Job Description:
Senior Product Stewardship Engineer (m/f/*)
The Impact You’ll Make in this Role
As a Senior Product Stewardship Engineer located at our UK HQ in Bracknell, Berkshire you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative and diverse people around the world.
Here, you will make an impact by:
Being a trusted regulatory partner to the business by translating complex product compliance requirements into clear, practical guidance to support successful commercialisation.
Leading the daily compliance task of approving new 3M products intended for the UK and EU market by ensuring documentation relating to local requirements are fulfilled.
Working closely with internal and external customers and within the EMEA Product Stewardship team to manage enquiries on regulatory aspects of 3M products. Example, UK specific requirements, REACH, RoHS, Biocidal Products Regulation, Conflict Minerals, compositional data, etc.
Contribute to digital transformation and process simplification by identifying opportunities to improve workflows, data quality, automation, and regulatory information management.
Prepare and maintain product compliance documentation such as declarations, regulatory statements, customer responses, and internal assessment records.
Stay ahead of changing regulatory landscapes by monitoring new requirements, assessing product impacts, and sharing practical insights with business teams.
Your Skills and Expertise To set you up for success in this role from day one, 3M is looking for candidates who meet following minimum requirements:
Solid understanding of EU and UK product compliance requirements
Strong preference for candidates with prior experience supporting compliance and other relevant product stewardship or regulatory requirements.
Ability to interpret regulations and translate them into clear, practical business guidance
Bachelor’s/Master’s degree, technical (e.g. Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Environmental, Material Science, etc.)
Additional knowledge / nice-to-have skills / preferred qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:
Enjoys working with multiple IT systems
Excellent organisational skills, attention to detail and capable of dealing with short deadlines
Demonstrated communication skills - must be able to summarize and articulate technical information to diverse audiences
Self-motivated, proactive, and growth-oriented
Experienced in working across cultures and cross-functional teams
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to drive projects to completion
Nordic languages would be advantageous
Job specifics:
Location Information - Bracknell, UK
This role has on-site working model, with the employee working at least four days a week in the office at Bracknell
Working pattern - full time

# Business Value Consultant
Sales GroupFull timeUK-Remote
Apply Now
8x8 connects our customers and teams globally, empowering CX leaders with performance and insights to make smarter decisions, delight customers, and drive lasting business impact.
The **Business Value Consultant (BVC)** is an expert in contact centre and unified communications technologies, solution connectivity challenges and options, and business processes. They bring first-hand experience from within the contact centre industry, with the ability to apply that understanding to sales engagements and recommend solution designs. This combination of technical and business experience, together with a clear understanding of the product development lifecycle and the broader technology landscape, positions this individual contributor as a trusted advisor to 8x8, the Sales organisation, and the prospect and customer community. The role also supports internal departments across the organisation as a resource and subject matter expert (SME) for both 8x8 products and industry trends.
As part of the Global Sales Team, the BVC provides support on strategic and critical opportunities for prospects. The consultant conducts deep discovery into current business operations and challenges to position the best solution for the customer, and may run sessions to help determine the Return on Investment (ROI) a customer could see after implementing 8x8 solutions, creating a foundation for budgetary and business planning. They contribute to the successful onboarding of potential customers onto the platform while providing best practice guidance on hosted contact centre, unified communications, workforce optimisation, self-service, emerging communication technologies (including AI and its impact on communications), and customer experience. They also support ongoing retention for existing 8x8 customers through deep data analysis and optimisation, sharing data-based recommendations such as configuration changes, better use of underutilised features, or new products and services for the existing deployment. The consultant may provide on-site or remote support for early-stage go/no-go situations, development of strategic opportunities, delivery of on-site sales consulting services for prospects, and subsequent post-visit reports.
The successful BVC must be able to present 8x8 solutions effectively to prospect and customer personnel at varying levels, including C-level, business unit or operations management, and technology professionals. This role is integral to the overall success of the Sales, Solutions Engineering and Customer Success organisations, ensuring a positive customer experience throughout.
Responsibilities
* Become an expert in the 8x8 product portfolio including CCaaS, UCaaS CPaaS and AI solutions, and demonstrate solutions as needed to develop and explain the recommended solution architecture.
* Develop fluency in new and emerging technology offerings from our Technology Ecosystem Partners.
* Support the global sales team on request for strategic or critical opportunities, identifying gaps and red-flag issues that could be barriers to successful implementation or increase the risk of not meeting prospects' expectations.
* Work collaboratively with prospects' contact centre teams and business unit leaders to provide change management support, facilitate sound decision-making, review options and considerations in system design, and provide insight into the trade-offs between them.
* Engage in contact centre reviews with prospects, examining business processes, current technology strategy and required metrics to collaboratively clarify priorities. Analyse customers' contact centre analytics, processes and metrics to identify gaps, and provide a roadmap of recommendations to move from current state to successful deployment against their strategic objectives.
* Provide internal guidance and mentoring across all project areas, including call flow design, workforce management, quality monitoring, key metrics, and the unique dynamics of contact centre operations.
* Ensure customers realise maximum value from their investment by driving proper methodologies, processes and best practices across all consulting engagements.
* Strengthen credibility as a contact centre and customer experience expert by delivering presentations on contact centre issues for consulting projects, and representing 8x8 at industry conferences and events.
* Produce materials such as on-site reports and analysis of results, and contribute to the creation and optimisation of templates for the BVC team.
* Stay abreast of current developments in telecommunications, UCaaS, CCaaS, CPaaS, self-service, automation, VoIP technologies, AI solutions and industry trends.
* Engage with the Centre of Excellence as the CX consultant for contact centre proof of concepts.
Qualifications
* 5+ years in a consulting role with CCaaS and UCaaS experience.
* 5+ years in an operational contact centre role.
* Professional consulting experience preferred; internal consulting and collaboration also considered.
* Experience in technology sales engineering is an advantage.
* Progressive experience in roles of increasing responsibility within contact centre, VoIP or unified communications technology.
* Understanding of AI and how to apply it to improve day-to-day efficiency, benefiting the team, the organisation and customers.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
* Knowledge of contact centre technology, quality management and workforce management.
* Broad understanding of the contact centre market and its trends, including emerging technologies.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Excellent interpersonal skills, demonstrated in a customer-facing environment.
* Strong organisational, written and verbal communication skills.
* Creative, with the ability to think beyond conventional approaches.
* Able to work independently as well as within a team.
* Flexibility to accommodate travel requirements.

Every bank, lender and investment platform runs into the same invisible pain: compliance review that slows down every campaign, every launch, every idea. We're turning the function that has always said 'no' into infrastructure that says 'yes, and here's how'.
This is a fundamental shift in how regulated industries and compliance teams operate, and we're only at the beginning. The product you'll design is what people actually touch when they experience that shift.
Founded in 2024, we've already earned the trust of leading innovators as well as established enterprises including Monzo, Lloyds, PensionBee, Kraken, Coinbase and many others. Our early traction let us raise 2.6m in funding, and we're now scaling fast. We're building the product engine that turns a genuinely novel category into something people love to use, and this is where you come in.
## The Basics
**Location:** London (4 days a week in our Farringdon office)
**Reports to:** founders, working day to day alongside our CTO
**The role:** our first dedicated designer, owning the product experience end to end
## The Role
You'd be the first designer at Adclear. Today, design here is developer-led and largely AI/vibe-coded, with no single owner. That's the gap you're filling: the product's look, feel and flow are yours to mold, and the design function is yours to build from the ground up.
This role has two distinct halves, and we're looking for someone who can genuinely do both.
The first is improving what already exists. Adclear is a live product used regularly by enterprises and other customers. You'll bring coherence to the UI, refine and properly apply our existing design system across the app, improve existing functionality, and design complex new features on top of it. Strong UX judgment matters as much as UI polish here: a lot of this is making genuinely complex, regulated workflows navigable for non-technical users like compliance reviewers and marketers.
The second is zero-to-one. We'll likely be building two new product lines from scratch alongside the core product, which means heavy discovery, lots of proof-of-concepts, and rapid iteration through quick mockups, AI-assisted prototypes and user testing. You'll be speaking with customers regularly across both workstreams, not just the new ones.
You won't be handed tidy specs and asked to make them pretty. You'll sit in the messy middle: talking to compliance teams and marketers at banks and fintechs, working out what they actually need, and turning genuinely hard, ambiguous problems into a product that feels obvious once it exists.
This is a design role with a real product management edge. You'll work in tandem with our CTO to shape what we build and why, not just how it looks. You'll help set priorities, scope releases and make the calls that move the roadmap.
## What you'll do
* Own the end-to-end product experience: from problem definition and research through to interaction design, high-fidelity UI and shipped product
* Bring consistency to the existing product: refine and coherently apply our design system across the app, and raise the UX and UI bar on what's already live
* Work directly with our CTO to shape the roadmap, scope releases and decide what's worth building, wearing a product manager hat alongside your design one
* Lead discovery and build proof-of-concepts for new product lines, moving from sketch to something real fast rather than over weeks
* Run your own research: get on customer calls across both the existing product and new lines, sit in on compliance reviews, and turn what you hear into clear product direction
* Establish the foundations of design at Adclear: the design system, the patterns, the craft bar and the way design works with engineering and go-to-market
* Set up design process from scratch, and help build the design team over time, with the potential to lead it
* Partner with engineering from design through implementation, staying close as things get built so the shipped product matches the intent
## What you should have
* A track record that spans early-stage chaos and later-stage scaling: you joined a company at pre-seed or seed and helped take it through to Series B, or joined at Series A and scaled it through to Series C or D. You may have covered these stages across different companies rather than one.
* Genuine range: you're comfortable being dropped into zero-to-one ambiguity, but you've also proven you can take a product to its next level, not only start things from a blank page.
* You've shipped code, understand how systems work under the hood, and don't need engineering to explain why something is hard
* Prototypes in code as a default, not a last resort - You are a Figma expert and Cursor, Claude Code, or similar are already part of how you work
* High agency: comfortable operating as the sole designer under pressure, managing a heavy and varied workload, moving quickly without sacrificing quality
## What we hope you have
* Exposure to fintech, regtech or another regulated space. A real plus, but not a must.
* Experience designing for non-technical operators. You've built for people who use software to get a job done, like compliance reviewers and marketers, not power users who live in the tool.
* Fluency moving between fidelities fast. Napkin sketch to clickable prototype in a day, because the fastest way to settle a debate is to make the thing real.
* Experience building or leading a design function, or a clear point of view on how you'd start building one here.
## How we work
* Founders and the CTO are closely involved in the day-to-day, and design has a real seat at the table
* Design drives product direction here; it doesn't decorate decisions made elsewhere
* The pace is fast and the approach is still being built, and you're one of the people building it
* This isn't the right role if you want a fixed formula and a full team handed to you on day one
## Benefits
* Competitive pay
* Meaningful equity as our founding designer
* Private healthcare and dental
* Hardware and software budget so you have the tools you want
* Monthly gym contribution
* A rare chance to define the product and the design function of a fast-growing company from scratch
## How to apply
Send us a link to your portfolio together with your CV. We read every application.

**Technical & Quality Centre**
**Quality Product Analysis Specialist**
**Location: Rotherham**
Alliance Automotive Group UK & Ireland is a leading distributor of passenger and commercial vehicle parts to motor factors, garages, franchise networks and public services throughout the UK and Ireland. Our strategically designed network, supported by acquisitions, positions us as a market leader in providing automotive parts distribution services to the aftermarket.

The Quality Product Analysis Specialist plays a critical role within the Technical & Quality Centre by conducting in-depth inspections, diagnostic testing, and root cause analysis of returned automotive components.
This position ensures that warranty claims are assessed accurately and consistently while supporting overall product quality, compliance, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Working across a broad range of systems—including turbochargers, braking components, suspension units, clutches, and rotating electrics (alternators and starters)—the specialist applies advanced mechanical and electrical expertise to determine failure causes, verify product performance against factory specifications, and differentiate between manufacturing defects and usage-related issues.
The role combines hands-on technical evaluation with detailed digital reporting and cross-functional collaboration. Using specialized testing equipment and precision measuring tools, the specialist generates comprehensive inspection reports, documents findings with photographic evidence, and supports warranty decision-making in alignment with company policies and regulatory standards.
Beyond technical capability, the position requires strong analytical thinking and a methodical, investigative mindset. The Quality Product Analysis Specialist acts as a key liaison between warranty administration, customer service, and manufacturing partners—clearly communicating technical findings to ensure timely and fair claim resolution.
This role is essential in safeguarding product integrity, improving quality performance, and maintaining customer confidence through accurate, data-driven analysis and professional technical expertise.
**Core Responsibilities**
• Component Inspection: Conduct detailed physical and functional inspections on a wide range of components including turbos, braking systems, suspension units, clutches, and rotating electrics (alternators/starters).
• Diagnostic Testing: Operate specialised test equipment (e.g., vacuum testers, electronic actuator testers, battery/alternator analysers, brake DTV machines, and brake caliper testers) to verify part performance against factory specifications.
• Root Cause Analysis: Investigate and determine the underlying cause of failure (e.g., carbon buildup, oil starvation, electrical surges, installation errors) to support warranty claim evaluations.
• Warranty Claim Assessment: Review and assess warranty claims in accordance with company policies, determining validity and identifying potential manufacturing or usage defects.
• Digital Reporting & Documentation: Utilise computer systems to log findings, upload digital photos of defects, generate professional inspection and warranty evaluation reports, and maintain accurate records for claim processing.
• Quality & Compliance: Maintain a clean, organised laboratory/testing environment ensuring all test equipment is in safe and calibrated working order. Ensure inspections comply with company standards and relevant regulatory requirements.
• Cross-Functional Communication: Collaborate closely with warranty administration, customer service, and re manufacturing teams to share findings, explain technical details, and support timely claim resolution.
**Technical Skills & Knowledge (Hard Skills)**
• Multi-System Mastery: Deep mechanical knowledge of modern vehicle and electronic systems.
• Electrical Proficiency: Ability to read electrical schematics and use multimetres or oscilloscopes to test rotating electrics and electronic sensors.
• Software Literacy: Comfortable with PC-based diagnostic software, CRM portals, warranty management systems, and standard office tools (e.g., Microsoft Word/Excel).
• Precision Measurement: Skilled with precision tools such as micrometres, vernier calipers, and dial indicators for checking tolerances and shaft play.
• Warranty & Compliance Knowledge: Understanding of warranty policies, claim processing procedures, and applicable regulatory standards.
**Character Qualities & Professionalism (Soft Skills)**
• Analytical Thinking: Logical, detective-like mindset adept at solving complex diagnostic puzzles that other technicians may overlook.
• Attention to Detail: Precision in inspecting fracture surfaces, wear patterns, and minute electrical deviations.
• Reliability & Punctuality: Strict adherence to schedules and deadlines, ensuring customer and warranty reports are delivered on time.
• Clear Communication: Ability to translate complex technical failures into clear, simple language for non-technical stakeholders, customers, and internal teams.
• Collaboration: Effective team player with proven ability to coordinate across departments for efficient warranty handling.
**Desired Qualifications & Experience**
• Proven Experience: Ideally 3–5 years as a senior technician or diagnostic specialist in a high-volume garage, remanufacturing environment, or warranty inspection role.
• Certification: Level 3 Automotive Technician qualification or equivalent (e.g., IMI or City & Guilds).
• Failure Analysis Training. Warranty Training: Experience or formal training related to warranty claim evaluation and processing preferred.
**Physical Requirements**
• Capacity to safely handle heavy components (e.g., alternators, brake discs) and stand for extended periods in a workshop or laboratory environment.

***Customer-Facing Security Assurance (10%)***
* Produce customer-facing security assurance — security questionnaire responses, security whitepapers, and trust collateral — that unblocks enterprise deals.

***Leadership (10%)***
* Mentor teams on secure coding, AI risk management, and secure design.

Arm is a complex and dynamic semiconductor and AI technology business with a portfolio of over 12,000 active patents and applications covering a broad range of CPU, GPU, AI, semiconductor and software technologies. This is an exciting time to join and help shape how innovation is protected within our business.
## Job Overview:
Our in-house IP team builds and curates Arm’s global patent portfolio and supports the protection of innovation throughout our business. As Arm continues to invest in IP protection across both established and emerging technology areas, we are expanding our Patents team to add drafting and prosecution capability.
This is a new type of role for Arm. While our existing patent attorneys are involved across the breadth of portfolio development and management, this position is being created with hands-on patent drafting and prosecution as a primary activity, helping to build our in-house capability.
The role is particularly suited to a patent attorney who genuinely enjoys the craft of drafting and prosecution and wants that to remain a significant part of their day-to-day work. You will have the opportunity to work on technically challenging inventions at the leading edge of Arm’s business without needing to move away from hands-on patent work to develop your in-house career.
## **Responsibilities:**
You will work directly with inventors and engineering teams across Arm to understand new technologies, help identify and capture inventions, and draft patent applications covering innovations in areas including microelectronics, semiconductor technology, computer architecture, software and artificial intelligence. You will also take direct responsibility for the prosecution of your filings before the UKIPO, EPO and other patent offices, while continuing to work alongside and direct our network of external patent counsel where appropriate.
Because this is a new capability for Arm, you could help shape it from the outset. Rather than joining a mature process and simply working through an established caseload, you will be the start of an effective in-house drafting and prosecution function, develop prosecution workflows, explore how we better engage with inventors for our own drafts, and help to develop our use of AI to work more effectively.
We are not looking simply to recreate an external patent attorney firm within Arm. We want to develop an in-house model that takes advantage of being embedded within the business, with closer access to inventors, greater insight into our technologies and strategy, and the ability to make prosecution decisions in the context of the wider portfolio and Arm’s commercial objectives.
For someone coming from private practice, this offers a relatively unusual proposition: the opportunity to continue doing the drafting and prosecution work you enjoy, while helping to kickstart a new in-house capability around it. There are no client billing requirements, billable-hour targets or pressure to generate work, but there will be expectations set around drafting and prosecution output which are intended to ensure an appropriate and sustainable level of delivery and to demonstrate the value of this role, rather than recreate a private-practice billing environment.
Being embedded within Arm also means having much greater context around the inventions you protect. You will build relationships with inventors and technical teams, understand the technologies and products being developed, and see how individual inventions fit within Arm’s wider technology, commercial and patent strategies. The objective is not simply to draft and prosecution file on any idea, but to help identify, capture and prepare cases to build a strategically relevant portfolio for the business.
Although drafting and prosecution will be the primary focus of the role**,** you will remain part of the wider in-house IP team and participate in broader portfolio activities where appropriate. Depending on your interests and experience, there may also be opportunities over time to become involved in areas such as invention harvesting, portfolio strategy, competitive intelligence, standards, open-source software, patent analytics, IP data and reporting, and projects to improve the systems through which we manage and use our IP.
## **Required Skills and Experience:**
* This role may suit a finals-level / a few years qualified CPA and/or EPA qualified patent attorney. Alternatively, you may be someone who wants to take a step back from management or business development to return to a role focussed on drafting and prosecution work.
* A background in electronics, physics or computer science or proven experience working or prosecuting patent portfolios in such an area.
* A university degree in Electronics, Computer Science, Physics or a related subject is preferred, although other qualifications will be considered if suitable technical knowledge can be shown.
## **In Return:**
This is an opportunity to remain a hands-on patent attorney working with cutting-edge compute, semiconductor, software and AI inventions and help Arm to deliver more of its drafting and prosecution work in-house.

**About Arup University**
Arup University is Arup's engine for exploration, innovation and adaptation. We drive the technical excellence, future capabilities and collective intelligence that enable Arup to lead in evolving markets, win better work and deliver world-class outcomes.
We work through three integrated capability areas. Discovery explores future markets and creates new capabilities through foresight, research and innovation. Expertise builds technical excellence and world-leading expertise through Skills Networks, continuous learning and our Fellows. Knowledge ensures the firm can find, share and build on what it knows, so that 80 years of hard-earned experience becomes a source of intelligence and competitive advantage.
**About Operations & Strategic Services**
Operations & Strategic Services (OSS) exists to simplify, strengthen and coordinate the delivery of Arup University's programmes and services. We bring together finance, programme management and coordination with Strategic Design, Engagement, and Data & AI capability, working in project-based teams in a design-led, data-informed way to set and solve AU challenges.
**The Opportunity**
We are looking for a strong communicator, storyteller, and project manager who is interested in how people encounter new ideas, and how learning, ways of working, and activities become part of everyday practice.
Arup University is a team of 130 people with 18,000 internal clients. Our programmes are designed globally, but they only land when people across the firm properly engage. For us, engagement is two-way, relationship-led work. It connects our programmes to the people who need them, and brings what those people need back into how we design and run them.
This new role gives AU’s engagement work more capacity and craft. You will work closely with the Engagement Lead, who sets the overall strategy and direction, and your focus will be bringing that direction to life through practical engagement planning, useful materials, and well-run activity.
The role carries real ownership. You will lead defined engagement activities and small projects yourself, from scoping through to delivery and review, while also helping AU teams turn good ideas into clear stories and useful tools.
You will not be expected to arrive with all the answers. This is a developing area of work, and you will shape it alongside an experienced lead, with support and room to grow over time.
**Key responsibilities:**
**Planning engagement with AU teams**
a. Own the day-to-day translation of AU’s engagement strategy into practical plans for programmes, capabilities, and project teams, working to the direction set by the Engagement Lead.
b. Run planning conversations and workshops with AU teams and leaders, helping them clarify who they need to reach, why it matters, what those people need to understand or do, and which activities will get them there.
c. Turn the output of those sessions into clear, actionable engagement plans with named audiences, activities, owners, and timings.
d. Own and maintain AU’s engagement planning toolkit, including templates, guidance, session formats, worked examples, and repeatable approaches, so teams can plan with confidence, support participation and behaviour change, and avoid starting from scratch each time.
**Leading the delivery of engagement activity**
a. Take end-to-end responsibility for delivering defined engagement activities for priority AU initiatives, from scoping and scheduling through to delivery, follow-up, and review.
b. Work with programme teams, OSS colleagues, AU geography representatives, and our Skills Networks engagement colleague so activity is planned once and lands well in every region.
c. Set up and run the operational side of AU’s engagement routes and sessions so they work reliably and to a consistent standard.
**Coordinating stakeholder activity, feedback, and insight**
a. Own the shared view of who AU is engaging, when, and why, so the firm experiences AU as joined up rather than fragmented, and so we avoid duplication.
b. Co-design and maintain straightforward feedback loops, synthesising what AU hears from geography representatives, programme teams, and other engagement routes into reusable insight for programme design, leadership updates, engagement planning, and our own practice.
c. Track how engagement approaches are landing, capture what works, retire what does not, and recommend changes based on what the evidence tells you.
**Shaping the narrative and materials that engagement depends on**
a. Develop clear, useful materials that support engagement activity, including messaging frameworks, presentations, scripts, briefing notes, session materials, and strategy documents.
b. Find the thread in dense, technical, or half-formed material, bringing curiosity, clarity, and initiative to turn it into something people across the firm can understand, explain to others, and act on.
c. Work to AU’s existing messaging guidance, keep it current, contribute to how it develops, and grow into more strategic responsibility as the role and the practice mature.
**Is this role right for you?**
* You will be an experienced engagement and storytelling professional, though we are equally interested in a less conventional route into this kind of work.
* Excellent writing, narrative, and storytelling skills, with the judgement to turn complex or competing inputs into clear, accurate, and compelling messages for different audiences.
* Experience producing practical materials others can use and adapt, such as messaging frameworks, engagement packs, briefings, scripts, presentations, strategy documents, and templates.
* Experience taking work end to end, from scoping and coordinating contributors to managing multiple priorities and keeping delivery on track.
* Working knowledge of engagement practice, including what makes engagement different from communications, participation, and behaviour change.
* Comfortable working with senior stakeholders and navigating a large, complex organisation across regions, disciplines, and contexts.
* Confident facilitating or supporting workshops and planning conversations, or keen to develop this with support.
* Comfortable collaborating asynchronously as part of a globally distributed team.
* An awareness of design thinking, and how it can be applied to organisational problems
* Familiarity with change management or behavioural change approaches
* An interest in systems thinking and how parts of an organisation connect
* AI skills, or a good understanding of the challenges and opportunities AI is creating in professional practice
* Experience of, or genuine curiosity about, the built environment
**Values and approach**
* Curious about people, and interested in understanding an audience properly before designing anything for them
* Believes engagement is about participation and behaviour, not distribution and reach
* Reflective and open to feedback, willing to adapt an approach based on what is actually working
* Comfortable with ambiguity, curious about developing areas of work, and happy to shape early-stage thinking into something clearer with appropriate support

## Job Description
This is an opportunity to join Ascot Group - one of the world’s preeminent specialty risk underwriting organizations.
Designed as a modern-era company operating through an ecosystem of interconnected global operating platforms, we are bound by a common mission and purpose: One Ascot. Our greatest strength is a talented team who flourish in a collaborative, inclusive, and entrepreneurial culture, steeped in underwriting excellence, integrity, and a passion to find a better way, The Ascot Way.
The Ascot Way guides our people and our organisation. Our underwriting platforms collaborate to find creative ways to deploy our capital in a true cross-product and cross-platform approach. **Job Purpose:**
Ascot UK is seeking a motivated internal controls professional to head the Internal Controls unit, providing support to the UK Finance leadership team and to the Senior Vice President, Group Head of Internal Audit & Advisory, in the performance of Ascot UK’s quarterly and annual control testing. The Head of Internal Controls owns the Internal Control over Financial Reporting (ICFR) programme, leads the development and continual enhancement of the internal control framework, and provides leadership to the UK finance team on internal control matters via the UK Technical Accounting Group (“TAG”). The role leads the Internal Controls team, including the Technical Accountant, and works closely with the external audit team and with local, regional and global leaders of the Company while maintaining objectivity.
**Detailed Duties:**
* Lead the development and continual enhancement of the internal control framework, aligning it with organisational needs and evolving risk profiles.
* Assess departmental needs, establish priorities, and assist in the design and management of the annual control testing plan.
* Own the Internal Control over Financial Reporting (ICFR) programme, ensuring compliance with standards such as SOX 404 and the UK Corporate Governance Code.
* Develop and deliver control testing programmes for financial, reporting, operational and compliance controls, and establish methodologies (e.g. walkthroughs, sample testing) to assess control design and effectiveness.
* Document new or changed business processes, map end-to-end workflows, and identify internal controls to cover identified risks. Where unmitigated risks are identified, assist management in the design and implementation of appropriate controls.
* Become actively engaged within the Ascot UK processes to fully understand and contemplate the company’s risks and business activities.
* Provide leadership to the UK finance team on internal control matters via the UK Technical Accounting Group (“TAG”), including the recommendation of any remediation actions should they be required. This will include the production of memos regarding specific internal control topics (e.g. risk of fraud).
* Coordinate with the external audit team during the annual year-end audit planning process.
* Develop strong relationships with local, regional and global leaders of the Company while maintaining objectivity.
* Lead special project engagements as requested by company management.
* Update annually (at a minimum) the materiality thresholds for Global Specialty (both collectively and as individual companies).
* Remain current on and continuously develop knowledge of control guidance, accounting standards, trending issues and best practices through available literature and attendance at appropriate conferences and seminars.
* Line manage, develop and set objectives for the Internal Controls function, including the Technical Accountant, and review the output of the duties set out below.

+ Management of all technical accounting memos, ensuring they are updated annually.

* Preparation of new accounting policies in compliance with FRS 102/3 as and when the need arises.

* Ad-hoc technical accounting projects and queries as and when they arise.

* Strong interpersonal and communication skills to work collaboratively across multiple time zones, geographies, and business functions

* Knowledge and experience with drug safety reporting, regulatory compliance and with international requirements and pharmacovigilance regulations

# Senior Robotics Simulation Engineer
Automation - London - Onsite - Full Time
Overview
Application Form
****London, E17 | 4-5 days per week on-site****
### ****About us****
We're automating homebuilding. Construction is one of the least automated industries in the world, and homes are still built largely by hand, in slow, expensive and fragmented processes. AUAR is a physical AI and robotics company changing that.
Our software platform, MasterBuilder, turns a building design into the instructions needed to manufacture a home's timber structure. Our robotic MicroFactory then deploys directly onto a homebuilder's site and produces the wall, floor and roof panels they need, on demand. It arrives in a shipping container, sits on a footprint of max 30 by 30 ft and runs off generators on a gravel pad: no grid connection, no permanent site works. We own and run the equipment, our customers buy the panels it produces, not the machine.
We're past pure R&D and shipping our first commercial MicroFactories this year, across the UK, Europe and North America. Backed by Planet A, PT1, Shadow Ventures and ABB Robotics, we're a team of around 35 engineers, roboticists, operators and designers working from an 11,000 sq ft R&D and demonstration facility in London. The systems we build now will decide how homes are manufactured at scale.
### ****The role****
We're looking for a ****Senior Robotics Simulation Engineer**** to own and advance the simulation capability for our robotic MicroFactory.
Simulation is how we develop an increasingly complex robotic manufacturing system without being blocked on one physical machine. You'll own our physics-based environment in NVIDIA Isaac Sim and everything around it: digital twins of the robotic cell, CAD and USD asset pipelines, physics and control modelling, ROS 2 integration and automated test scenarios. The hardware keeps changing underneath you, so keeping the digital and physical systems aligned is permanent, not a setup phase.
This is a senior IC role with real technical ownership. You'll define the engineering approach, make the calls on fidelity and architecture, and work with robotics software, controls, integration, test and mechanical engineering to find where simulation actually has leverage. You'll also make it something the team can use, not something only you can run.
### ****Problems you'll work on****
* ****Simulation architecture**** - Own and evolve our Isaac Sim environment so it stays reliable, maintainable and usable across robotics development.
* ****Digital twins and asset pipelines**** - Keep models of robots, tooling and the wider cell physically representative as the hardware changes, with robust workflows for taking engineering geometry into USD.
* ****Physics that matches reality**** - Tune contacts, friction, joints, actuators and sensors for stable, useful behaviour, and diagnose where simulation diverges from the machine.
* ****ROS 2 integration**** - Own the interface so robotics software runs against simulated and physical systems through consistent abstractions.
* ****Virtual development and automated testing**** - Build scenarios that exercise behaviours, changes and failure conditions repeatedly, and turn them into tests that live in the robotics CI workflow.
* ****Sim-to-real**** - Find the discrepancies between simulated and real MicroFactory behaviour that actually affect engineering decisions, and close them.
* ****Data for what comes next**** - Version simulation runs as usable data, and generate synthetic training data with domain randomisation to support computer-vision development.
### ****What good looks like****
* In your first weeks, you're running the existing environment yourself, finding where it diverges from the physical MicroFactory, and forming a view on where simulation has the most leverage.
* Within your first month, another engineer can run a useful scenario without you configuring it for them.
* Within two months, there's a clear technical direction: what gets modelled, to what fidelity, and how it stays aligned as hardware changes.
* Simulation is routinely used to develop, test and make engineering decisions, not to produce demos.
* The environment keeps pace with changing hardware and software without becoming fragile or expensive to maintain.
* You know when fidelity is enough to answer the question and when physical testing is still required, and you don't gold-plate.
### ****Who this is for****
You're a senior robotics or simulation engineer who has built simulation environments for complex physical systems, and you know the gap between a simulation that looks convincing and one that is useful for engineering. You've worked where software, controls, mechanical systems, sensing and physics all interact, and you're comfortable going deep into a physics problem, debugging a ROS integration, or deciding a model isn't worth building at all.
You like owning technical infrastructure rather than contributing individual scenes. You think about architecture, maintainability and how other engineers will use what you build. You'll have real autonomy over the approach, alongside a robotics team that will use and challenge it. If your simulation work has been about convincing visuals or research demos rather than tools other engineers depend on, or you'd rather be handed scenarios to build than decide what's worth modelling, this isn't the right role. The tooling you'd want handed to you is the tooling you'd be building.
### ****What we're looking for****
* ****NVIDIA Isaac Sim:**** significant hands-on experience building robotics simulation environments in it.
* ****Simulation physics:**** contacts, friction, joints, stiffness, damping and control parameters, and the ability to diagnose unstable or non-physical behaviour rather than tuning blindly.
* ****Strong Python, and fluency with Linux, Docker and Git.****
* ****Integration with real robotics software:**** you've connected simulation to systems that actually run, with working knowledge of ROS 2 interfaces and workflows.
* ****CAD and 3D assets:**** engineering geometry in a robotics, manufacturing or automation context.
* ****Infrastructure other people use:**** simulation infrastructure a wider team could use and maintain, not only you.
* ****Judgement on fidelity:**** you know when a model is accurate enough, and can defend the trade-off between complexity and usefulness.
* ****Cross-discipline communication:**** you work clearly with robotics, controls and mechanical engineers, not just other simulation people.
### ****Bonus if you have****
* URDF and CAD-to-URDF/USD asset pipelines.
* Automated simulation testing, CI, or hardware/software-in-the-loop workflows.
* Industrial robots or automated manufacturing systems, and C++.
* MuJoCo or other simulation platforms, deeper PhysX knowledge, or deformable-body and compliant-joint modelling.
* ML training-data pipelines, domain randomisation, synthetic data generation or sim-to-real calibration, and cloud-based simulation infrastructure.
### ****What we offer****
* Competitive salary based on experience
* 28 bookable days + bank holidays + seasonal office closure
* Health and dental insurance via Bupa
* Pension via Smart Pensions
* An 11,000 sq ft R&D and demonstration facility in E17, where you work alongside the hardware your software drives, plus time on MicroFactory sites where it runs
* Share options so we all grow together
* High autonomy, high accountability, and a team of industry experts that takes the mission seriously
### ****Our values****
* ****#ownyourmission**** - we take responsibility and execute with focus and urgency.
* ****#forpeopleandplanet**** - we strive to do the best for people and planet.
* ****#buildtogether**** - we succeed through deep collaboration with our team, partners and customers.
* ****#gooddesign**** - we centre good design in everything we do, holistically.
* ****#beboldberadical**** - we think creatively; we are ambitious, bold and radical.
### ****Application process****
We expect the full hiring process to take around 4-5 weeks, and we aim to be as transparent as possible throughout.
1. Initial Application - a human will review your CV & full application
2. Hiring Manager Call (30-45 mins, remote) - with Gilles Retsin (CTPO/Co-founder) OR Tom d'Arcy (Head of Robotics & Deployment)
3. Task-based Working Session & Values Interview (60-90 mins, in-person) - you'll be given a real AUAR challenge to tackle in your own time and present to a panel of AUAR team members. We'll also discuss our Values.
4. Final Founder Interview (30 mins, in-person) - with Gilles Retsin (CTPO/Co-founder) OR Mollie Claypool (CEO/Co-founder)
5. Offer
****This is a London role, 5 days a week in our E17 office. You'll need the right to work in the UK. We can sponsor visas if you're a standout candidate. If this is a fit, tell us, we'd rather hear from you than not.****
**We're proud that 50% of our technical team and 50% of our leadership are women. We're building a team as diverse as the communities we serve. If you see a part of this role that excites you, even if you don't meet 100% of the criteria, we encourage you to apply. Let's make housing better, together.**

* Design, develop and test **rApps** for the Non-RT RIC / SMO layer, using the R1 interface to consume data and issue A1 policies to the Near-RT RIC.

* Design and implement CI/CD pipelines for automated build, test and deployment of RIC applications.

* Troubleshoot and debug issues across the RIC platforms and application stack.

* 3-5 years’ software development experience, with strong programming skills in **Python and Go.**
* Solid understanding of the **O-RAN architecture**: SMO, Non-RT RIC, Near-RT RIC, and the A1, O1, R1 and E2 interfaces, including E2 Service Models.
* Knowledge of 5G NR RAN protocols and 3GPP specifications.
* Experience with Near-RT RIC Message Routing and Shared Data Layer (SDL).
* Experience working with multiple databases (e.g. Redis, Influx, MariaDB).
* Hands-on experience with the **O-RAN SMO/Non-RT and Near-RT RIC platforms.**
* Experience developing, packaging and deploying containerised applications with **Docker, Kubernetes and Helm.**
* Working knowledge of **REST APIs** and microservices architecture.
* Proficiency with **Git** and collaborative development workflows.
* Comfortable working in a **Linux** environment.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and in a team.
**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications, Electronic Engineering or a related field.

Payments has a lead role in one and a significant role in four of the Bank’s strategic priorities. About Better Collective
Sports media at scale, running on data
Better Collective is a global sports media group, reaching more than 400 million monthly visits across a portfolio of leading sports media brands.
We build products and experiences that make sports more engaging and accessible for fans around the world. Behind that sits a large and diverse technology and data landscape, spanning markets, brands and business models.
We work in a collaborative environment where people are encouraged to challenge how things are done, take ownership and help shape what comes next.
The domain
Paid media is where the data has to pay off.
We spend real money across dozens of ad networks every day. Which campaigns scale, which creatives get cut, which markets get more budget: those calls come out of the models this team builds.
Ad platform spend and delivery, affiliate and operator revenue, CRM data, all stitched into one user-level view of what a click was actually worth. That model exists and it works.
It is also the most demanding domain on our data platform - the most sources, the fastest schema churn, and the shortest patience for a table that landed late.
We are looking for the engineer who owns it.
Where this role sits
A central platform team sets the how. You set the what.
Better Collective runs a hub and spoke data organisation. A central data platform team owns the platform itself - MotherDuck, dbt, Dagster, DLT, the golden paths, the standards, the infrastructure. Paid Media Insights is a domain team, a spoke, that builds on it.
The split is deliberate and we hold to it. The platform team decides how data is produced here. You decide what paid media produces, and you own everything we run.
So you are not starting a new stack, and you are not going to spend your year on plumbing that a central team should be solving once for everyone.
You are, however, expected to be a demanding customer. When a golden path does not fit paid media, we want you to say so and push for it to change, not quietly build around it.
You will report to the Senior Head of Paid Media Insights and work across Paid Media, with the Campaign, Commercial and CRM teams, as well as with the central platform team.
What you will own
Every data job in paid media. All of it.
Freshness, cost, reliability, alerting, and the incident at 07:30 before the spend review. If a paid media model is wrong or late, it is yours, not the platform team's. That accountability is the core of this role, not a footnote to it.
Concretely, you will own:
The end-to-end user-level model. Ad platform spend and delivery, affiliate and operator revenue, and CRM, joined into one view the business trusts enough to move budget on.
Ingestion of paid media sources, built on the platform's framework. Which sources, which schemas, and what happens the next time a network changes its API without telling anyone.
The domain's models, from staging through to the marts analysts and business teams actually query, plus the semantic meaning that sits on top of them. Nobody at the centre can define what a qualified signup means in paid media. You can.
Reverse ETL back into the ad platforms, so online and offline conversion data lands where it changes bidding.
The handover. Part of your first year is taking over the paid media jobs the central team still runs on our behalf, and moving that ownership to where the context actually lives.
What you will lead
A group of engineers, and the standard they build to
You will guide and mentor a group of data engineers in Paid Media Insights, as their technical lead. That means setting the standard for how this domain builds, reviewing their work, unblocking them, and deliberately growing them: giving away the interesting problems rather than keeping them.
You will also shape the domain's roadmap together with the Senior Head of Paid Media Insights, the analysts and the business teams, and you will represent paid media in platform conversations, including how we support machine learning and data science on top of this data.
This is a hands-on technical leadership role, not a step away from building. You will be in the code.
What we are looking for
More than a stack match, we are looking for a particular way of working.
You take ownership, and it shows up in the boring parts. Plenty of engineers want to design the model. You also want the pager. You would rather own a domain end to end, unglamorous parts included, than build one piece and hand off the consequences. When things get tricky, you follow through.
You break complex systems into simple parts. Paid media data is genuinely messy: attribution windows, late conversions, identity across platforms, and dozens of source APIs that all disagree. You can hold that complexity and still hand the business something they can reason about.
You raise the people around you. You are the person colleagues come to for technical advice, and you enjoy that part of the job. You give feedback that lands, you review generously, and you would rather the whole team understand the pipeline than be the only one who does.
You work well with a platform team. You have strong opinions about standards and you are still happy to work inside someone else's. You know the difference between a constraint worth fighting and a preference worth dropping, and you would rather help fix a shared path than fork it.
You are already past prompting. AI is part of how you engineer, not something you occasionally ask questions. You have experimented with agents, tooling or AI-enabled workflows, and you have a view on what a data domain has to look like for them to be useful on top of it: documented, standardised, semantically clear. Paid media is likely where we find out first.
You are close to the business. You will sit with marketers and analysts who are spending budget on what you build. You want that proximity, and you can talk about data with people who do not think in tables.
You are technically deep where it counts. Production pipelines in SQL and Python, modelling and orchestration tooling such as dbt and Dagster, cloud data warehousing, and a real feel for performance, cost and reliability at scale. Experience with paid media or attribution data, or with machine learning pipelines, is a bonus rather than a requirement.
Not sure you meet every single requirement? That is okay. Your unique experience might be exactly what we are looking for.
Our stack
What you will build on
MotherDuck / DuckDB · dbt · Dagster · DLT · Python · SQL · AWS · reverse ETL and semantic layer tooling
We do not expect you to have worked with all of these. If you have built production pipelines on Snowflake, BigQuery or Redshift and you are curious about where we are going, that transfers.
What we offer
An international company in growth, and a flat structure
Join a strong team where you can create value and make a real business impact, in a dynamic and creative environment with a flat organisational structure. Freedom with responsibility, ample room to grow, and the chance to take on a broad set of responsibilities.
Flexible working hours supporting a healthy work-life balance, private health insurance, and office perks including lunch, snacks, gym access and social events, alongside skilled, passionate and fun colleagues.
Your path to Better Collective
How to apply
We process applications on an ongoing basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible. For questions about the position, reach out to Michael Hill, Senior Head of Paid Media Insights, at mhill@bettercollective.com. We look forward to hearing from you.

We're looking for a Data Scientist to join Fospha's Data Science team in London.
Fospha builds marketing measurement products for ecommerce brands — attribution, marketing mix modelling, incrementality testing, and brand impact measurement. Our Data Science team owns the models behind all of it, from methodology through to production code. You will work across our technical stacks and own maintaining and growing the codebases that power our product and solutions.
This role suits an established data scientist who wants to own things properly. You'll lead larger production projects, choose the modelling approach rather than being handed it, and talk to clients as the modelling expert in the room — supported by a team that reviews each other's work seriously, and a company that rewards high agency with ownership.
Team: Data Science
Level: Career (Data Science Career Development Framework)
Location: London
What you'll do
Lead larger production projects end to end — scoping, building, and shipping production-level code, rather than working through tickets someone else has specified
Choose the modelling approach — independently selecting and applying the right method within our suite, across attribution, marketing mix modelling, incrementality testing, and brand impact. You will be given time to keep up-to-date on the latest methodologies in the industry
Resolve bugs and queries independently — including in parts of the codebase you didn't write, without needing to route them upwards
Use AI as leverage, not as a crutch — solving coding tickets quickly, unblocking yourself on product and engineering dependencies, and building automation workflows that save the team time
Work with QA properly — using our automated tooling efficiently and flagging the gaps in it rather than working around them
Communicate as a modelling expert — confidently and independently, with clients and with colleagues, including when the message is that a number they like is wrong
Help develop the people around you — code review, methodology critique, and hands-on support for less experienced colleagues. Breaking down tickets and helping those more junior is essential
What we're looking for
Essential
Solid commercial data science experience — typically 3–5 years, with a track record of shipping models into production
Strong ML knowledge across multiple algorithm families, and the judgement to pick the right approach for the problem rather than the one you know best
Strong Python and SQL, with the ability to lead on production-level code and set the standard others work to
Able to debug and resolve issues independently across unfamiliar repositories, using AI tooling to accelerate rather than to guess, while still understanding the problem fully
Strong AI fluency — you solve tickets quickly with it, you unblock cross-department dependencies with it, you build automation workflows with it, and you never send AI-assisted output without checking it
Confident, independent communication with clients and stakeholders as the technical authority on the work
Emerging mentorship — you're ready to develop junior colleagues, and you want to
Initiative in accepting and planning your own work, rather than waiting to be allocated it
Genuine attention to detail — much of this work involves noticing when a number is wrong
Nice to have
Bayesian modelling experience, particularly hierarchical models
Experience with AWS or comparable cloud tooling
Familiarity with automated QA tooling and test coverage practices
Experience with marketing, ecommerce, or advertising data
Not required
Experience with attribution methodology, MMM, incrementality testing, or Bayesian modelling is genuinely an advantage at this level — but it isn't a filter. Our stack takes time to learn regardless of what you arrive with, and we'd rather hire strong modelling judgement and teach the domain.
How you'll grow
We run a published Data Science Career Development Framework with six levels. You'd join at Career, where the expectations are:
AI Fluency & Tooling: Leverages AI to solve coding tickets quickly; consistently unblocks themselves on cross-department dependencies, especially product and engineering; never sends AI-assisted communication without checking quality; expert at using AI to build automation workflows.
Machine Learning & Modelling: Strong ML knowledge across multiple algorithm families; independently chooses and applies the right modelling approach within Fospha's suite.
Engineering & Codebase: Leads on larger coding projects and tickets with production-level code; resolves queries and bugs efficiently and independently; master at using supplied AWS tooling through AI; uses automated QA tools efficiently and flags gaps to the QA team.

Job Complexity: Consistent contributor and respected knowledge holder, with emerging collaboration and mentorship abilities.
Supervision: Demonstrates initiative in accepting and planning work.

You'll know what you're working towards from your first week.
Throughout, we look for the same core behaviours: concise communication, collaboration, problem solving, critical thinking, growth mindset, attention to detail, time management, and initiative.
Why Fospha
Real methodological depth. Bayesian attribution, MMM, geo lift testing, and causal inference are our day job, not a side project. You'll be working on all of it, not adjacent to it.
Ownership at the methodology level. At this level you're choosing the approach, not implementing someone else's choice.
Published career framework. No guessing what the next level requires or when you'll get there.
A team that reviews each other's work properly. Code review and methodology critique from people who care about getting the model right.
Direct client impact. The models you build and maintain drive real budget decisions at brands you'll recognise.

## Description & Requirements
The Bloomberg CTO Office is the future-looking technical arm of Bloomberg L.P. We envision, design, and guide the creation of our next generation infrastructure, hardware and applications that interface in all aspects of the company. We are passionate about what we do.
The Bloomberg Terminal is built on top of an internal technology platform that supports thousands of unique, mission critical financial applications with tens of millions of executions daily. The software development lifecycle (SDLC) tooling that underpins this platform enables hundreds of engineering teams to build, test, release, and operate software reliably, securely, and at scale.
This role will be responsible for reimagining how Bloomberg engineers build and deliver Terminal applications by shaping the next generation of SDLC tooling, workflows, and integrations needed to support AI-enabled development, increased automation, and future-ready engineering practices.
## What’s in it for you
We are looking for a Technical Product Manager to shape and execute the vision and roadmap for the SDLC tooling ecosystem that supports the Bloomberg Terminal. As a product manager, you will focus on the end-to-end developer experience across the software lifecycle, share ownership of the product roadmap for our internal development tools, and build new capabilities and integrations that empower engineering teams to move faster with confidence. You’ll be making decisions on how to evolve the develop, build, test, CI/CD, release, and product support workflows for the age of AI.
You will work in a group of other highly motivated product managers that work on a range of adjacent projects around application development and platform enablement. You will interact very closely with internal stakeholders across product, infrastructure, and engineering. * Define the next-generation Terminal application SDLC tooling strategy, setting principles for automation, consistency, and AI-assisted development

* Build strong relationships with key stakeholders, providing transparency into roadmaps, dependencies, and prioritization decisions
* Advocate for and project manage wide-spread adoption of application SDLC best practices and tooling across engineering teams; measure adoption and impact
* Own processes for intake, evaluation, and prioritization of new tooling and workflow requests from engineering teams

# Principal Agentic AI Engineer (Defence and Security)

You won’t work exclusively in that sector, but a genuine interest in it matters to us. ### **What you’ll be doing**
* Designing and implementing cutting-edge AI solutions to our clients’ problems, such as agentic AI that can search for, interpret and analyse information as well as plan and act to achieve a goal.

* Setting technical direction and acting as technical reviewer across the department, with your opinion sought by colleagues.
* Leading the development of proposals and costed work programmes, turning client problems into work we can win and deliver.
* Driving internal capability and demonstrators that keep us at the leading edge and open up new conversations with clients.
* Mentoring engineers and conducting technical interviews to help us recruit and grow strong people.
* Contributing to how the department works, improving our processes and technical standards.
### **What you can bring**
* 5+ years’ experience designing and delivering cutting edge AI solutions, including experience delivering agentic AI systems.
* Experience in assuring the quality of the output of AI systems and the technologies that help to achieve this.
* Experience collaborating with subject matter experts to create systems that are built on deep and specialist domain understanding.
* A strong undergraduate degree in a relevant technical subject, such as AI/machine learning, computer science, mathematics or physics.
* Strong Python and software engineering judgement.
* The ability to architect the technical approach on complex projects and to review the work of others, including working autonomously as the technical authority.
* Experience mentoring and developing engineers.
* Experience working with non-technical stakeholders for your work.
* Interest in working directly with clients and contributing to proposals and sales conversations.
* A genuine affinity for working in the defence and security sector.

Cambridge Consultants is a workplace where everyone is welcome. When the brightest minds come together and feel included, that’s when we develop the most important technology breakthroughs. We believe that diversity can only flourish when everyone feels involved and has a sense of belonging. We welcome and value all people regardless of their characteristics and encourage applications from all backgrounds and dimensions of society.

This engagement is strictly deliverable-focused. You will not be integrating into our day-to-day operations or managing staff. Instead, you will provide senior, independent judgment and set the overarching security strategy, which will be executed by our internal IT & Systems Manager. This deliberate separation between control definition and operational execution ensures the objective assurance required by our regulated client base.
### Key Deliverables & Outcomes
You will maintain full autonomy over how these outcomes are achieved as an external advisor, partnering with our Head of Engineering (acting SIRO) as your primary internal contact.
* Security Strategy & Roadmap: Define a clear, costed security strategy and sequenced improvement roadmap tailored to our evolving estate, threat landscape, and risk appetite.

* Board Reporting: Deliver periodic board-level reporting on organisational risk.
* Certification Direction: Deliver a formal, evidence-based recommendation on whether to pursue ISO 27001 or maintain Cyber Essentials Plus with a documented ISMS.
* Incident Framework: Design an incident response framework, testing plans, escalation pathways, and playbooks. (Note: Hands-on involvement in a live serious incident will be treated as a separate, ad-hoc call-off engagement).
* Client Assurance & Board Reporting: Mature the existing reusable security assurance evidence library for complex client due-diligence.

To ensure unambiguous B2B boundaries and maintain focus on strategic deliverables, the following operational execution remains firmly with Cambridge Spark:
* Execution & First Response: Hands-on operations (patching, endpoint hardening, configuration) and incident first-response are owned by our internal IT & Systems Manager.
* Routine Questionnaires: Standard client security questionnaires will be completed by the internal team against the standards and evidence library you define.

# Senior DevOps Engineer
London, UK
Catapult is building the future of sports performance technology, with a mission to **Unleash the Potential** of every athlete and team on earth. We don't just work in the sporting industry; we are actively changing it. Since 2006, our solutions have been leading the way in sports performance software, science, and data, in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing.
We work with over 5,000+ teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes’ health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics.
Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success.
### **WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT PLATFORM ENGINEERING**
We are looking for a talented and inquisitive Senior DevOps Engineer whose drive for learning and determination for continuous improvement aligns with our ambitious, fast-growing and transforming company. Based in our London office, you will be a key player in planning, designing, building and testing the features of our next-generation cloud platform that combines digital video assets, wearable data and athlete information to provide insights and analytics to coaching/support staff, sports scientists and athletes to assist in optimizing athlete performance. We believe that our customers deserve the best platform and we are on a mission to maximize and enhance their performance through delivering a high-quality experience. Our software and DevOps engineers match this ethos by taking responsibility for constantly improving productivity and development of self and be able to excel in a fast-paced environment with short project timelines from conception to deployment.
### **WHAT YOU’LL DO**
* Cloud & Platform Engineering
+ Infrastructure Automation & IaC: Own infrastructure provisioning and configuration management (e.g., Terraform, Ansible).
+ Observability & Reliability: Design, build and maintain logging, monitoring, alerting, and SLO/SLI frameworks to ensure system health and performance.
+ Software Delivery Pipelines: Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines to enable fast, safe, and repeatable software delivery.
+ Infrastructure Operations & Governance: Oversee the availability, scalability, and performance of cloud and on-prem infrastructure while ensuring all systems remain strictly aligned with corporate security standards and global regulatory compliance.
* Cloud Security
+ Cloud Security & Compliance: Ensure compliance with relevant compliance and regulatory frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR as applicable) and implement best practices cloud security controls.
+ Security Operation: Lead security first approach, collaborate with Security and IT teams to make sure our infrastructure is patched according to SLAs.
+ Application Security (AppSec): Collaborate with security teams to embed security controls into CI/CD pipelines and platform services.
* Technology leader
+ Architectural Roadmap & Vision: Define and execute the long-term technical roadmap for Catapult’s global cloud platform, evaluating emerging technologies (e.g., Serverless, AI-driven operations, and Containerization) to ensure the infrastructure remains cutting-edge, scalable, and best to used by our customers.
+ Technical Governance & Standards: Be a big contribution to infrastructure decisions, establishing "Golden Paths" and reusable Infrastructure as Code patterns that dictate how engineering teams deploy services while ensuring consistency across all environments.
+ Strategic Security & Compliance Integration: Architect and champion a "Shift-Left" security strategy, mandating the integration of automated security guardrails and compliance auditing into the core fabric of the CI/CD pipelines to protect athlete and video data globally.
### **WHAT YOU’LL NEED**
* Significant experience in DevOps, Site Reliability, Platform or Infrastructure Engineering, with tenure in technical leadership role.
* Deep expertise in the AWS cloud platform and associated security and compliance practices.
* Strong background in infrastructure automation (IaC), CI/CD pipelines, and observability tooling.
* Proven experience with big platform re-design, architecture of new cloud infrastructure systems based on software and business requirements.
* Solid understanding of AppSec principles, including integrating security into build and deploy pipelines.
* Experience managing hybrid environments, including traditional data centers and on-prem services.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; ability to influence across engineering, security, and finance.
* Experience with regulated industries (e.g., healthcare, fintech).
* Familiarity with multiple compliance frameworks (SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI-DSS).
### **WHAT YOUR SUCCESS WILL LOOK LIKE**
In 6 months time...
By the half-year mark, you will have moved beyond the onboarding phase to become the primary authority on Catapult’s infrastructure.
* Infrastructure Ownership: You will fully own the cloud infrastructure, having gained a deep understanding of all interconnected parts that support their athlete and video data services.
* Established Automation: You will have taken control of infrastructure provisioning and configuration management, ensuring that Terraform or Ansible are being used effectively for IaC.
* Observability Implementation: You will have designed and begun maintaining essential logging, monitoring, and SLO/SLI frameworks to ensure high system health and performance.
* Have a full understanding of Catapult’s products and the way we are working in order to be able to architect any new future existing or new product.
In 12 months time...
By the end of your first year, you will be driving the "next generation" of Catapult’s technology stack and leading cross-functional improvements.
* End to End Platform Ownership: You will take full accountability for the evolution of our production ecosystem, architecting a resilient, "deploy-anywhere" infrastructure that scales seamlessly with software demands and business growth.
* Optimized Delivery: You will have refined the CI/CD pipelines to a state where software delivery is consistently fast, safe, and repeatable across the engineering team.
* Integrated Security and Compliance: You will have transitioned the platform to a "security-first" architecture, successfully embedding automated AppSec controls and vulnerability scanning directly into the CI/CD pipelines.
* Cross-Departmental Influence: Your success will be reflected in your ability to influence stakeholders across engineering, security, and finance to drive technical and operational improvements.
**WHY CATAPULT?**
* We have amazing people. We promise you’ll work with some of the most ambitious, intelligent people in an exciting industry, and do some of the best work of your life.
* We encourage our people to engage in constructive, open, and honest communication to make Catapult extraordinary.
* We work in a collaborative yet challenging environment to consistently improve our performance, which in turn impacts our customers' performance.
* Our workforce spans more than 20 countries. You'll have the opportunity to work with people from multiple nationalities and cultures, and to build your global awareness.
* We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to improve. There is an unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better.
Whether you’re interested in sports or not, you’ll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams and athletes on the planet!
Research shows that while men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend only to apply when they check every box. So if you have what it takes, but don't meet every single point in our job ad, please still get in touch! We would love to have a chat and see if you could be a great addition to our team. We are building the future of sports performance. Our priority is to find the brightest talent who can add to our team culture, actively contribute, and be excited about what they do.

# Senior Intelligence Analyst, DPRK & China Focus

London Office; Aarhus Office
