OverviewApplication
The R&D team at Chainalysis is inspired by solving the hardest technical challenges and building products that establish trust in cryptocurrencies. We're a global organization that thrives on challenging work and doing it alongside exceptionally talented teammates. Our industry evolves rapidly, and our mission is to build a flexible, AI-driven platform that automates entity resolution, optimizes data labeling pipelines, and creates predictive models that identify illicit patterns before they escalate. Our data and solutions have been used to solve some of the world's most high-profile criminal cases and grow consumer access to cryptocurrency safely. Now, by pairing the industry's most trusted blockchain data with agents that reason, investigate, and act, we help our customers scale their workflows as the cryptocurrency economy becomes increasingly mainstream.
Chainalysis data has helped solve some of the world’s highest-profile criminal and national-security cases and made it safer for people everywhere to access crypto. The Global Intelligence Team produces the attribution at the heart of that data — connecting on-chain activity to the real-world entities behind it, across the global crypto ecosystem. It’s the intelligence data moat beneath every Chainalysis product, and what investigators, sanctions authorities, and national-security agencies rely on to follow the money and disrupt threats.
Few threats test that mission harder than North Korea and China. Through Lazarus Group, the DPRK has stolen billions in crypto — via exchange and DeFi hacks and IT-worker schemes — to fund its weapons program, then laundered it through mixers, cross-chain bridges, and Chinese OTC networks. China, in turn, sits at the center of global crypto money laundering — from guarantee marketplaces and underground banking to scam compounds, fentanyl vendors, and cartel-linked laundering. The two are deeply intertwined, and making that activity visible on-chain is one of the most consequential problems in crypto intelligence today.
As our **DPRK- and China-focused intelligence analyst** — the team’s subject-matter expert on North Korea and China — you’ll own that problem end to end. This is a depth role: while our analysts cover the breadth of the crypto-services ecosystem, you’ll go deep on a single, high-stakes domain — becoming the person, inside Chainalysis and increasingly across the industry, who understands how DPRK and Chinese actors use crypto and can prove it on-chain. You’ll own the attribution for their crypto footprint, map how these networks actually operate, turn that into finished intelligence customers act on, and be the expert voice representing Chainalysis on DPRK and China crypto threats.
**Who you’ll work with**
You’ll join a fast-moving, globally distributed team — analysts, threat-domain SMEs, data scientists, and engineers — collaborating across time zones, async and in real time. We move fast, hold each other to a high bar, and back each other up across regions. As the DPRK & China SME, you’ll be the single point of depth for the domain and a force multiplier for everyone working adjacent to it.
**In this role, you’ll:**
* **Own DPRK & China attribution end to end** — the threat-actor entities, their definitions, and the accounts, addresses, and infrastructure they operate: Lazarus Group and DPRK state-sponsored theft and laundering, DPRK IT-worker networks, Chinese-language OTC and underground-banking networks, guarantee marketplaces (e.g., Huione-style platforms), scam-compound and pig-butchering laundering infrastructure, fentanyl and precursor vendors, and Chinese money-laundering organizations.
* **Lead the attribution response to DPRK- and China-related sanctions events** — when OFAC or allied authorities designate DPRK actors, exchange-hacking units, or Chinese laundering networks, drive the rapid, high-visibility on-chain attribution that turns those designations into coverage in our data, often against the clock.
* **Map the networks on-chain** — trace how stolen and illicit funds move through mixers, cross-chain bridges, no-KYC swaps, OTC brokers, and off-ramps, following DPRK hack proceeds into and through Chinese laundering infrastructure, and keep that picture current as they adapt to pressure.
* **Produce finished intelligence** — advisory notes, customer and partner briefings, and contributions to flagship publications (the Crypto Crime Report and beyond) that make DPRK theft/laundering and Chinese money laundering legible and actionable.
* **Be the named external expert** — represent Chainalysis on DPRK and China crypto threats at conferences, on panels, with the press, and in briefings to public- and private-sector partners.
* **Help set the DPRK & China collection agenda** — surface what data we need on these networks and feed those requirements into our collection process and priority intelligence requirements; you direct collection for the domain, but it runs through the team’s apparatus and prioritization, not you alone.
* **Translate typologies into detection** — turn what you learn about DPRK and Chinese methods into guidance that our products and our customers can operationalize.
* **Build with AI** — design and tune the automation that scales your analysis and the team’s, and handle the hard cases automation can’t.
* **Level up the team** — raise the bar on DPRK, China, and money-laundering tradecraft broadly, and partner closely with analysts, other SMEs, data science, and engineering.
**We’re looking for candidates who have:**
* **Deep, demonstrable DPRK and/or China expertise** — real command of DPRK state-sponsored crypto operations (Lazarus Group, exchange and bridge hacks, IT-worker schemes) and/or Chinese-language money laundering, OTC and underground banking, guarantee marketplaces, and organized-crime finance. This is the core of the role, and we’ll expect you to show it.
* **On-chain tracing ability against DPRK/China targets** — direct experience following DPRK hack laundering or Chinese OTC/laundering networks on-chain, or deep DPRK/China threat-finance expertise paired with proven blockchain-tracing skill you can bring to bear here from day one.
* **A national-security or threat-finance background** — intelligence, sanctions, counter-threat-finance, or investigations, from the IC, Treasury/OFAC, law enforcement, the military, a think tank or research institution, or private-sector CTF/sanctions work.
* **Regional fluency** — a strong grasp of the DPRK and Chinese illicit-finance ecosystems and regional money-laundering flows. Mandarin and/or Korean language ability is a significant plus.
* **Elite potential and a proven track record** — exceptional aptitude, judgment, and work ethic; you’ve led hard problems end to end and you raise everyone around you.
* **Excellent writing and communication** — this is an outward-facing expert role; your intelligence has to land with analysts, customers, and senior audiences alike.
* **AI-forward instincts** — you build automation to scale your work and others’, not just use it.
* Comfort working with data; blockchain forensics experience strongly preferred.
* 5+ years of relevant analytic, intelligence, or threat-finance experience for a Senior hire; 8+ years and recognized domain authority for a Staff hire.
**You might also have:**
* Mandarin and/or Korean language ability.
* Direct experience with OFAC sanctions, designations, or the designation process — especially involving DPRK or Chinese entities.
* A record of published research or public speaking on DPRK crypto theft, Lazarus Group, or Chinese money laundering.

# Manager, Salesforce Administration
* Full-time
## Company Description
**Who We Are**
Cint is a pioneer in research technology (ResTech). Our customers use the Cint platform to post questions and get answers from real people to build business strategies, confidently publish research, accurately measure the impact of digital advertising, and more. The Cint platform is built on a programmatic marketplace, which is the world’s largest, with nearly 300 million respondents in over 150 countries who consent to sharing their opinions, motivations, and behaviours.
We are feeding the world’s curiosity!
## Job Description
**We are looking for an experienced Senior Salesforce Administrator to lead the day-to-day stewardship and continued evolution of our Salesforce ecosystem. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will guide and develop a team, own critical platform controls, and remain directly involved in the design, configuration, release and support of business-critical solutions.**
**The role is accountable for the reliability, security, scalability and maintainability of our Salesforce estate, with particular focus on Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and the APIs and integrations that connect Salesforce to Slack and other enterprise platforms. You will balance rapid delivery with strong governance, helping the organisation get more value from Salesforce without increasing operational or security risk.**
**What you will be accountable for**
**1. Team leadership and operating model**
* Lead and develop the Salesforce team, setting clear priorities, standards and expectations while creating an environment of ownership, learning and constructive challenge.
* Act as the senior escalation point, providing calm, evidence-led direction during incidents, complex delivery decisions and stakeholder conflicts.
* Shape the team operating model, including capacity planning, work allocation, skills development, recruitment support and the effective use of specialist partners.
* Build sustainable capability, through coaching, documentation, peer review and reducing dependency on individual team members or external suppliers.
**2. Salesforce platform ownership**
* Own the health and evolution of Sales Cloud, Service Cloud and Experience Cloud, ensuring the platform supports commercial, customer-service and operational processes effectively.
* Set and enforce platform standards, covering configuration, automation, data models, naming conventions, documentation, testing and technical debt.
* Remain hands-on where needed, including complex Flow automation, permissions, validation rules, objects, page layouts, Lightning pages, reports, dashboards, analytics and troubleshooting.
* Own day-to-day system administration, including user administration, joiner/mover/leaver processing, delegated administration and routine platform hygiene.
* Configure and maintain Experience Cloud portals, including external sharing rules, guest user access, community settings, and partner- or customer-facing experiences.
* Maintain a clear platform roadmap that balances strategic improvements, regulatory or security obligations, operational resilience, and business demand.
* Control platform lifecycle changes, including Salesforce seasonal releases, feature adoption, deprecations, sandbox strategy and environment management.
* Evaluate and deploy AppExchange packages, assessing them against business requirements, security review status, licence cost, support model and long-term maintainability.
**3. Integrations, APIs and operational monitoring**
* Own the operational oversight of Salesforce integrations, including interfaces with Slack and other core enterprise applications.
* Administer and maintain key business integrations.
* Establish effective Slack API monitoring to cover authentication failures, token or certificate expirations, API errors, rate limits, latency, message delivery failures, and unexpected usage patterns.
* Define monitoring and alerting standards, with meaningful thresholds, named owners, support runbooks, escalation paths and service-level expectations.
* Protect integration reliability by overseeing connected apps, OAuth scopes, named credentials, integration users, event-driven services and API consumption.
* Lead incident response and problem management, ensuring root causes are understood, corrective actions are completed and recurring failures are designed out.
**4. Security, access and control posture**
* Own the Salesforce security posture, working with Security, IT and Risk teams to maintain proportionate, auditable controls.
* Design and maintain the org-wide sharing and security architecture, including organisation-wide defaults (OWD), role hierarchy, sharing rules, permission sets and permission-set groups, and field-level security.
* Apply least-privilege access, with appropriate segregation of duties and regular remediation of accumulated or excessive entitlements.
* Govern identities and privileged access, including SSO and MFA (working knowledge of Okta or a comparable identity provider), service accounts, integration users, delegated administration and joiner/mover/leaver controls.
* Lead regular security audits and access reviews to evidence least-privilege compliance and drive timely remediation of findings.
* Partner with IT and Security on platform audits and compliance, including SOC 2 and GDPR obligations, control evidence and audit response.
* Review platform risk signals, such as login anomalies, API usage, configuration changes, installed packages and connected-app behaviour, using the monitoring capabilities available in the Salesforce estate.
* Protect sensitive information through sound data-access design, retention controls, masking or anonymisation in non-production environments, and responsible vendor access.
**5. Licensing, certificates and lifecycle management**
* Optimise licence usage and forecasting across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud and Experience Cloud, including reharvesting, right-sizing and renewal input.
* Monitor and manage certificate lifecycles, including SSL and SAML signing certificates, to prevent avoidable authentication or integration outages.
* Manage connected app and OAuth lifecycles, with a maintained inventory, named owners, expiry tracking and proactive renewal ahead of failure.
* Provide clear cost and entitlement visibility, so licence, package and integration spend is understood, challenged and aligned to realised value.
**6. Delivery, release and DevOps**
* Own a transparent and prioritised delivery backlog, working with business stakeholders to clarify outcomes, value, dependencies and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain disciplined release management, with source control, peer review, automated or repeatable deployment, regression testing, rollback planning and release communications.
* Execute version-controlled releases through GitHub, using branch strategy, pull requests, peer approval and traceable change history as the standard route to production.
* Maintain documentation for all configuration and change management, so the estate remains understandable, auditable and supportable by more than one person.
* Improve platform support, using clear service measures, triage processes, knowledge articles, problem records and trend analysis.
* Manage technical debt deliberately, making risks and trade-offs visible and ensuring remediation is planned alongside new demand.
* Partner effectively with vendors, holding delivery partners to clear outcomes, quality standards, documentation and knowledge-transfer commitments.
**7. Data quality and platform insight**
* Champion trustworthy Salesforce data, including ownership, validation, duplicate management, integration reconciliation and remediation of recurring data-quality issues.
* Provide actionable platform insight, using dashboards and regular reporting on adoption, automation failures, API consumption, incidents, release quality, access risk and technical debt.
* Support sound architecture decisions, challenging unnecessary customisation and promoting maintainable, scalable use of standard Salesforce capabilities and enterprise-level data modelling.
**8. AI, Agentforce and emerging capabilities**
* Help evaluate and safely adopt Agentforce, Salesforce AI capabilities and adjacent enterprise AI tools where they can improve employee or customer outcomes.
* Support responsible AI governance, including data access, grounding, human oversight, prompt and agent testing, monitoring, auditability and change control.
* Contribute practical experience with Claude or comparable models, especially where AI services interact with Salesforce, Slack, knowledge content, workflows or customer data.
* Separate experimentation from production readiness, ensuring AI-enabled solutions meet the same security, reliability and support standards as other business-critical capabilities.
**Leadership behaviours**
* Service-minded ownership: you treat Salesforce as a critical business service, not simply a collection of projects.
* Wise pragmatism: you balance speed, usability, maintainability, cost and risk rather than optimising for only one dimension.
* Constructive challenge: you can say no, or not yet, with clear evidence and a practical route forward.
* Calm accountability: you take ownership when problems arise without creating blame or hiding uncomfortable facts.
* Enabling leadership: you give people clarity and support while building their confidence, judgement and independence.
* Clear communication: you make technical issues understandable and keep stakeholders informed before uncertainty becomes surprise.
**Key working relationships**
**The role will work closely with Sales, Revenue Operations, Customer Service, Finance, Security, Enterprise Architecture, IT Operations, Data and Integration teams, as well as Salesforce and specialist implementation partners.**
## Qualifications
**Essential**
* 7+ years as a Salesforce Administrator in large, multi-team environments, with substantial hands-on responsibility for administration, configuration and operational support in a complex production environment.
* Salesforce Administrator certification (required).
* Proven people leadership, including line management, coaching, performance support, work prioritisation and development of Salesforce administrators or platform specialists.
* Deep practical knowledge of Sales Cloud and Service Cloud, including their security, automation, data and service-management implications.
* Deep Salesforce security expertise, covering organisation-wide defaults, role hierarchies, sharing models, permission sets, field-level security, identity, privileged access, connected apps and audit controls.
* Hands-on Experience Cloud capability, including external sharing models, guest access and community configuration.
* Proven Salesforce DevOps and change-management experience using GitHub, including version-controlled deployment workflows, pull-request review and release governance.
* Experience operating API-led integrations, including monitoring, troubleshooting, authentication, limits, failure handling and coordination across technical teams.
* Experience managing SSL and authentication certificates and maintaining integration health.
* Strong declarative delivery capability, particularly Flow, data modelling, validation, Lightning configuration, reporting and environment management.
* Sound release and change-management experience, including sandbox strategy, source control, testing, deployment governance and production support.
* Confident stakeholder management, with the ability to translate between commercial priorities, user needs, technical constraints and risk.
* Strong solution and design judgement, with a good understanding of platform architecture and enterprise-level data modelling.
**Desirable**
* Salesforce Advanced Administrator certification (preferred), or other relevant credentials such as Platform App Builder, Service Cloud Consultant or an appropriate Agentforce/AI accreditation.
* Experience administering Ironclad, Qualtrics and Slack CRM / Sales Elevate, or directly comparable CLM, survey and Slack-CRM tooling.
* Agentforce or Salesforce AI experience, including agent design, grounding, guardrails, evaluation or operational monitoring.
* Experience with Claude or other enterprise AI platforms, particularly in governed, data-sensitive business workflows.
* Experience with Slack platform capabilities and APIs, including enterprise integrations, apps, workflows, authentication and observability.

## Creative Strategist job description
**Our Company**At Quantum, we connect global brands with high-intent consumers. We turn intent into action and complexity into clarity.
Our Mission is clear, to help smarter, faster buying decisions. Our vision, to be the world’s most used digital comparison service, delivering value and simplicity to millions.
We drive growth through data-driven affiliate marketing built for performance from day one. Every campaign is measurable, optimised in real time, and designed to scale.
With in-house tech, full-stack analytics, and a compliance-first mindset, we give our partners an edge. We drive confident decisions and growth in regulated and high-growth sectors. We’ve helped ambitious brands grow faster, smarter, and globally.
## **The Role**
Our Performance Marketing team is growing, and we’re looking for a Creative Strategist to join us in London.
This is a performance role for someone who lives at the intersection of creative, culture and data. You’ll work across all of ur markets and verticals, turning audience insight, platform trends and performance data into creative that drives measurable growth.
You’ll have real ownership. We want someone who can help us build a best-in-class creative testing engine: finding the insight, developing the hypothesis, shaping the concept, getting it produced, analysing what happened and making the next test better.
We’re not looking for someone to make ads prettier. We’re looking for someone obsessed with understanding why people stop, click and convert and who wants to test those ideas at speed.
You’ll work closely with our Performance Marketing and Creative teams, as well as creators and external partners. You’ll also be hands-on: comfortable briefing polished production when it matters, but equally happy picking up a phone or opening CapCut and getting a lo-fi prototype live when speed matters more.
**Key Responsibilities**
* **Own creative experimentation** - build and run the creative testing roadmap across Meta, TikTok, Snap and emerging channels, taking ideas from hypothesis → brief → production → analysis → learning.
* **Obsess over the customer** - mine reviews, Reddit, competitor activity, customer research and performance data to understand the problems, motivations and objections behind the click.
* **Turn insight into ideas** - develop personas, hooks, angles and concepts across different stages of customer awareness, rather than endlessly iterating the same offer-led creative.
* **Build our UGC and lo-fi engine** - source and brief creators, shoot or prototype content yourself, edit when required and help us dramatically increase the diversity and velocity of what we test.
* **Live in the platforms** - understand what feels native to Meta, TikTok and Snap, monitor trends and competitors continuously, and turn relevant opportunities into testable concepts quickly.
* **Turn data back into creative** - use metrics such as hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CVR, CAC and win rate to understand *why* something worked, not simply whether it did.
* **Make our learning compound** - maintain a clear testing and insights system, run creative retros and make sure successful patterns travel across channels, geographies and verticals.
* **Use AI aggressively and intelligently** - apply generative AI, creative intelligence and production tools to accelerate research, ideation, prototyping and iteration without replacing the thinking behind the work.
* **Raise the creative capability of the whole team** - bring outside thinking into Quantum, coach marketers on stronger creative briefs and work as the bridge between Performance Marketing and Creative.
**About You**
* You’ve spent 2+ years in creative strategy, performance creative, paid social or a closely related growth role, ideally within DTC, affiliate, agency or another performance-led environment.
* You understand paid social commercially. You know the difference between content that gets attention and creative that ultimately acquires customers profitably.
* You’re hands-on with UGC and lo-fi production. You can find creators, write scripts, brief effectively and use tools such as CapCut, Canva or similar to get an idea into market yourself.
* You’re genuinely plugged into social platforms, culture and creative trends. You notice formats, hooks and behaviours before somebody sends you a deck about them.
* You’re analytically curious. You’re comfortable interrogating performance data and translating it into the next creative hypothesis.
* You have strong creative and messaging instincts - able to take messy customer insight and distil it into one simple, compelling idea.
* You naturally experiment. You’d rather test a good hypothesis this week than debate the perfect answer for a month.
* You’re excited by AI and emerging creative technology and are constantly looking for ways to make yourself and the people around you faster and better.
* Experience in iGaming, finance, subscription or another regulated/performance-led vertical is useful, but not essential.
* And finally, no ego. We want someone curious, ambitious and collaborative who gets excited by finding out they were wrong almost as much as finding a winner.

* Travel Insurance
* Competitive Base Salary
* Company Bonus Scheme
* Paid for AI Subscription (Claude / ChatGPT / Gemini)
* Market-Leading Training Programme
* Recognition & Reward Scheme
* Annual Company Conference
* Regular Happy Hours & Team Lunches
* Free Coffee, Drinks & Snacks

# Data Literacy Capability Coach (DP3/DL3)
**Data Capability Coach** (DP3/DL3)
**Reports to**: Delivery Director
**Location**: UK, Remote, with national travel as required
**About Corndel**
Corndel is a unique, multi award-winning UK management and technology training provider that focuses on delivering the highest quality programmes throughout an employee’s career. We partner with some of the UK’s largest and most exciting businesses to help drive organisational and personal performance through transformational learning.
Our mission is to inspire people to think bigger and shape the future, and our vision is to expand minds and create a world of unlimited potential. We are one of the fastest growing companies in the UK and provide a great platform for proactive and motivated individuals to take the next exciting step in their career. You will be joining an organisation with a fun, entrepreneurial and supportive environment, providing fulfilling work and an open, informal culture.
**Purpose of the Role**
The DP3 Coach (Data Driven Professional & Leader) exists to help learners **build confidence in using data to inform decisions, generate insight, and drive tangible business impact**.
In this role, you will coach, mentor, and teach learners on Corndel’s Level 3 data technician programmes, supporting them to move from data awareness to confident, practical application. You will help learners understand not just *how* to work with data, but *why it matters*, how to communicate insight clearly, and how to apply sound judgement when working with data in real organisational contexts.
You will combine strong data capability with a coaching mindset — empowering learners to take ownership of their development, challenge assumptions, and apply data ethically and effectively in their roles.
**Core Responsibilities**
**Learner Coaching & Development**
* Manage a caseload of learners, building trusted relationships through high quality coaching, mentoring, and structured teaching.
* Deliver engaging one to one sessions and workshops that make data concepts accessible, relevant, and practical.
* Empower learners to develop confidence with data by encouraging curiosity, critical thinking, and reflection.
* Create an inclusive, psychologically safe learning environment where learners feel comfortable asking questions, testing ideas, and learning from mistakes.
**Data Literacy & Insight**
* Support learners to develop core data skills, including data preparation, analysis, visualisation, and interpretation.
* Coach learners to use tools such as Excel, Power BI, and related platforms to generate meaningful insights and communicate them clearly.
* Help learners connect data analysis to real business questions, decision making, and outcomes.
* Model integrity and good judgement in how data is used, interpreted, and communicated, including awareness of data quality, bias, and ethical considerations.
**Progress, Quality & Outcomes**
* Guide learners through programme milestones, assessments, and portfolio development, ensuring consistent progress and timely completion.
* Support learners to produce high quality, compliant evidence that genuinely reflects their capability and workplace impact.
* Engage constructively with learners’ line managers to align learning with organisational priorities and support progression.
* Take ownership for quality and compliance, balancing learner support with high standards and clear expectations.
**Collaboration & Continuous Improvement**
* Work collaboratively with colleagues across Operations, Product, and Curriculum to deliver a consistent and high quality learner experience.
* Proactively identify opportunities to improve delivery approaches, learner engagement, and outcomes.
* Stay curious and committed to continuous development, keeping up to date with data tools, practices, and ways of working that enhance learning.
**Technical Skills & Experience**
**Essential**
* Practical experience working with data in a professional context.
* Strong working knowledge of Excel, including formulas, pivot tables, data validation, and analysis techniques.
* Knowledge of Power Query and how it can be used for data cleansing, importing data and automation of repetitive tasks.
* Experience using Power BI or similar tools to analyse data and create clear, intuitive visualisations.
* Confidence using Microsoft tools such as Teams, Word, and PowerPoint to support communication and learning.
* Experience coaching, mentoring, teaching, or facilitating learning in a professional environment.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain data concepts clearly to learners with varied confidence levels.
**Desirable**

**Senior Clinical Statistical Programmer (Portfolio Development / Biometrics / Programming)**
**The Role**
CSL is looking for a Senior Programmer to take technical ownership of one or two clinical trials from first line of code to final submission package. This is a hands-on statistical programming role with real authority attached to it: you'll be the person a study team turns to when the data needs to hold up under regulatory scrutiny, and the person who decides how a dataset gets built, not just who builds it. You'll work alongside statisticians, data managers, medical writers and regulatory colleagues as a peer, not a downstream resource — reading protocols and SAPs early enough to shape how a study's analysis gets structured, then seeing that structure through to submission-ready SDTM and ADaM datasets, TFLs, and supporting documentation.
*Hybrid Based (3 days a week onsite) in Maidenhead*
**Why It Matters**
Clinical data is only as useful as the programming behind it is trustworthy. Every regulatory decision downstream — every safety signal caught or missed, every submission accepted or queried — traces back to whether the datasets and outputs were built right the first time. This role sits at that pressure point. You're not just executing specifications; you're often the one writing them, catching the ambiguity in a protocol before it becomes a data problem three months later, and making the judgment calls that keep a study's analysis both scientifically sound and audit-ready.
**What You'll Be Responsible For**
You'll lead end-to-end programming for your assigned studies — in-house or outsourced — spanning the full clinical development lifecycle from study setup through analysis, reporting, and regulatory submission. That means building and validating datasets and outputs yourself where the work is done internally, and holding CRO-delivered work to the same bar where it isn't. You'll also be a technical reference point for less experienced programmers, and a contributor to how the wider programming function does its work.
· Serve as lead programmer for one or two clinical trials, interpreting protocols, SAPs, data management plans, and CRF specifications to drive study setup and analysis
· Design and validate SDTM and ADaM datasets, tables, figures, and listings, in partnership with study statisticians
· Review and take ownership of CRO-produced deliverables, ensuring submission-ready quality before they go further
· Lead specification and delivery of integrated analyses (e.g. ISS/ISE) and associated outputs when not handled by a CRO
· Mentor other programmers on internal processes and standards, and contribute to departmental tools and process improvements
· Take on ad hoc analytical work — regulatory query responses, exploratory analyses, publication support — as studies require it
**Experience Required**
· Experience of programming in pharmaceutical, biotech, CRO, or clinical research settings
· Strong SAS proficiency (Base/Macro/Stat/Graph); familiarity with R or other languages is a plus
· Working knowledge of current CDISC standards — CDASH, SDTM, ADaM, define.xml
· Track record of producing and validating submission-ready TFLs and datasets, including ad hoc analytical requests
· Experience supporting regulatory submissions (FDA required; PMDA, NMPA, or EMA experience a plus)
· Comfort working with external vendors and CRO-managed data
· BSc in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics or a related field — equivalent experience and certifications will also be considered

## **Job Description**
Denodo is looking for an ambitious and hands-on BDR/SDR Manager – EMEA to lead, coach and develop our Business Development/ Sales Development organization across key European markets. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced BDR/SDR Team Leader ready to step into their first management role, or an existing BDR/SDR Manager with up to approximately three years of management experience who is looking for broader international responsibility.
The successful candidate will lead a team responsible for creating qualified sales pipeline across the UK, France, DACH, the Nordics and Eastern Europe, working closely with Account Executives, Marketing, Sales Leadership and Revenue Operations. The role combines people leadership, coaching, pipeline generation, performance management and sales development strategy.
We are looking for someone who is hands-on, commercially minded and passionate about developing people. You don't need to have managed a large organization. We are particularly interested in leaders who have demonstrated success in sales development and are ready to take the next step in their leadership career.
You will play a key role in building Denodo's future sales organization, with the BDR/SDR team serving both as a significant source of qualified pipeline and as an important talent pipeline for future Account Executives and other sales roles.
## **Job Responsibilities & Duties**
Lead & Develop the BDR/SDR Team
* Lead, coach and motivate a high-performing BDR/SDR team across multiple European markets.
* Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, learning and continuous improvement.
* Set clear individual and team objectives aligned to pipeline and revenue goals.
* Conduct regular 1:1s, team meetings, performance reviews and development planning.
* Conduct call reviews, role plays and coaching sessions to improve individual performance.
* Identify high-potential team members and support their career development.
* Develop BDR/SDRs as a key internal talent pool for future Account Executive and other sales roles.
* Support recruitment, onboarding and retention of high-quality BDR/SDR talent.
Build & Improve Pipeline
* Own BDR/SDR pipeline generation across inbound, outbound and account-based sales development activities.
* Work closely with Account Executives to identify and prioritize target accounts.
* Develop effective outbound strategies for enterprise accounts and buying groups.
* Ensure the team is focused on creating quality opportunities and pipeline, not simply maximizing activity.
* Continuously improve prospecting approaches, messaging, sequences and qualification.
* Monitor conversion rates throughout the funnel and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Ensure effective handoff and alignment between BDRs/SDRs and Account Executives.
Coach Through Data
* Use Salesforce and other sales technologies to understand team and individual performance.
* Analyze activity, conversion, pipeline and meeting data to identify trends, opportunities and risks.
* Turn data into clear coaching actions and measurable improvement plans.
* Establish and track appropriate BDR/SDR KPIs.
* Forecast BDR/SDR-generated pipeline accurately and proactively communicate risks and opportunities.
* Provide regular performance insight to Sales Leadership.
Partner Across Sales & Marketing
* Work closely with Account Executives to ensure BDR/SDR activity is aligned with territory and revenue priorities.
* Partner with Marketing on campaigns, events, content and demand-generation initiatives.
* Provide feedback to Marketing on campaign quality, messaging and prospect response.
* Work with Sales and Product Marketing to ensure BDR/SDR messaging clearly communicates Denodo's value proposition.
* Support account-based marketing and coordinated sales plays across strategic accounts.
* Share market feedback and competitive insights with the wider organization.
Continuously Improve
* + Develop and implement BDR/SDR best practices across prospecting, qualification and meeting generation.
+ Test and implement new approaches to outbound prospecting, messaging and engagement.
+ Improve processes, technology and workflows to increase productivity and effectiveness.
+ Help evolve the BDR/SDR operating model as Denodo continues to grow across Europe.
+ Bring new ideas, energy and a continuous-improvement mindset to the organization.
## **Desired Skills & Experience**
We are looking for a people-focused sales development leader with strong BDR/SDR foundations.
You may currently be:
* A BDR/SDR Team Leader ready for your first Manager role
* A Senior BDR/SDR with demonstrable leadership or mentoring experience
* A BDR/SDR Manager with up to approximately three years of management experience
* A Business Development professional who has successfully stepped into people leadership
What matters most is your ability to develop people, create pipeline and build a high-performance culture.
You should have:
* Proven experience in BDR, SDR, inside sales or business development.
* Experience in B2B technology, SaaS, enterprise software or a similarly complex sales environment.
* Experience coaching, mentoring or managing BDR/SDR professionals.
* A track record of achieving or exceeding sales development or pipeline targets.
* Strong understanding of outbound prospecting and enterprise account engagement.
* Experience working with Account Executives and sales teams to convert BDR/SDR activity into qualified pipeline.
* A data-driven approach to managing performance.
* Experience using Salesforce or a comparable CRM.
* Excellent communication, coaching and interpersonal skills.
* Confidence engaging with senior stakeholders and enterprise decision-makers.
* A hands-on approach — comfortable getting involved in the detail as well as setting direction.
* Resilience, curiosity and a genuine desire to continuously improve.
* The ability to operate effectively across different cultures and European markets.
Language Skills
* Fluent English is essential.
* Fluency in French or German would be highly advantageous given the geographical scope of the role.
* Additional European languages are also welcome.
**Desired Experience**
* Approximately 3–6 years' experience in BDR/SDR, inside sales, business development or sales development, including some leadership, coaching or people-management experience.
* Experience within enterprise software, SaaS, data, cloud, cybersecurity, infrastructure or other B2B technology markets is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience building pipeline through outbound prospecting.
* Experience managing or supporting both inbound and outbound BDR/SDR motions.
* Experience with enterprise accounts and complex buying groups.
* Experience with Salesforce or a comparable CRM.
* Experience with sales engagement, prospecting, intent or data platforms is desirable.
* Strong understanding of sales development KPIs, funnel analytics and forecasting.
* Experience implementing structured coaching and performance-management practices.
* Bachelor's degree preferred, but equivalent professional experience will be considered.

* Own extraction and matching across AR, AP, expenses and more. Invoices, purchase orders, remittances, bill, receipts, card transactions. Unstructured PDFs, photos, and structured e-invoicing feeds.
* Own confidence scoring and threshold calibration. Auto-accept vs escalate is the highest-leverage decision in the product. Too loose and we post bad entries to a real ledger. Too tight and the platform's customers do the work themselves.
* Solve cold start. New platforms go live in days with almost no labelled data for their formats, chart of accounts, or policies. Making that work without a bespoke build per client is an open problem, and it's yours.
* Build the evaluation infrastructure. Gold sets, regression suites, per-platform accuracy tracking. We find out when something regresses before a client does.
* Build the correction flywheel. Every fix an SMB makes inside a partner's product is a label. Turn that into measurable accuracy gains.
* Turn written rules into executable logic. Expense policies and approval rules, interpreted, applied, and explainable.
* Partner directly with the founders on where the accuracy bar sits and what we ship next.

* You've built evaluation harnesses and treat accuracy as an engineering problem rather than a judgement call.
* Experience in a domain where being wrong is expensive. Fintech, compliance, legal, insurance, healthcare.
* Genuinely autonomous: take an ambiguous accuracy problem, make the call, ship the improvement.
* Comfortable operating without structure, and creating it.
Bonus: document AI (OCR, layout parsing, entity extraction), AP/AR or accounting systems knowledge, e-invoicing, or time at an API-led fintech or infrastructure company.
### Who this is for
People who want to own the number rather than present it. Builders who've put AI into production where it had to be right. People who make the call rather than wait to be told.

* Real production AI systems with real money on the other side, not experiments.

Automotive Dealer Network Manager – Global Partners

DRVN Automotive Group is seeking an experienced Dealer Network Manager to manage, support and develop a global network of independent dealer partners representing DRVN brands across international markets. The role is responsible for dealer performance, brand compliance, commercial growth, customer satisfaction and effective communication between DRVN and its appointed representatives.
Acting as the primary relationship owner for an assigned portfolio of dealer partners, the successful candidate will drive sales performance, strengthen dealer capability and support international network expansion while protecting the brand’s reputation and ensuring a consistently premium customer experience.
Overview of the Role
* Salary: £100,000.00
* Holidays: 33 days includes Bank Holidays
* Salary Sacrifice Pension
* Private Healthcare/Life Insurance
* Employee Referral Scheme
* Location: Scotland – Perth Area
* Reports to: Commercial Director, Managing Director or Head of Global Sales
Company Overview
The DRVN Automotive Group is a sector-leading automotive group, specialising in the design, manufacture, and distribution of luxury automotive brands. Recognised globally for our commitment to innovation, quality, and engineering, we are proudly centred around delivering a world-class customer experience.
Our recent launch of Evoluto, along with the reimagination of some of Ford Motor Company’s most historically significant icons including the RS200 and MK1 Escort places DRVN at the forefront of modern automotive excellence.
Key Responsibilities
Dealer Relationship Management
* Serve as the primary point of contact and relationship owner for a portfolio of international dealer partners.
* Build strong, trusted relationships with dealer owners and senior management teams.
* Lead regular business reviews to assess sales, pipeline, customer experience, brand compliance and agreed improvement actions.
* Support dealers in achieving agreed sales, marketing and customer-journey objectives.
* Manage dealer onboarding and appointment processes, ensuring new partners are operationally ready and aligned with DRVN standards.
Dealer Performance and Development
* Monitor dealer sales performance against targets, forecasts and market potential.
* Analyse market trends, dealer activity, pipeline health, conversion rates and forward order demand.
* Develop and track targeted action plans for underperforming dealers and identified customer-experience gaps.
* Provide clear performance reporting, risks and recommendations to senior leadership.
* Share best practice across the dealer network and promote continuous improvement.
Brand and Compliance Management
* Ensure dealer adherence to brand standards, policies and operating requirements.
* Conduct dealer audits and structured performance assessments, documenting findings and agreed corrective actions.
* Support the implementation of new products, campaigns and strategic initiatives across the network.
* Monitor compliance with appointed representative agreements and commercial obligations, escalating material concerns where required.
* Protect brand integrity across all physical, digital and customer-facing touchpoints.
Sales and Commercial Support
* Support dealers with vehicle allocation, ordering, client specifications and delivery coordination.
* Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Concierge, Operations, Finance and other internal teams to ensure efficient delivery of products and services.
* Maintain accurate visibility of dealer forecasts, sales pipelines, risks and commercial opportunities.
* Provide commercial insight and evidence-based recommendations to senior leadership.
Training and Capability Development
* Coordinate dealer training programmes covering products, systems, sales processes, customer experience and brand standards.
* Support dealer staff development and knowledge enhancement, addressing capability gaps identified through reviews and audits.
* Deliver presentations and workshops remotely and in person.
* Ensure dealer teams are equipped to represent DRVN confidently and provide a premium customer experience.
Customer Experience
* Promote consistent customer-service standards throughout the dealer network.
* Review customer feedback, dealer satisfaction metrics and Net Promoter Score performance to identify trends and priorities.
* Support the timely resolution of escalated customer issues involving dealer partners.
* Develop and drive initiatives that improve customer retention, satisfaction and advocacy.
Network Expansion
* Identify opportunities for new dealer appointments in priority markets and territories.
* Participate in dealer selection, due diligence and appointment processes.
* Support contract negotiations and commercial discussions in collaboration with relevant internal stakeholders.
* Contribute to market-entry strategies and international growth plans.
* Track new-dealer launch readiness and early performance to support successful onboarding.

* Dealer sales performance against targets and agreed forecasts.
* Pipeline quality, conversion performance and forecast accuracy.
* Dealer satisfaction, engagement and completion of agreed business-review actions.
* Compliance with brand standards, policies and commercial obligations.
* Customer satisfaction, retention and Net Promoter Score performance.
* New dealer appointments, launch readiness and successful onboarding.
* Market penetration and network growth within assigned territories.
Essential Skills and Experience
* Relevant experience within an automotive OEM, distributor, importer or dealer-network management environment.
* Proven experience managing and developing independent dealer or franchise networks.
* Strong commercial acumen and relationship-management skills, with the ability to balance partner needs and brand requirements.
* Ability to analyse sales performance, pipelines, forecasts and market trends and convert insight into practical action plans.
* Excellent communication, presentation, influencing and negotiation skills.
* International business experience and confidence working across different markets and cultures.
* Strong organisation, judgement and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Willingness and ability to travel internationally as required.
Desirable Experience
* Experience within a premium, luxury, performance or niche automotive brand.
* Knowledge of dealer agreements, appointed representative arrangements and franchise operations.
* Experience launching new products, appointing dealers or developing new international markets.
* Additional language skills.

* Relationship management and stakeholder engagement.
* Commercial acumen and strategic thinking.
* Dealer development and performance management.
* Influencing and negotiation.
* Brand management and customer focus.
* Problem solving and sound judgement.
* Cross-cultural communication.

**About the role**
FDEs are how Duvo brings AI to life inside our customers. You sit at the front line, map their workflows on the Duvo platform, improve the underlying processes, and turn the result into running agents that deliver tangible business impact. Scoping, build, debug, handover, expansion. You own the customer outcome end to end and you own the relationship that goes with it.
You won't write the core product. You will write the glue: integration scripts, agent configurations, data transformations, prototypes, whatever it takes to get an agent running against a customer's actual systems. You'll spend real time inside their stack and inside their team.
If you like the messy middle between AI, process, and customer, this is the role.
You will be deployed directly with our clients, mostly in onsite/hybrid mode of work, you will travel a lot.
**Location.** This role is UK-based. You'll need to be living in the UK, or relocating there before you start, and able to travel to client sites from there.
**What you'll do**
* Embed with customers from kickoff through go-live and beyond
* Map customer workflows directly on the Duvo platform and decide what's worth automating, what's worth fixing first, and what's blocked
* Improve the underlying processes where it matters. Don't automate broken flows, redesign them
* Translate business logic into agent behavior: actions, decision rules, exception paths, fallbacks
* Configure and ship agents against real customer systems (ERPs, portals, spreadsheets, email, custom tools)
* Write integration code, scripts, and prototypes when the situation calls for it
* Debug live agents in production environments and iterate quickly
* Build and own the working relationship with customer stakeholders, from operators to sponsors
* Run working sessions, hold your own with technical counterparts, and earn the right to push back
* Make AI real for the customer. Move them from pilot energy to measurable business outcomes
* Capture reusable patterns, templates, and runbooks so the next deployment is faster
* Send recurring workflow patterns back to Product and Engineering as real signal
**What success looks like**
* Multiple agents in production across clients, with measurable business impact
* Customers point to specific KPIs that moved because of your work
* Customers treat you as a trusted operator and want you in the room
* Process improvements you drove are visible in the customer's day-to-day, not just in the agent
* Transformation Managers want you on their hardest accounts
* Accounts you own expand because the relationship and the results are both there
* Each deployment is faster than the last because you've left behind reusable assets
**Who you are**
*Experience*
5+ years in roles where you've shipped against real customer environments. We're prioritizing AI-native candidates: people who have been building, deploying, or operating AI and agentic systems in customer-facing settings, not adjacent to them.
Likely backgrounds:
* Forward-deployed engineering or solutions engineering at an AI-first company
* Applied AI / ML engineering with direct customer exposure
* Technical consulting on AI or automation projects where you owned delivery and the client relationship
* Operations or product roles where you've built and shipped AI-powered tooling against messy real-world systems
Retail, e-commerce, or CPG background is a strong plus. Fluency in any operational domain (supply chain, procurement, category management, merchandising, finance ops, supplier management, warehousing) helps you ramp faster on customer accounts. What matters most is that you can pick up a new business quickly, see how to improve it, and build something with AI that actually works.
*Skills*
* Hands-on with modern AI tooling: LLMs, agent frameworks, prompt engineering, evals, MCP, retrieval
* Strong systems thinking and engineering judgment
* Process design instinct. You can spot waste, redundancy, and bad handoffs and propose something better
* Comfortable in code-adjacent territory: SQL, Python or JS scripting, APIs, JSON, webhooks, light data work
* Familiarity with ERPs and enterprise stacks is a plus
* Able to lead a working session, manage a stakeholder, push back on bad scope, and explain trade-offs without hiding behind jargon
* Fluent English. Additional European languages are a plus
*Mindset*
* Bias to ship
* Comfortable with ambiguity, half-built systems, and changing requirements
* Low ego, high standards
* Customer-obsessed. You build trust by being useful, not by being polished
* Commercially aware and able to help customers believe in what you're building
* Honest about what's working and what isn't
**What we offer**
* A small, sharp team that values ownership and candor
* Real product and culture leverage from day one
* Customer-facing impact: your work ships and moves the business
* Competitive comp including equity
* Option to trade cash for equity
## How we hire
We respect your time and aim to move fast:
1. **Screening call.**
2. **Hiring Manager call (online, 30 min).** We'll talk about you, how you think and whether there's mutual fit.
3. **Case study ( ~4 hours).** Ship something small to production with us and see how we work together. Fully compensated
4. **Final interview (online, 30min)**
We're not looking for perfection. We're looking for someone who can walk into a customer's operation, figure out what matters, fix the process, ship the agent, and turn AI into outcomes the business can feel.

Who we are
Enterprise teams still copy data between systems all day. Work gets stuck in emails, legacy UIs, and handoffs. That chaos is costly, slow, and risky.
We're a fast-moving team on a mission to end it for good. Traction is strong and we're solving real problems for real customers, but to win, we need exceptional talent. We stay humble, do the work, and let results speak.
What we are building
We're building the AI operations platform for retail and CPG enterprises—a horizontal platform where AI agents execute end-to-end work across UIs and APIs with governance built in.
Where copilots stop, Duvo finishes the job. Business users specify the outcome; agents plan, act, request approvals on exceptions, and learn with every run. We start with a retail wedge (category management, supply chain, finance ops) where ROI is obvious, then expand to adjacent functions and sectors.
Velocity is our moat: ship fast, iterate faster, compound learning.
The role
You will own end-to-end product features—from user-facing UI to API to data to deployment. You're the kind of engineer who connects technical choices to customer outcomes and ships with high velocity under ambiguity.
Your unit of ownership: user-facing features and the systems behind them, delivered to production and measured against customer impact.
LOCATION
We're looking for people within two hours of Prague (CET), so the team overlaps for most of the working day.
What we're looking for
These are non-negotiables. The things we'll specifically evaluate you on:
Shipping and ownership. You've repeatedly taken ambiguous requirements to production. You own the full stack of a feature (UI, API, data, deployment) and you don't wait for someone to tell you what to build next.
Product judgment. You can define MVP scope, pick the right metric to move, and kill work that isn't delivering value. You think about what the user needs, not just what's technically interesting.
AI comfort. You've worked alongside AI systems—at work or in side projects. You're comfortable building features that interact with LLM outputs (parsing agent responses, designing human-in-the-loop flows), but you won't be training models.
Strong sense of product quality. You care about the details of how a feature looks and feels, not just whether it works. You notice when something is off and you fix it.
Collaboration. You're low-ego and team-first. You give and receive direct and constructive feedback, align proactively with product and design, and unblock yourself and others.
Judgment in a fast-moving environment. You'll often define your own scope based on customer problems surfaced through product feedback and competitive gaps — then ship it within a week.
You might also
Have a strong sense for security and reliability in production systems.
Have scalable, distributed-system instincts—you've designed and operated systems that scale.
Have deep applied LLM experience—evaluation design, prompt engineering, safety controls, and cost optimization in production.
Have experience designing interfaces for AI-assisted workflows — confidence signals, human-in-the-loop interactions.
This is not for you if
You need significant hand-holding or aren't energized by figuring things out yourself.
You primarily want to work on infrastructure (see our SRE and AI Platform Engineer roles).
Our tech stack
TypeScript-first: Next.js, React, Tailwind, Fastify, Kysely (PostgreSQL), Zod
GCP
Latest AI primitives
You don't need to know all of these, but you should be excited to learn them quickly.
How we work
These are real tradeoffs we've made, not aspirations:
Initiative-driven. We organize around customer problems, not org charts. Problems surface through product feedback, competitive analysis, and direct customer conversations — then we prioritize, build, and ship weekly.
Customer-obsessed. We solve real problems, not hypothetical ones. Features that don't move customer metrics get cut.
Iterative by default. We ship small, learn fast, and never get attached to yesterday's code. This means things break sometimes — we fix forward.

job_title: Analyst, Research - Integrity Screening & Research Unit
job_description:
**Purpose of Job**
The individual will directly interface with internal clients to provide market data/research information. This business intelligence activity supports the growth and maintenance of the Bank’s pipeline and portfolio, as well as other business activities.
The individual will need to adopt a continuous improvement mindset and will be expected to support and be a part of improving operational processes across the screening function.
**Background**
The function is a 1st line of defence team responsible for screening and research due diligence/business intelligence across our portfolio of customers and related parties, both pre and post signing. Using a range of online data sources the function is a key controlling activity that is designed to support adherence to our Integrity Due Diligence Guidelines, conducting searches into the identity, reputation and commercial/political interests of relevant parties with whom the Bank may/has conducted business. The function also undertakes research related activity covering a range of topics to support the acquisition and maintenance of projects and other business activities.
The role holder will day-to-day be responsible for conducting screening activity to established service standards, escalating key issues in a timely manner to relevant 1st, 2nd and 3rd line of defence teams or other stakeholders. The role holder will require a good level of subject matter expertise, able to navigate matters relating to integrity risk factors, including PEPs, sanctions, criminal matters and beneficial ownership.
The Bank has adopted continuous improvement practices and the individual will be expected to support and adopt new ways of working. The role of the function has significantly evolved in the past year, with considerable focus now being applied to how the team supports future monitoring activity in a more effective and efficient manner. As part of this process, a ‘proof of concept’ exercise is being undertaken (in 2023) to determine how the function better supports the Business, whilst ensuring continued adherence to Bank standards and guidelines. The role holder will be the recipient of these changes, expected to embrace new practices and ways of working. An appreciation of how contemporary screening solutions (coupled with strong data standards) can deliver better service and improved compliance standards would be considered extremely beneficial.
**Accountabilities & Responsibilities**
**Operational Performance:**
• Execute screening/research processes to expected service standards (quantitative and qualitative) • Demonstrate personal commitment to delivering outstanding operational performance by adhering to established operational metrics – quality, timeliness and customer satisfaction • Responds to queries in a prompt and timely manner. Where necessary, escalating across the three lines of defence • Communicate with relevant departments to ensure that the decision-makers are aware of the risks involved with specific projects/transactions • Where necessary, provide additional capacity across the wider screening team to ensure expected service levels are maintained, including unanticipated deadlines defined by internal/external clients
**Operational Standards, Risk, Control & Governance:**
• Be a part of a culture where team members are responsible for the quality of their output, ensuring adherence to established quality/assurance targets • Help support the broader improvement of OSMs control environment • Ensure that new processes and practices are conducted in line with quality standards, applicable policies and relevant legislation
**Continuous Improvement:**
• Be a ‘team player’ in a team/department responsible for creating a ‘best in class’ operational function • Demonstrate self-awareness of personal and broader operational metrics, identifying opportunities to improve (either personally or collectively)
**Service Management & Third Party Management:**
• In delivering day-to-day operational activity, conform to established service levels and standards • Where necessary, work in a collaborative manner with other colleagues/teams involved in a hybrid service model
**Stakeholder Management:**
• Works collaboratively with colleagues to facilitate operational outcomes that adhere to established service levels • Positively influence others to help deliver a sustainable operations function • Proactively works with the Business to identify and manage backlogs, guiding them on prioritisation and, where necessary, conveying wider operational constraints • Be an ambassador for OSM across other departments by delivering outstanding operational outcomes
**Knowledge, Skills, Experience & Qualifications**
The individual appointed must have the necessary seniority to be able to take on responsibilities associated with the role, being able to handle the pressures of the role in a manner appropriate to the Bank. The candidate should have the following:
• Good experience in a corporate research unit in the financial services sector. • Understanding of current market practices and related technology platforms (and their functionality/capabilities). • Comfortable with balancing operational workloads/queues and actively communicating with Banking and Compliance teams. • Excellent written and verbal communication in English. • Must have positive, collaborative and solution orientated attitude with a track record of achieving results across KYC/AML and/or Research teams. • Fluent English (essential); Russian, French/Arabic, Turkish are advantageous.

From **The Scrum Guide 2020**:
“The Scrum Master is accountable for establishing Scrum as defined in the Scrum Guide. They do this by helping everyone understand Scrum theory and practice, both within the Scrum Team and the organisation.
The Scrum Master is accountable for the Scrum Team’s effectiveness. They do this by enabling the Scrum Team to improve its practices, within the Scrum framework.
Scrum Masters are true leaders who serve the Scrum Team and the larger organisation.”
**Source :** **https://scrumguides.org/docs/scrumguide/v2020/2020-Scrum-Guide-US.pdf** **(contains full description.)**
The Scrum Master II role is the continuation of an Agile career.
The Scrum Master role at Edenred PayTech closely follows the definition in the Scrum Guide. Additionally we ask our Scrum Masters to gain and practice skills from wider Agile disciplines such as **Kanban****,** **Disciplined Agile**, and **Better Value Sooner Safer Happier**, as we realise that one-Scrum-size does not fit all team contexts.
The Scrum Master does not govern nor manage the Product Backlog for the team. This is done jointly by the Product Manager/Product Owner, and the team (via pulling work into the Sprint Backlog each sprint). The Scrum Master facilitates, and encourages such backlog grooming and refinement.
Importantly a key aspect of the Scrum Master’s role is to champion early detection and removal / mitigation of cross-team dependencies. Such can create bottlenecks, ie: constraints that left unresolved will slow throughput of value to zero.

## **Senior E-commerce Backend Engineer: AI Native (f/m/d)**
The Senior E-commerce Backend Engineer: AI-Native is responsible to build, integrate, and expand the backend services that power the company's evolving modular e-commerce platform. This is a hands-on software engineering role focused on connecting core e-commerce capabilities including personalization, semantic and LLM-driven search and discovery, Digital Asset Management (DAM), Product Information Management (PIM), and internal SAP/HANA systems. The role will design and develop APIs, services, data flows, and integrations that allow these platforms to work together reliably at scale. A defining requirement for this position is an AI-native development mindset: the successful candidate will use AI coding agents as a normal part of the software development lifecycle to generate, refactor, test, debug, document, and improve code while applying strong engineering judgment, security practices, and human review. The ideal candidate combines strong backend engineering fundamentals, systems integration experience, curiosity, and the ability to move quickly in a modern AI-assisted development environment. ### Essential Functions:
* Backend Platform Development: Design, build, maintain, and extend backend services, APIs, and integration layers that support Edmund Optics' modular e-commerce architecture and customer-facing web experiences
* AI-Native Software Development: Use AI coding agents and agentic development workflows as a core part of day-to-day engineering to generate, refactor, test, debug, document, and accelerate production code. Validate AI-generated output for correctness, security, maintainability, and performance rather than treating generated code as automatically production-ready
* E-commerce Systems Integration: Integrate key e-commerce capabilities including personalization platforms, semantic/LLM search and discovery, DAM, PIM, analytics and data services, and other modular components as the e-commerce ecosystem evolves
* Enterprise Data & ERP Integration: Build and maintain reliable integrations between the e-commerce platform and internal enterprise systems, including SAP/HANA, product, pricing, inventory, customer, order, and other business data required to support e-commerce experiences and transactions
* API & Service Architecture: Develop scalable, secure, well-documented APIs and services that allow internal applications, third-party platforms, and customer-facing experiences to exchange data efficiently and consistently
* LLM & Semantic Capabilities: Partner with e-commerce, search, data, and AI teams to integrate LLM-enabled and semantic capabilities into the site, including retrieval, product discovery, conversational experiences, and supporting data pipelines or service layers
* Quality, Testing & Debugging: Build automated testing and validation into development workflows. Use AI-assisted debugging where appropriate while maintaining strong standards for code review, observability, performance, regression prevention, and production reliability
* Modular Architecture & Reusability: Develop services and components with clear boundaries, reusable interfaces, and maintainable integration patterns that support continued movement toward a more modular and composable e-commerce architecture
* Vendor & Partner Collaboration: Work directly with technology vendors, implementation partners, and internal teams to understand technical requirements, review integration approaches, troubleshoot issues, and translate platform capabilities into production solutions
* Continuous Improvement & Emerging Tools: Stay current with AI-assisted software development, agentic coding workflows, backend architecture, integration patterns, and emerging e-commerce technologies. Evaluate new approaches pragmatically and adopt those that measurably improve engineering speed, quality, or maintainability
### Qualifications:
To perform this position successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential function satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable Accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
### Your profile:
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field; equivalent relevant experience will be considered
* 7+ years of professional software development experience, including substantial hands-on backend, API, or systems integration work
* Experience working with SAP and/or SAP HANA data and integration patterns
* Demonstrated recent experience using AI-assisted or agentic coding workflows in real software development, not solely experimentation or prompt-based prototyping
* Strong hands-on backend software engineering experience building production web applications, services, APIs, and integrations
* Strong engineering judgment and demonstrated ability to use AI coding agents and AI-assisted development tools to write, refactor, test, debug, and document code as part of a professional software development workflow
* Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs, service integrations, data interfaces, and modern backend application patterns
* Experience integrating multiple enterprise or SaaS platforms within a production web or e-commerce environment
* Strong understanding of databases, data modeling, SQL, system-to-system data flows, error handling, and integration reliability
* Experience with source control, automated testing, code review, CI/CD practices, logging, monitoring, and production troubleshooting
* Ability to work effectively with frontend developers, architects, product and e-commerce teams, data teams, enterprise application owners, and external implementation partners
* Strong problem-solving skills, curiosity, and comfort working in an evolving environment where architecture and tools will continue to change
* Ability to communicate technical concepts, trade-offs, risks, and dependencies clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Fluency in English
### What we offer:
A versatile and challenging position alongside a highly competitive employment package within our dynamic and successful corporation in a growing and future-proof industry. You will have the opportunity to work with highly motivated, self-driven and open-minded people with a great team spirit.
Edmund Optics provides a range of employee benefits alongside the salary package including:
* Company pension scheme
* Private medical & dental insurance
* Extensive training and development opportunities
* Subsidized gym membership
* Cycle to Work scheme
* Company events
* ...and a lot more!

# Principal AI Engineer - Context - Agents and Context

United Kingdom

Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale - unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data - securing and protecting private information more effectively - Elastic's complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
### What is The Role:
The Context Engine team builds the knowledge layer that AI agents use to work with enterprise data in Elasticsearch. We extract knowledge from any data sources into a structured AI Index, serve it to agents through public APIs, MCP tools and framework integrations, and close the loop with agent traces so that what the engine knows improves from real usage. Any agent can use it: Elastic's own Agent Builder, Claude Code, LangChain and other third-party harnesses.
As a Principal AI Engineer, you own the improvement loop of this product end to end: how agents, automations and skills behave in production, how we observe them, how we evaluate them, and how we ship changes to them safely. This is a hybrid role at the intersection of engineering, data science, and product. You will write production code, design evaluation and telemetry that product decisions can rest on, and set the technical bar for how the team iterates on agentic behaviour. You will work alongside data scientists, backend engineers, product, and UX, and your work will show up directly in what customers build on top of Elastic.
The codebase is TypeScript and we build it in the open, so you'll be shipping code, designs and discussions in public alongside the rest of the Elastic Stack.
### What You Will Be Doing:
* Own the production improvement loop for Context Engine: understand how extraction automations, retrieval tools and memory behave, based on offline evaluations and customer conversations and telemetry. You help find the failure modes, fix them, and prove the fix.
* Define how we iterate on agents and skills safely: versioning and rollout of prompts, skills and automations, regression coverage, staged and shadow evaluation, and the guardrails that let us change behaviour without breaking customers.
* Design the telemetry we need to make data-informed engineering decisions: what to capture from agent traces, tool calls and knowledge retrieval, how it lands in Elasticsearch, and how it feeds evaluation, dashboards and the feedback loop.
* Partner with the data science team on evaluation strategy: golden datasets, evaluators to gate on quality, latency and cost.
* Raise the bar across the team: review designs and PRs, mentor engineers in eval-driven development, and write the technical proposals that shape the roadmap.
### What You Bring:
* 10+ years of software engineering experience, with the recent years spent shipping and operating AI-driven products on real production traffic, ideally products with public APIs and data models that had to evolve without breaking customers.
* A track record of eval-driven product improvement: you have diagnosed agent or LLM behaviour from traces and user feedback, designed the evaluation that exposed the problem, shipped the fix and measured the outcome.
* Direct experience building agents with state and memory, and iterating on prompts, skills and tool behaviour safely in production.
* Familiarity with MCP, including exposing public MCP servers and tools.
* Experience designing telemetry for AI systems, and using it to make engineering and product decisions.
* Experience running product experiments end to end: instrumentation, unattended execution, and interpreting results.
* Experience building products with public APIs and evolving data models, and the judgement that comes with maintaining external contracts as a product changes.
* Strong backend engineering skills in either Python or TypeScript: APIs, stateful workflows, data pipelines and production services.
* Comfort working with data scientists, engineers, and product managers as peers, translating between measurement and shipping, and communicating trade-offs clearly.
* A pragmatic, low-ego style suited to a distributed, async-first team.

* Experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, Claude Agent SDK, or similar.
* Agentic retrieval experience, including knowledge representation.
* Practical Elasticsearch experience.
