Job Title: Oracle EPM Planning Cloud Developer & Support Specialist
Location: [Remote / Hybrid - London, UK]
Job Type: Fixed Term Contract – Full Time
Position Summary
We are seeking an experienced Oracle EPM Planning Cloud Developer & Support Specialist to manage, maintain, and enhance our Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) ecosystem. In this dual role, you will be responsible for the end-to-end administration and technical support of Oracle EPM Cloud (EPBCS/PBCS) applications while actively collaborating with finance stakeholders to design, build, and deploy enhancements to the existing planning, budgeting, and forecasting solutions.
Key Responsibilities
Application Development & System Enhancement
Design, build, test, and deploy enhancements to Oracle EPM Planning Cloud applications, modules (Financials, Workforce, Capital, Projects), and custom plan types.
Write, debug, and optimize complex Groovy scripts, Business Rules, and Calc Scripts to support automated calculations and business logic.
Develop, maintain, and optimize Data Integration / Data Management (FDMEE) routines, metadata loads, and data load rules.
Build and customize Smart View templates, Financial Reporting (FR) Web Studio reports, and Management Reporting dashboards for finance users.
System Administration & Operations
Manage user security, roles, group assignments, and access permissions using Oracle Access Management/EPM Cloud Security.
Oversee monthly Oracle EPM Cloud patch updates, test application compatibility in Non-Prod environments, and manage deployment cycles.
Monitor daily data loads, batch schedules, automation scripts (EPMAutomate), and system performance.
Production Support & Incident Management
Act as the Primary Tier 2/3 Technical Support contact for global finance and accounting users during monthly forecasting and annual budgeting cycles.
Diagnose and resolve system errors, data reconciliation mismatches, performance bottlenecks, and user access issues.
Raise, manage, and escalate Oracle Service Requests (SRs) through resolution.
Stakeholder Management & Process Optimization
Partner with FP&A and Finance leadership to translate complex business requirements into scalable technical specifications.
Conduct user training sessions and maintain detailed technical documentation, process flowcharts, and runbooks.
Required Qualifications & Skills
Experience: 3–5+ years of hands-on experience designing, developing, and supporting Oracle EPM Planning Cloud (EPBCS / PBCS).
Technical Proficiency:
Advanced knowledge of Groovy Scripting and Essbase calculation scripts.
Expert-level understanding of Oracle Data Integration (ODI) / Data Management and metadata administration.
Strong mastery of Smart View for Office (Excel integration) and EPM Report Designer.
Hands-on experience with EPMAutomate and command-line automation scripts.
Functional Knowledge: Solid foundation in core accounting and FP&A concepts (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow forecasting, cost allocations).
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, Accounting, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
Preferred Qualifications
Oracle EPM Cloud Implementation / Technical Certification (e.g., Oracle Enterprise Planning and Budgeting Cloud Service Certified Implementation Specialist).
Hands-on experience with other Oracle EPM modules (PCM / Profitability & Cost Management, ARCS, EDM).
SQL and database querying skills for backend data reconciliation.
About King
With a mission of Making the World Playful, King is a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world with more than 20 years of history of delivering some of the world’s most iconic games in the mobile gaming industry, including the world-famous Candy Crush franchise, as well as other mobile titles such as Farm Heroes Saga. Around 200 million people play a King game every month. King, part of Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), has Kingsters in Stockholm, Malmö, London, Barcelona, Berlin, Dublin, San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles and Malta. Landytech is on a mission to revolutionise the way that investment managers, asset owners and their advisors access asset information. **The role**
AI has made producing screens easy. It has not made products coherent. We are looking for someone to own the experience of Sesame end to end — the client journey, the interaction logic, the look and feel, and the consistency of all of it — and to build it.
If you are an engineer who has always had a view on how the product should look and behave, this is a role where that judgement is part of the remit rather than a side interest.
*We have posted this role under two titles — Design Engineer and Product Experience Designer — to reach both backgrounds. Same role, same team. Apply once, to whichever fits you better.*
**How we work**
We have rebuilt our product process around AI rather than bolting it on:
• AI is used heavily at every stage of both design and engineering, not just at the production end
• Our design system lives in code, used by engineers and AI tooling alike
• Tooling changes every few months and we expect it to
You will have real scope to shape how we work, and to help build the parts that do not exist yet.
**What you will shape**
How much of this you lead outright will depend on your experience and on how it fits with the team already in place. There is room to take on more over time.
* **The front-end experience layer.** You will build the interfaces that matter most, particularly the dense and difficult ones, and help set the patterns others follow
* **The design system.** Developed in code with the rest of the front-end team, with a leading voice in what belongs in the system
* **Look, feel and consistency.** The product should feel like one thing, and you will help define what that one thing is and uphold it in review and in tooling
* **The client journey.** You will be in front of investment professionals, family offices and their advisors, and trusted to act on what you hear
* **Craft in dense financial interfaces.** Tables legible at scale, numbers at the right precision, drill-downs that survive a messy real portfolio under load
**The must-have: setting the standard AI works to**
AI is very good at producing attractive interfaces. Given a design system, almost anyone can now generate a credible screen.
The harder problem, and the one this role exists to solve, is making sure what we build expresses the product’s logic, density and intent rather than simply reusing its components. That means defining the standards and instructions our tools work to, reading the output critically enough to see why something is subtly wrong, and tightening the rules so it does not recur.
Using AI to produce interfaces is not the skill we are looking for. Directing it to our standard, consistently and at depth, is.
Increasingly this is engineering work: it lives in the repo, in the tooling, and in what the agents can and cannot reach for.
**Strongly valued: design expertise**
We are not looking for a front-end engineer willing to tolerate design work. We are looking for real UX judgement.
* You can say what is wrong with a flow, not just implement it faster
* You think in objects, relationships and states before components
* You have taste in what matters here: hierarchy, typography, density, restraint
* You are comfortable doing the upstream thinking, including what should not exist at all
No portfolio required. Shipped interfaces we can look at, and the decisions behind them, is what we want to see.
**Also valued: product management instincts**
If you have talked to clients directly, decided what not to build, and owned an outcome rather than a ticket, we will weight it heavily.

We do not expect anyone to have everything below — we would rather meet someone exceptional in two areas than adequate in all three.
* 5+ years in front-end engineering, ideally React and TypeScript, with libraries such as shadcn/ui

**🚀 Mission:** Our mission is to elevate later life and build the later living sector of the future
**👫 Team:** Eliza (AI Agents), cross-functional with Engineering, reporting to the CXO
**🏷️ Title:** Senior Product Manager
**💷 Salary:** £80,000 – £100,000 (depending on experience and seniority)
🎁 **Benefits:** 26 days holiday and a range of other benefits. See here
**📈 Equity:** We have a generous EMI share scheme that all team members will participate in
💻 **Office Policy:** Hybrid (Minimum 2 core days per week in the office)
🌍 **Office Location:** London Bridge, London, UK
**🔍 The Opportunity:**
Lottie is building the AI operating system for social care. Families use our marketplace to find care homes and home care. Care providers use Found, our software, to manage enquiries, occupancy and finances. Eliza is the AI agent inside Found. She answers calls and live chats from families enquiring about care, on behalf of the care provider, any time of day.
That matters because a third of enquiries to care providers go unanswered. A family calls a home at 7pm and nobody picks up, or leaves a voicemail that's returned three days later, by which point they've moved on.
Eliza is already handling a meaningful share of enquiries across our provider network, and we're now expanding the team's remit. **The team owns the conversation: every voice and chat interaction between a family and a provider, and the telephony that carries it.** That's two products, not one. The conversational AI itself, and the call tracking layer underneath it: number provisioning, routing, recording, transcription, and the attribution that tells a provider where their enquiries actually came from.
We're looking for a **Senior Product Manager** to own this. It is an unusual product job, because the quality bar is set in half-seconds as much as in sprints. You'll be making the calls on where latency is worth spending, when a faster model is worth a slightly worse answer, how Eliza should sound to a worried daughter at 9pm, and what "good" even means for a conversation nobody scripted. Getting that right is an evals problem, and you'll own it.
You'll set the direction for your area 3–6 months out and ship fast in a space where the technology moves underneath you every few weeks. You'll also spend real time inside care providers' operations: their phone trees, their out-of-hours cover, their weekend rotas, their CRM. The quality of this product depends on understanding those setups better than anyone else does.
**💻 What does this role involve?**
* **Owning the strategy and roadmap for Eliza's conversational surfaces:** voice call handling, live chat, and the handoffs between AI and humans.
* **Owning the conversational stack end to end:** speech to text, the model and prompting layer, text to speech and voice design, and the call tracking product underneath.
* **Owning evals as a first-class product surface:** labelled call sets, automated scoring, regression tests before every release, and a human review loop on real transcripts, so we can ship model and prompt changes weekly without breaking a provider's trust.
* **Setting the quality bar for AI conversations and the measurement that proves it:** containment, resolution, escalation, enquiry conversion, and provider trust.
* **Defining what we need to learn before we build, and choosing the fastest credible way to learn it:** when to run proper discovery and when to just ship.
* **Connecting product decisions to commercial outcomes:** what Eliza does for a provider's occupancy, and what that's worth.
* Partnering with Account Management, Customer Care and Sales so every launch lands well with the providers using it.
**💪 What problems will you be solving?**
* **Getting every enquiry answered.** Designing AI conversations that families trust and providers are proud of, at any hour, in a category where the stakes for the person calling could not be higher.
* **Making onboarding forgettable.** Every provider has a different phone setup, a different group structure, different rules about who gets which call. Turning that mess into something we can configure in hours, not weeks.
* **Knowing when to hand over.** Getting the AI-to-human handoff right, so Eliza does what she's good at and people do what they're good at — and neither side drops the family in between.
* **Turning conversations into intelligence.** Every call and chat is a signal about what families want and how providers sell. Making that usable across Lottie.
**👀 We think you'll be a great fit if...**
* **You've shipped LLM-powered products to real users.**
* **You're comfortable in the machinery:** speech to text and text to speech, latency budgets, model selection, prompting, tool calling, and evals. You don't need to build it, but you need opinions about it.
* **You've shipped B2B SaaS products** to businesses that are not software businesses, and you've enjoyed it.
* **You've owned a product area independently**, set its direction, and can explain the bets you didn't take as clearly as the ones you did.
* You get properly interested in operational detail. An afternoon reverse-engineering a customer's call-routing rules sounds like a good afternoon to you.
* **You're hypothesis-driven:** you tackle value, usability, feasibility and viability risk before committing to build, and you kill things early when the evidence is weak.
* You prioritise ruthlessly under ambiguity and say no gracefully, with clear reasoning.
* **You care about the people on the other end of the phone** — families at one of the hardest moments of their lives, and care teams who are already stretched.
**💔 This role isn't for you if...**
* **You want to work on consumer polish only.** This role is as much about providers' back-office reality as it is about the care seeker.
* **You need a fully-formed roadmap handed to you** — this area is being defined as we go.
* **You'd rather stay above the detail.** You'll be in call transcripts, eval results, IVR configs and provider onboarding sessions.
* You're uncomfortable shipping when the underlying technology changes every month.
* **Our mission to elevate later life doesn't resonate with you.**

* First round with Talent Lead, Alice Rooke (20 minutes, remote)
* Case study with Product Manager and Engineering Leader: present a project you've led, covering the problem, the decisions you made and what happened (60 minutes, remote)
* Leadership round with CXO: a leadership conversation plus a live case worked through together (90 minutes, in person at Lottie's office, London Bridge)

**🚀 Meet Lottie**
Founded with a mission to build the care sector of the future, Lottie is creating the AI operating system for social care - designed to unlock profitability for care providers and to make finding care as easy as booking a holiday on Airbnb.
Launched in London in July 2021, Lottie has raised over £25m from tier 1 venture capital funds (Accel and General Catalyst) and is widely recognised as one of Europe's fastest growing tech companies. **🤩 Why Lottie?**
* **Ownership –** A chance to own one of the most commercially important products at one of the UK's fastest growing startups, in a category where AI is changing what's possible every month.
* **Mission -** Tech for good that aims to build the care industry of the future and to positively impact millions of peoples lives. Care is one of the final remaining large consumer industries that is yet to be disrupted and positively revolutionised by technology.

# **Compliance & IT Operations Manager**
**Reports To:** Chief Financial Officer **Job Level:** SeniorIndividual Contributor **Location:** London, UK **Role Type:** Full-Time, Permanent **Salary:** Up to £65,000 D.O.E
### **Role Purpose**
*As Lunio’s Compliance & IT Operations Manager, you will own the day-to-day management and continuous improvement of our compliance programme, information security governance and IT operations. You will lead our approach to ISO 27001, SOC 2 and UK GDPR/data protection, acting as the primary point of contact for our external Data Protection Officer (DPO), auditors, customers and internal stakeholders on security and compliance matters. Alongside this, you will oversee our day-to-day IT operations, including identity and access management, equipment and software lifecycle, user onboarding and offboarding, and internal IT support. This is a highly autonomous role with significant ownership, bringing compliance, information security governance and IT operations together under a single accountable owner.*
### You'll make a great Compliance and IT Operations Manager at Lunio if you have experience with:
* **Compliance Programme Ownership:** Manage and continuously improve Lunio's compliance programme (ISO 27001, SOC 2, UK GDPR), acting as the single point of contact for auditors, our external DPO, and internal stakeholders.
* **Audit Readiness:** Lead certification and audit cycles end-to-end, including scoping, evidence collection, auditor liaison, and remediation of findings.
* **Policy & Risk Management:** Maintain and evolve Lunio’s information security and data protection policy suite, ensuring policies remain current, approved, and understood across the business. Own the corporate risk register, conducting regular risk assessments and driving mitigations through to closure.
* **Third-Party & Customer Assurance:** Manage security and compliance due diligence across both suppliers and customers, including vendor and sub-processor risk assessments and completion of customer and prospect security questionnaires, partnering closely with Sales and Customer Success.
* **Security Incident Management & Resilience:** Own security incident and data breach response processes, coordinating with the DPO and SLT where required. Lead business continuity and disaster recovery planning, including maintaining plans and coordinating periodic testing.
* **Security Awareness & Training:** Build a strong culture of security and compliance across Lunio by designing and delivering company-wide awareness training, onboarding, and ongoing guidance.
* **IT Operations & Access Management:** Oversee day-to-day IT operations, including equipment provisioning, software licensing, identity and access management, and employee joiner, mover and leaver processes, ensuring appropriate access controls and least-privilege principles are consistently applied.
* **IT Support & Enablement:** Provide effective internal IT support, resolving day-to-day issues and escalating more complex cases where necessary. Own technology setup for new starters and maintain clear processes, documentation, and runbooks to support consistent IT operations.
### You'll really thrive in this role if...
* You've worked somewhere small enough that you had to build the process, not just follow it
* You've been the point of contact for customer security questionnaires and know how much of that work is translation
* You've supported a security incident or breach response, even in a small part
* You like tidying up processes that don't have an owner yet
* You've worked in B2B SaaS, or somewhere with a similar pace
### Why Lunio?
* Genuine Hybrid Working: 2 days per week in office (Tuesday & Thursday), 3 days working from home.
* 35 days annual leave including bank holidays
* Christmas Closure
* £1000 one off home office budget
* £500 per year wellbeing budget
* Flexible working
* Growing Scale-Up with space for you to grow with it!
If you are excited to join a fast-paced, growing scaleup - we want to hear from you! 🌟

*One final ask; whilst we are an AI first company and encourage people to utilise it to streamline their day-to-day tasks. We kindly ask that your cover letter is a genuine reflection of you, your experience and your motivation to join Lunio. Your authentic self is who we want to get to know throughout the process!*

* Ensure financial controls, audit trails, and compliance standards are met within the system environment.

Autodesk is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help design and build a reusable Electron and Chromium-based desktop platform for Autodesk web applications. You will solve challenging problems at the boundary between web applications and native desktop software while mentoring other engineers and collaborating across Autodesk teams.
**Responsibilities**
* **Electron and desktop platform engineering - approximately 35%:** Design, implement, and own significant areas of the Electron application, including process architecture, native integrations, web-to-desktop interfaces, and application lifecycle
* **Chromium runtime engineering - approximately 25%:** Own the configuration and integration of the Chromium runtime, including supported build settings, runtime flags, Electron and Chromium upgrades, feature enablement, compatibility analysis, and technical investigations
* **Windows and native systems integration - approximately 20%:** Design and implement integrations with Windows APIs and system capabilities such as hardware discovery, process management, application protocols, GPU preference, system configuration, and enterprise desktop behavior
* **Architecture, reliability, and technical leadership - approximately 20%:** Contribute to architecture decisions, security design, troubleshooting strategy, engineering standards, and the long-term maintainability of the platform
* Own moderately complex and complex features from initial investigation through technical design, implementation, validation, and delivery
* Break ambiguous technical work into actionable tasks, identify dependencies and risks, and coordinate with other engineers and partner teams when necessary
* Design secure boundaries between hosted web applications and privileged desktop functionality, including process isolation, API exposure, navigation controls, and inter-process communication
* Work with the technical lead and application-security partners to apply Electron and Chromium security best practices and address findings
* Define and maintain stable interfaces that allow Autodesk web applications to consume shared native desktop capabilities without creating product-specific forks
* Lead evaluation and adoption of new Electron and Chromium releases, investigate compatibility and performance implications, and recommend upgrade approaches
* Diagnose complex runtime, memory, startup, security, operating-system, and application-integration issues using Chromium tooling, native debuggers, profiling tools, crash diagnostics, and system telemetry
* Collaborate with the build and release engineer to ensure runtime dependencies and desktop components can be built, packaged, tested, and released reliably
* Work with product and specialist engineering teams to expose platform capabilities while keeping product-specific implementation outside the shared desktop layer
* Contribute to architecture decision records, technical documentation, coding standards, and operational runbooks
* Review code and designs from other engineers and provide constructive technical guidance
* Mentor less-experienced engineers and help them develop expertise in Electron, Chromium, desktop engineering, debugging, and secure application design
* Proactively identify technical debt, platform risks, and opportunities to simplify or improve the system
**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience
* Strong software development experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and Node.js
* Experience developing Electron applications, Chromium-based applications, native desktop software, or comparable systems-level application platforms
* Strong understanding of application architecture, asynchronous programming, process boundaries, security, and software lifecycle management
* Experience independently delivering complex software features from design through production
* Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills across multiple components or technology layers
* Experience with automated testing, source control, code review, and modern continuous integration practices
* Ability to communicate technical trade-offs and work effectively with engineers across multiple teams
**Preferred Qualifications**
* Deep experience with Electron architecture, including main, renderer, preload, context isolation, inter-process communication, and security configuration
* Understanding of Chromium architecture, runtime configuration, feature flags, release cycles, or build systems
* Experience with C++, native Node.js modules, or bindings between JavaScript and native platform APIs
* Experience with Windows systems programming or Windows desktop APIs
* Experience diagnosing memory, process, performance, or crash problems in Chromium-based applications
* Familiarity with Chromium or Electron build tooling such as GN and Ninja
* Experience with Windows installers, application signing, enterprise software deployment, or application updating
* Experience designing APIs or shared platform components consumed by multiple applications or teams
* Experience with software security threat modeling or secure desktop application design
* Experience mentoring engineers or providing technical leadership within a development team
**The Ideal Candidate**
You enjoy solving problems that cross traditional frontend, backend, and systems-engineering boundaries. You are comfortable moving from TypeScript and Electron code into Chromium diagnostics, native operating-system behavior, build configuration, or security analysis when the problem requires it.
You can take an open-ended technical problem, investigate the available options, make reasoned recommendations, and independently drive implementation while knowing when a broader architectural decision needs input from the technical lead,
You enjoy helping other engineers succeed, improving the systems around you, and building shared infrastructure that is maintainable beyond the immediate feature or product.

Our batch stack includes Spark and Presto over Hive and Iceberg tables, Velox as a shared execution layer, and an internal workflow authoring and scheduling platform. Own the multi-year product strategy for stream and batch processing at Meta: the engine portfolio, the authoring surface, and the convergence path between streaming and batch execution.
Act as the voice of the internal customer: software engineers, data engineers and ML practitioners authoring pipelines.
Turn their real pain (state management, event-time windowing, backfill, schema evolution, debugging a pipeline at 3am) into abstractions that hold up under load.
Define what "managed" should mean internally, covering self-service authoring, autoscaling, upgrade and deprecation, and hold the platform to that bar.
Establish the semantics customers can rely on, and the honest cost of each guarantee: processing semantics (at-least-once, at-most-once, exactly-once), checkpointing, state management, and freshness.

Instrument whether the platform is measurably reducing operational load for the teams on it.
Own adoption and deprecation as a single problem.

Drive the open source strategy: what we adopt, what we contribute upstream, and where internal systems remain justified.
Partner with the ML data and ranking teams whose realtime feature pipelines are the most demanding tenants on this stack, and with the warehouse and analytics teams on the batch side of the boundary.
Drive alignment across Ads, Reels, ML Infra and the warehouse orgs largely without direct authority.

Raise the bar of the PM function through mentorship of senior PMs across Data Infrastructure, and support recruiting and interviewing.

Critical thinking and analytical leadership experience
Experience driving strategy and alignment across multiple organizations without direct authority
BA/BS in Computer Science or Information Systems

Mindstone learns what works in AI adoption through our work with clients and our community, builds those insights into training, community and Rebel, our AI-powered agentic OS, then brings what works to more people, measure what works and iterate. There is real administration here, and priorities will change. This isn’t a strategy role with the practical work delegated to someone else. Taking care of the details is part of the opportunity, not something hidden behind the title.

**Profile Summary**
This is a senior, highly technical role within the Mizuho EMEA Market Risk team, carrying independent risk oversight responsibility across cross-asset derivatives franchise in FX and IR. The position combines deep FX and FX Options coverage – spanning vanilla and exotic spectrum – with additional oversight of the Fixed Income derivatives portfolio, including interest rate swaps, inflation derivatives, structured rates products and cross-currency transactions.
Role will also act in as senior manager, ability to deputise for Head of EMEA Market Risk management on regular basis.
The successful candidate will serve as the primary market risk authority for Mizuho EMEA’s derivatives businesses, partnering closely with FX and Rates trading, structuring and quantitative analytics teams. This is a hands-on, intellectually demanding role that requires genuine quantitative depth, commercial awareness of trading dynamics and the credibility to challenge front-office pricing and hedging assumptions at the most senior level.
It is a compelling time to join Mizuho in EMEA as the bank continues to build out its Risk team and capabilities. The person will be given the required backing and support to ensure success.
**Duties and Responsibilities**
**End-to-End Market Risk Ownership – FX & FX Options**
* Closely observe relevant market developments across rates and currencies markets, critically review risks in FEG / Rates Derivatives portfolio and provide value-added challenge on risk positioning in forward looking market context.
* Manage market risk framework for the entire FX and FXO businesses, including daily risk reporting, P&L attribution, limit monitoring and escalation across spot, forwards, vanilla options and the full suite of exotic structures.
* Monitor and analyse risk sensitivities across the full FX volatility surface – delta, gamma, vega, and higher-order Greeks – with particular focus on spot vol grids, pin risks, smile dynamics, term structure and cross-currency effects.
* Understand and challenge pricing models for exotic FX options and inputs including local and stochastic volatility.
* Maintain and evolve the limit framework for FX and FXO businesses, ensuring coverage of Greeks limits, VaR, stress and notional constraints aligned to risk appetite and regulatory standards.
* Support the FRTB IMA / SA-TB analysis for derivatives trading books, contributing to internal capital calculations and regulatory submissions alongside the Head of Market Risk.
**End-to-End Market Risk Ownership – Fixed Income Derivatives**
* Provide independent daily risk oversight for the Fixed Income derivatives portfolio, including interest rate swaps (vanilla, basis, OIS, cross-currency), inflation swaps and linkers, swaptions and structured rates products, and the DRSE (Derivative Risk Solutions EMEA) interest rate and currency hedging portfolio.
* Monitor and analyse rates sensitivities across tenors, currencies and curves – including DV01, PV01, convexity, vega, cross-gamma and basis risk – ensuring a complete and accurate risk picture across the multi-currency rates franchise.
* Oversee the interaction between FX and rates risk in cross-currency derivatives ensuring coherent cross-asset risk measurement and appropriate limit coverage.
**Stress Testing & Scenario Analysis**
* Design, implement and maintain bespoke stress scenarios for the combined FX derivatives and FI derivatives portfolios, covering: FX spot and volatility surface shocks, correlation breakdown, liquidity squeezes and geopolitical events; parallel and non-parallel yield curve shifts, central bank policy surprises and sovereign spread stress; combined cross-asset scenarios that capture the interaction between FX and rates risk in structured products and cross-currency transactions.
* Ensure FRTB-compliant Expected Shortfall and SA calculations are robust, well-documented and regularly reviewed.
* Lead historical stress test analysis, mapping significant market events (GFC, Eurozone crisis, 2022 GBP/LDI event, post-COVID rate normalisation, EM FX crises) to current portfolio exposures.
* Develop reverse stress tests across the derivatives book, identifying scenarios that approach risk appetite thresholds and working with management on appropriate mitigants.
* Present stress testing methodology, results and management actions to the Stress Testing Committee, Market Model & Methodology Committee and, where required, regulatory supervisors.
**Model Governance & Risk Infrastructure**
* Act as a key contributor to the model governance process for FX and rates derivatives pricing models, providing independent market risk input to model validation and approval processes.
* Lead the development and enhancement of in-house risk analytics tools (Python-based Greeks calculators, P&L explain frameworks, scenario engines) to support real-time risk management of complex exotic and structured portfolios.
* Identify and escalate model limitations, calibration weaknesses and infrastructure gaps; drive remediation in collaboration with Quantitative Analytics and Technology.
* Contribute to the ongoing evolution of P&L attribution methodology across the FX and FI derivatives books, ensuring risk explain frameworks keep pace with product and model development.
**Governance & Stakeholder Engagement**
* Partner closely with FX and Rates traders, structurers and quants on new product approvals, hedging strategy reviews and limit breach management.
* Prepare and present risk positions, stress results and technical insights to senior risk management, the EMEA Risk Management Committee, Stress Testing Committee, Market Model & Methodology Committee and the New Product Working Group.
* Act as a credible and technically authoritative counterpart to FCA/PRA supervisors and internal audit on matters relating to FX derivatives and FI derivatives market risk.
* Maintain strong working relationships with Tokyo-based parent risk functions, ensuring EMEA derivatives risk is accurately and transparently represented at group level.
* Attend and contribute to the Prudential & Regulation Committee, Financing Committee and other governance forums as directed by the Head of Market Risk EMEA.
**Team Leadership & Development**
* Deputise for Head of EMEA MRM on key committees and senior leadership meetings.
* Strategical thinker with critically review existing processes and drive improvements forward.
* Mentor a small team of risk analysts, maintaining personal technical ownership of the most complex areas of the book.
* Foster a culture of rigour, intellectual curiosity and continuous improvement within the team, supporting the Head of Market Risk EMEA in developing the broader Market Risk function.
**Qualifications, Skills, and Experience**
* A minimum of eight to ten years of relevant post-qualification experience in market risk management (or a front-office quant/risk hybrid role) specifically covering FX options and/or interest rate derivatives in an investment bank, major hedge fund or large systematic trading house.
* Proven track record of independent risk ownership across vanilla FX options and a wide range of exotic structures (barriers, Asians, lookbacks, digitals, quantos, volatility products).
* Material experience covering Fixed Income derivatives risk, including multi-currency swaps, swaptions, inflation and structured rates products, ideally alongside FX derivatives coverage.
* Demonstrable experience in stress testing methodology and scenario design for derivatives portfolios, including presentation to senior risk governance forums.
* Direct exposure to regulatory frameworks including FRTB (IMA and SA-TB)
* Relevant academic background in a quantitative discipline (Mathematics, Physics, Financial Engineering or equivalent) from a leading institution; MSc or PhD strongly preferred. CFA, FRM or PRM is advantageous.
* Advanced understanding of option pricing theory and numerical methods.
* Strong command of FX volatility surface construction, arbitrage-free interpolation and dynamic smile modelling.
* Deep knowledge of exotic FX option risk drivers: path-dependency, barrier monitoring, averaging features, quanto adjustments and correlation skew.
* Solid technical grounding in interest rate derivatives risk measurement: multi-curve DV01/PV01, convexity, basis risk, swaption vega, cross-gamma and XCCY basis.
* Proficiency in Python for risk analytics development and P&L explain.
* Familiarity with industry risk and pricing platforms (Murex) and data infrastructure.

## Description
**ABOUT NEUTREENO**
Climate change is the defining business challenge of our time, and we're here to solve it. Most decarbonisation solutions count emissions but do nothing to reduce them. We've changed that.
We’re Neutreeno, an emissions-to-performance platform, born out of the University of Cambridge's Department of Engineering. We help companies with supply chains and production processes turn emissions data into operational insight, the kind that cuts costs, sharpens decisions, and unlocks genuine competitive advantage. For operations and finance, it's margin they can measure. For sustainability teams, it's progress they can prove. Same data, two audiences, one engine.
We’re a fast-moving team that values EQ just as much as IQ. Autonomy, high ownership, speed and no-ego collaboration are at our core. We seek people who care deeply and are eager to work on solving problems bigger than themselves.
**THE ROLE**
As a Decarbonisation Model Engineer, you'll sit at the forefront of industrial decarbonisation, identifying, evaluating and modelling the technologies and process changes that cut carbon emissions across complex industries. The role is defined by system-level thinking: treating a client's processes, sites, energy supply and supply chain as one connected system, then finding where a change in energy use, material use or technology delivers the greatest reduction in emissions and cost.
Working across sectors like jet engine production, electricity transmission and EV battery manufacturing, you'll sit at the intersection of engineering, sustainability, economics and data science. Your models become part of the product, putting a credible number on every lever: what it costs, what it returns, and what it is worth under today's and tomorrow's carbon prices.
**THE WORK YOU'LL DO**
* Build bottom-up models from first principles that calculate bespoke decarbonisation levers at scale, accounting for cost, dependencies and implementation time.
* Quantify energy and material efficiency opportunities, from heat recovery, electrification and utilities to yield losses, material substitution and circular design while identifying Best Available Technologies (BAT) for technology-specific cases.
* Develop the techno-economic analysis behind each lever: CAPEX and OPEX, cost of abatement, marginal abatement cost curves, and sensitivity analysis that stands up to a client's finance team.
* Develop our carbon pricing engine across the current pricing landscape (compliance markets, taxation, internal shadow pricing, CBAM) and model client exposure under different price scenarios.
* Identify where decarbonisation creates value, including green premium pricing for low-carbon products and access to incentives and green finance.
* Write clear, reproducible Python behind the models and mentor junior engineers.

* Masters or PhD in Industrial, Chemical, Process or Mechanical Engineering.
* 3+ years of industry or research experience in techno-economic modelling, with a strong focus on energy and material efficiency and emissions reduction.
* Proven system-level thinking: able to reason about whole systems and identify where the biggest opportunity sits, rather than optimising components in isolation.
* Deep working knowledge of energy and material efficiency in industry: heat integration, electrification and fuel switching, and how material flows, yield losses and substitution drive embodied emissions.
* Strong command of carbon accounting and life cycle assessment, including Scope 1, 2 and 3 inventories, product carbon footprints and the relevant frameworks (GHG Protocol, ISO 14064 / 14067, SBTi, CBAM).
* Costing proficiency across techno-economic analysis (capex/opex, abatement cost, MACCs), project finance (NPV, IRR, payback, discount rates) and carbon pricing (ETS, carbon taxes, internal shadow prices).
* Expert Python for quantitative modelling (pandas, NumPy), with the discipline to make models reproducible, validated and version-controlled (Git/GitHub).
* Familiarity with using LLMs and agentic-AI workflows to build and enhance decarbonisation roadmaps.
* Outstanding communication skills, with the ability to convey technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
* Experience with process simulation software (e.g. Aspen Plus, HYSYS).
* Experience building marginal abatement cost curves or decarbonisation roadmaps for large industrial clients.
* Knowledge of optimisation or machine learning applied to process optimisation and emissions reduction.

**Job Description :**
Position: **Workday Implementation Lead / Programme Technology Lead**
Location: **This role can be located in our London or Peterborough offices but will need to work Tuesdays** **in Peterborough office and London Bridge office on Thursdays**
Type: **This role will be a one year Fixed Contract**
**Role Purpose**
**The Workday Implementation Lead is accountable for the end-to-end technology delivery of a major Workday transformation programme, leading the implementation and migration of News UK (NUK) onto News Corp’s global Workday platform.**
**The role provides overall technology leadership across** **functional solution design, Workday architecture, integrations, data migration and security** **, ensuring that the solution meets News UK business requirements while remaining aligned to the global Workday strategy, architecture and operating model.**
**Operating as the senior technology lead for the programme, the role brings together business, HR, technology and global Workday teams to deliver a scalable, sustainable and globally aligned solution.**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Programme Technology Leadership**
* **Lead the end-to-end technology delivery of the News UK Workday implementation, from design and build through testing, cutover, go-live and transition to BAU.**
* **Act as the senior technology lead for the programme, providing overall direction across functional, architecture, integration and data workstreams.**
* **Own the overall technical integrity of the solution and ensure individual workstreams operate as a cohesive programme rather than standalone delivery teams.**
* **Translate programme and business objectives into a clear Workday technology strategy and delivery roadmap.**
* **Provide senior leadership with visibility of technology progress, risks, dependencies and key decisions.**
* **Drive resolution of complex cross-functional and cross-system issues that cannot be resolved within individual workstreams.**
**Workday Functional & Solution Leadership**
* **Oversee the functional design and configuration of Workday capabilities being deployed to News UK.**
* **Ensure News UK requirements are appropriately challenged against existing global Workday design and standards.**
* **Champion a** **global-first / adopt-not-adapt** **approach, balancing local business requirements with the need to protect the integrity and scalability of the global platform.**
* **Provide design authority for significant solution decisions and exceptions to global standards.**
* **Ensure functional solutions consider downstream impacts across security, integrations, reporting, data and operational support.**
**Architecture & Design**
* **Own the overall solution architecture for the implementation and ensure Workday is appropriately integrated within the wider News UK and News Corp technology landscape.**
* **Establish and govern architectural principles, design standards and decision-making processes.**
* **Lead cross-functional design decisions where requirements span Workday, payroll, identity, finance or other enterprise platforms.**
* **Partner with enterprise and solution architects to ensure alignment with wider technology strategy.**
* **Identify architectural risks, technical debt and long-term support implications before design decisions are approved.**
**Integrations**
* **Provide leadership and governance across the programme's integration portfolio.**
* **Ensure integration architecture supports both News UK requirements and the global Workday operating model.**
* **Oversee integration design, build, testing and deployment across Workday and dependent systems.**
* **Manage complex dependencies between Workday, payroll, identity management and other downstream/upstream platforms.**
* **Ensure appropriate integration monitoring, ownership and support arrangements are established ahead of go-live.**
**Data Migration**
* **Own technology oversight of the end-to-end data migration strategy.**
* **Ensure appropriate approaches are established for data extraction, transformation, cleansing, mapping, validation and loading.**
* **Establish clear accountability between business data owners, functional teams and technical delivery teams.**
* **Oversee migration cycles and ensure lessons from each cycle are incorporated into subsequent loads.**
* **Ensure appropriate reconciliation and data quality controls are in place to support business and programme sign-off.**
**Testing, Cutover & Go-Live**
* **Ensure the technology solution is ready to progress through key programme toll gates, including design completion, SIT, UAT and production deployment.**
* **Oversee resolution of cross-workstream defects and technical issues.**
* **Lead technology cutover planning and coordinate dependencies across functional configuration, integrations, security and data.**
* **Own technology readiness for go-live and contribute to the overall programme go/no-go recommendation.**
* **Ensure appropriate hypercare and transition-to-support arrangements are established.**
**Governance & Risk**
* **Establish effective technology governance across all Workday delivery workstreams.**
* **Maintain oversight of technology risks, issues, assumptions and dependencies and ensure appropriate mitigation plans are in place.**
* **Present technology status, risks and key decisions to programme leadership and Steering Committees.**
* **Ensure appropriate controls, documentation, auditability and governance are embedded throughout delivery.**
* **Escalate material risks and decisions where programme objectives, global standards or delivery timelines may be impacted.**
**Leadership & Stakeholder Management**
* **Lead a multidisciplinary team spanning Workday functional consultants, architects, integration specialists, data specialists and other technology resources.**
* **Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders across News UK, News Corp Global Technology, HR, Finance, Payroll and other functions.**
* **Act as the primary technology escalation point for the Workday implementation.**
* **Create clarity of accountability across global, local and partner teams operating within a complex matrix environment.**
* **Coach and support workstream leads while maintaining accountability for the overall technology outcome.**
**Key Accountabilities**
**The role is ultimately accountable for:**
* **Successful technology delivery of the News UK Workday implementation.**
* **Integrity of the end-to-end Workday solution.**
* **Alignment between News UK requirements and the global Workday platform.**
* **Cohesion across functional, architecture, integration and data workstreams.**
* **Technology readiness for testing, cutover and go-live.**
* **Effective management of technology risks and dependencies.**
* **A sustainable transition from programme delivery into the global Workday support model.**
**Experience & Skills**
* **Significant experience leading large-scale Workday implementations or transformation programmes.**
* **Deep understanding of Workday HCM and enterprise HR technology.**
* **Strong understanding of Workday architecture, integrations, security and data migration.**
* **Demonstrable experience leading multidisciplinary technology teams across complex global organisations.**
* **Experience integrating new businesses, regions or operating companies into an established global Workday tenant.**
* **Strong understanding of global template versus local requirement decision-making.**
* **Experience working with systems integrators and offshore/onshore delivery teams.**
* **Strong programme governance, risk management and delivery experience.**
* **Ability to operate credibly with both highly technical teams and senior business executives.**
* **Excellent stakeholder management, influencing and decision-making skills.**
* **Ability to simplify complex technical issues and communicate their business impact to executive audiences.**
**Leadership Profile**
**This is a senior delivery leadership role requiring someone who can operate across** **strategy, architecture and execution** **. The successful individual will be comfortable moving between detailed Workday design discussions and executive-level programme conversations, challenging both business and technical teams where necessary.**
**They will combine deep Workday expertise with broad enterprise technology leadership and will take accountability not simply for delivering individual workstreams, but for ensuring that the** **entire Workday solution works as one coherent, sustainable platform** **.**

**Department:** Finance **Reports to:** Head of Credit **Location:** NMBS Head Office / hybrid working as agreed **Document purpose:** This role profile sets out the core purpose, responsibilities, performance standards and personal attributes required for the Senior Credit Risk Analyst role in 2026.
## Role purpose
The Senior Credit Risk Analyst supports disciplined credit risk management across the NMBS member base, with a particular focus on higher-value credit exposures, financial statement review, credit-limit recommendations and management information. The role provides analytical insight to the Head of Credit and wider Finance team, helping NMBS make informed, timely and commercially balanced credit decisions.
In a challenging trading environment, the role is expected to strengthen NMBS’s credit control capability by enhancing the quality of risk analysis, supporting member engagement, enhancing reporting and helping the Credit Risk team work in a more efficient, consistent and proactive way.
## Key responsibilities
### Credit risk analysis and credit-limit management
* Perform detailed credit risk analysis on members to support the credit decision-making process.
* Review annual financial statements, management accounts and other financial information received from members.
* Identify financial stress indicators, trading concerns, liquidity pressures and other emerging risk signals.
* Assess member creditworthiness and provide clear recommendations to the Head of Credit on appropriate credit-limit setting.
* Take ownership of a defined portfolio of higher-value member credit limits and manage these proactively from a credit risk perspective.
* Support the Head of Credit with annual member credit reviews and ad hoc risk assessments.
* Engage with members’ finance and commercial teams where required, to obtain information, understand trading context and support effective credit review.
* Attend member meetings where appropriate to discuss financial statements, credit position and risk-related matters.
### Reporting, management information and insight
* Produce clear, accurate and timely reports relating to the management of the back-office credit risk process.
* Prepare a monthly credit risk report for the Head of Credit, highlighting key exposures, movements, risks, actions and recommendations.
* Track agreed KPIs and provide evidence-based commentary on progress, exceptions and areas requiring attention.
* Improve the quality and consistency of credit risk reporting so that outputs are useful, actionable and suitable for senior review.
* Use data and analysis to identify trends, recurring issues and opportunities for process improvement.
### Team support and process improvement
* Support Credit Risk team members by sharing knowledge, best practice and practical guidance.
* Help develop smarter, more efficient and consistent ways of working within the Credit Risk team.
* Contribute to process improvement across credit checking, member review, credit-limit monitoring and reporting.
* Bring forward ideas and initiatives that improve control, accuracy, productivity or member service.
* Assist in all areas of credit management as required, particularly during periods of increased workload or business pressure.
### Member, supplier and internal stakeholder engagement
* Maintain a professional, customer-focused approach when dealing with members, suppliers and internal stakeholders.
* Communicate clearly and confidently by telephone, email and in meetings.
* Build strong working relationships across Finance, Credit Risk and the wider NMBS business.
* Escalate concerns promptly and constructively, ensuring that risks are visible and understood.
* Represent the Credit Risk function professionally when engaging with members and external contacts.
### General responsibilities
* Work in line with NMBS policies, procedures and standards.
* Maintain confidentiality when handling member financial information and commercially sensitive data.
* Support the wider Finance team and Head of Credit with additional duties that are appropriate to the role and business needs.
## Performance standards
The role holder will be expected to demonstrate the following standards:
* Strong experience in credit control, credit risk management or a closely related finance discipline.
* Ability to interpret financial statements, management accounts and supporting financial information.
* Sound judgement in identifying financial stress signals and assessing the level of risk presented.
* Ability to work under pressure, prioritise effectively and meet required deadlines.
* Delivery of agreed objectives and KPIs, both individually and as part of the wider team.
* High standards of accuracy, attention to detail and consistency in analysis and reporting.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership of tasks and make well-reasoned recommendations.
* Professional communication style, including an excellent telephone manner and clear written communication.
* Willingness to travel within the UK where required for member meetings.
* Flexibility to support the business outside standard working hours where this is reasonably required.
* Openness to change, continuous improvement and constructive feedback.
## Personal attributes
The role holder should demonstrate:
* Strong analytical thinking and a structured approach to problem solving.
* Self-motivation and the ability to work proactively on their own initiative.
* A collaborative approach and willingness to support colleagues within a close-knit team.
* Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.
* Confidence in building relationships with members, suppliers and internal stakeholders.
* A practical, commercially aware approach to credit risk assessment.
* Professional resilience and the ability to remain calm under pressure.
* A positive attitude, with a drive to deliver high-quality work and continuous improvement.

Northern Trust Asset Management (“NTAM”) is seeking a Database and Content Specialist to join our global RFP team. The successful candidate will partner closely with our Consultant Database Specialist, supporting platforms such as eVestment and Omni Complete, and will work alongside our Content Specialist, providing support through Qvidian. As a Database and Content Specialist within NTAM’s global RFP function, the role supports client and consultant relationships through highquality content and data management across multiple geographies. Working closely with Client Relationship Managers, Sales Specialists, Consultant Relations Directors, and global subject matter experts, the partner will manage and maintain information across eVestment and other thirdparty consultant databases, as well as maintain and enhance RFP content within the Qvidian platform.
This is a globally integrated role, requiring close collaboration with stakeholders across regions and time zones. The successful candidate will bring a global mindset, strong attention to detail, and relevant experience managing RFP and consultant database content. Direct experience with NTAM’s platforms is highly valued; however, experience with other RFP and content management systems (such as RFPIO, Loopio, Dasseti, or similar tools) is considered transferable.

· Assist the content manager in maintaining the RFP database (Qvidian) by engaging with SMEs, flagging outdated or expired content, and ensuring consistency across all submissions and platforms.
· Partner with crossfunctional teams globally to ensure firmlevel and productlevel information remains accurate, current, and aligned across consultant databases and RFP responses.

· College degree required, preferably in finance or economics.
· 1-3 years of experience in financial services; experience in asset management is preferred.
· Experience with RFP and consultant database platforms is key. Direct experience with Evestment, Omni Complete and Qvidian desirable; experience with other platforms (e.g., RFPIO, Loopio, DASSA/TI Diligence, or comparable systems) is highly transferable and valued.
· General knowledge of equity and fixed income investment concepts.
· Ability to multitask and manage conflicting priorities and workflows within a fastpaced, globally distributed environment.
· Strong analytical, organizational, and qualitycontrol skills, with high attention to detail.
· Excellent time management and communication skills, with the confidence to engage proactively with global stakeholders.
· Experience with Microsoft Office products (Word, Excel, and Teams).

As a Northern Trust partner, greater achievements await. You will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture in an organization where financial strength and stability is an asset that emboldens us to explore new ideas.

Do you thrive at the intersection of data science, human health and strategic decision-making? Join Novo Nordisk as a Data Science Specialist and help drive critical early R&D decisions by applying advanced analytics, machine learning, causal inference and AI to some of the most important questions in drug discovery and development.
**Your new role**
As a Data Science Specialist, you will be a senior individual contributor within Computational Real-World Evidence (cRWE), helping convert large-scale observational human data into decision-ready evidence that supports disease understanding, target discovery, target maturation and early development decisions.
Working across diverse scientific disciplines, you will provide both hands-on analytical leadership and strategic guidance, ensuring that scientific questions are translated into robust analytical approaches that influence portfolio and pipeline decisions.
Your key responsibilities will include:
* Leading high-priority data science projects that support preclinical and early development decision-making.
* Developing and implementing analytical and agenticAI approaches across causal inference, statistical modelling, machine learning, deep learning and multimodal data analysis.
* Translating biological, clinical and portfolio questions into executable analysis plans and actionable evidence.
* Driving scientific quality, reproducibility and analytical excellence across projects, ensuring appropriate interpretation of uncertainty, bias and causality.
You will work closely with experts across research, biology, epidemiology, translational medicine, clinical development and data science to generate evidence that can meaningfully impact strategic R&D decisions.
**Your new department**
Computational Real-World Evidence (cRWE) is part of Data Science within the AI & Digital Innovation organisation. The team applies causal inference, advanced statistics, machine learning and artificial intelligence to population-level longitudinal datasets, including electronic health records, claims data, disease registries and large human cohorts.
Our work focuses on the early stages of the R&D value chain, helping scientists better understand diseases, identify patient subgroups, validate targets and strengthen the evidence required before first human dose.
You will join a highly collaborative, international team where scientific curiosity, innovation and methodological excellence are valued equally. The environment offers a unique opportunity to work on complex biomedical questions while contributing to the evolution of advanced data science and agenticAI capabilities across Novo.

To succeed in this role, you combine deep technical expertise with scientific judgement, strong communication skills and a passion for solving complex healthcare challenges.

* A PhD or equivalent research experience in data science, statistics, mathematics, physics, computer science, computational biology or another quantitative discipline.

* Strong programming skills in Python and/or R, including experience working in cloud-based high-performance computing environments and reproducible research practices.

Every day we seek the solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with determination, constant curiosity and a commitment to finding better ways forward. Nscale is the GPU cloud engineered for AI. We provide cost-effective, high-performance infrastructure for AI start-ups and large enterprise customers. Our GPU cloud strengthens technical capabilities and directly supports strategic business outcomes, including cost management, rapid innovation, and environmental responsibility.

We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you’ll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you’ll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future.
# **About the Role**
The Network Engineering Team is responsible for the design, validation, and ongoing operation of all networking services that underpin both the internal management platform and the customer-facing cloud infrastructure — including high-performance Ethernet fabrics, InfiniBand, WAN connectivity, and data center networking. The team also acts as a 3rd/4th line escalation point for the support organization.
As a Staff Network Engineer, you will be a technical authority for Nscale’s AI-optimized network fabrics. You will drive the technical direction across low-latency, high-bandwidth InfiniBand and Ethernet networks supporting large-scale training and inference workloads; own critical technical domains end to end; and raise the bar for architecture, automation, operational rigor, and engineering standards across the organization.
You will combine deep hands-on engineering with broad architectural influence. You’ll define reference architectures, drive consistency across sites, lead complex technical decisions and escalations, and mentor engineers while partnering closely with deployment, data center operations, platform engineering, and vendors.
# **What You'll Be Doing**
* Define, design, validate, and evolve large-scale InfiniBand/RoCE and Ethernet fabric architectures at rack, row, and data center scale, with tight integration to bare-metal provisioning and cluster management systems.
* Own technical direction for high-performance Ethernet fabrics, including BGP, EVPN, VXLAN, LACP, and QoS, and establish reference architectures and standards implemented consistently across sites.
* Design and engineer perimeter and security infrastructure — firewalls, NAT, VPN, and security policy architecture — across WAN and data center edge environments.
* Lead network automation strategy in a GitOps model, building and guiding Python/Ansible tooling for provisioning, configuration validation, and compliance, with version-controlled configuration and CI/CD-driven change across multi-vendor environments.
* Drive operational excellence by leading complex escalations and root-cause analysis for performance and stability issues, and systematically reducing reactive toil through runbooks, automation, and measurable SLOs.
* Set the direction for network observability, telemetry, monitoring, and alerting to provide clear visibility into fabric health, performance, and traffic patterns.
* Ensure the accuracy and reliability of source-of-truth network inventory and configuration data, with changes flowing through structured engineering and change-management practices.
* Partner with deployment, data center operations, platform engineering, systems, storage, and vendors on new site delivery and platform evolution.
* Act as a technical mentor and force multiplier across the team through architecture reviews, design reviews, incident leadership, documentation, and knowledge sharing.
* Identify systemic risks and architectural gaps across sites and drive durable solutions that improve scalability, reliability, and operational simplicity.
# **About You (Skills / Qualifications)**
* 10+ years of network engineering experience, with significant depth in HPC, AI, hyperscale, or large-scale data center environments.
* Extensive hands-on experience with RDMA-aware networking for AI/HPC workloads, including InfiniBand and/or RoCE, subnet managers such as OpenSM/UFM, and fabric orchestration.
* Expert-level knowledge of modern data center routing and control planes, including BGP, EVPN-VXLAN, and Clos/spine-leaf architectures, with production experience on platforms such as Cumulus, Nokia, or Arista EOS.
* Strong network automation expertise using Python and Ansible, Git-based workflows, and modern infrastructure-as-code and pipeline tooling such as Terraform, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions; you treat the network as code rather than managing devices by hand.
* Deep design and engineering experience with firewall platforms such as Juniper SRX and/or Palo Alto, including security policy architecture, high-availability design, and multi-tenant segmentation.
* Experience designing network telemetry and observability for high-throughput, performance-sensitive environments.
* Proven ability to lead complex technical decisions and incidents across networking, systems, storage, and HPC/AI workload teams, with the judgment to balance performance, reliability, operability, and delivery velocity.
* Demonstrated experience defining architecture, standards, and technical strategy beyond a single project or site, and influencing engineering teams without relying on formal authority.
* Strong communication and mentoring skills, with the ability to make complex technical trade-offs clear to engineering leaders, operators, and cross-functional partners.
* Hands-on, adaptable, and comfortable operating with high ownership in a fast-paced environment building next-generation infrastructure for ML scale-out.

# **Senior Research Scientist – Atomic and Optical Physics**
**Salary & Benefits:** Competitive
**Department:** Research & Development
**Reports to:** Head of Future Systems
**Job Type:** Full time
**Location:** Central London, On-site (lab-based)
**About us**
ORCA Computing (“ORCA”) is at the forefront of a new era in high-performance computing, developing full-stack photonic quantum systems designed to transform how organisations tackle machine learning, generative AI, and complex optimisation challenges. Headquartered in London, ORCA has delivered eleven on-premises quantum computers worldwide – demonstrating that its technology is not theoretical but already delivering real world results.
At the core of ORCA’s innovation is its hybrid quantum-classical architecture, engineered for seamless integration into existing AI and HPC infrastructure. Its current PT-2 system, a rack-mounted quantum computer, connects directly to GPU clusters via NVIDIA’s CUDA-Q platform, enabling accelerated AI workloads with significantly lower energy consumption than traditional silicon-based systems. Backed by a strong portfolio of patent families spanning photonic integrated circuits, quantum memory, and multiplexing technologies, ORCA is enabling enterprises, research institutions, and HPC operators to unlock new levels of performance, efficiency, and scalability.
As ORCA prepares to launch its next-generation PT-3 system, the company is entering a pivotal phase of growth and technological advancement. Its solutions are already being embedded into generative AI pipelines, delivering measurable improvements in model performance, while also addressing the rising energy demands of large-scale AI adoption. With a focus on practical deployment and a clear roadmap to fault-tolerant quantum computing, ORCA is leading the development and deployment of quantum technology, providing a commercially viable path to the future of computing.
**The role**
We are looking for a Senior Research Scientist to develop, build, and operate experimental systems underpinning ORCA’s atom-mediated nonlinear protocols for photon-photon gates. The role sits at the intersection of cold-atom physics, cavity-QED and experimental quantum optics, with a focus on integrating high-performance optical cavities into robust experimental demonstrators.
**What you will do**
* Design, build, and operate systems for trapping and delivering atomic ensembles into optical microcavities.
* Develop and optimise cavity coupling, state preparation, and locking techniques for stable and reliable atom-cavity interactions.
* Implement and characterise ORCA’s nonlinear protocols on these platforms and drive improvements towards strong photon–photon quantum gates.
* Work closely with the wider Research team to engineer the system for high performance, repeatability, and integration into ORCA’s photonic quantum computing platform.
* Contribute to experimental strategy and future research directions based on measured performance, technical risks, and opportunities for improvement.
* Advance ORCA’s scientific and commercial leadership through high-quality publications, patent filings, internal reviews, and by advising stakeholders on future research directions.
**What you will bring**
* A PhD in physics or a related discipline, or equivalent research experience.
* A strong background in AMO physics and quantum optics.
* Extensive hands-on experience building and operating cold-atom experiments, including for example, laser cooling, magneto-optical traps, dipole trapping, and ultra-high-vacuum systems.
* Experience interfacing atoms with optical cavities or a closely related cavity-QED background, including cavity locking and laser frequency stabilisation.
* A track record of taking complex quantum optics or AMO experiments from design through construction to reliable, high-performance operation.
**Nice to have**
* Experience preparing high-density, high-optical-depth atomic ensembles.
* Experience with high-efficiency fibre coupling, single-photon detection, or quantum optics at the single-photon level.
* Experience developing experiment control, automation, data acquisition, or optimisation tools.
* Experience turning laboratory experiments into robust, deployable systems.
* Familiarity with photonic quantum computing.
**Who we are looking for**
* Ability to focus on results that deliver real, working systems: building for reliability and repeatability, not just one-off demonstrations.
* Can manage ambiguity: you can make progress and trade-offs even when data is incomplete or assumptions evolve.
* Cross-functional mindset: you enjoy working with theorists, engineers, and leadership to drive aligned outcomes.
* Intellectual humility: you are confident challenging assumptions, and just as open to having your own challenged.
**Why join us**
Joining ORCA Computing offers the opportunity to work at the forefront of quantum technology, where innovation is already delivering real-world impact. Across commercial, operational, and product roles, you’ll collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to bring advanced quantum systems to market and help integrate quantum capabilities into modern AI and data centre ecosystems.
ORCA provides a rare chance to contribute to a pivotal moment in the evolution of computing. With a culture built on ownership, collaboration, and ambition, the company empowers individuals to solve complex challenges and shape how next-generation quantum technologies are developed, deployed, and scaled across industries – driving a more efficient and powerful future for AI and compute.
**How to apply**
Please send your CV and a brief introduction (one paragraph is fine!) to: careers@orcacomputing.com.

For two years, Sofar Singles nights have brought people together around live music, with events ranging from 80 to 300 guests. Now we want to make it one of London's go-to nights for single people, with consistently sold-out shows every month, in the city where Sofar began.
### About Us
Sofar Sounds is a global community that connects artists and audiences through unique and intimate experiences. Sofar shows transform everyday spaces – from living rooms and rooftops, to boutiques and museums – into captivating venues for intimate gigs, creating inclusive experiences that bring people closer together. As **London Singles Producer**, you'll curate, produce and promote Sofar's singles events from end to end. You'll set the vision, shape the guest experience, book the artists and venues, and fill every room.
This role is about **building your own audience, not borrowing ours.** You'll bring or build your own promotional channels, such as social accounts, communities, mailing lists, partnerships and on-the-ground networks, and grow ticket sales through them. While Sofar London’s marketing channels will support your efforts, you won’t be relying on them. You'll also own one of the most important parts of a great singles night: **a balanced room.** Attracting men consistently is the hardest part of singles events, and it's where this role will make or break. We want someone who has clear, practical ideas for solving it and will test and refine them every month. *Note: Currently, these events are predominantly targeted toward heterosexual singles, but we welcome all genders and sexual orientations. We would be interested in exploring opportunities for Queer singles nights with the right candidate, but it’s not a requirement for this role.*
You live and breathe community experiences. You're always discovering unique venues, formats and ideas that create real connections, and you have networks you can tap into to make events happen. Like all Sofar Producers, you're entrepreneurial, resourceful and driven. Whether it's a creative ticket push or a day-of-event curveball, you make things happen and thrive on the challenge.
*Our Producers are freelancers who earn commission-based pay. Your schedule is flexible, but much of the work takes place on evenings and weekends.*
### What You'll Do
**Own and grow Sofar Singles in London**
* Build a vision for London's singles programming, covering monthly show volume, neighbourhoods, themes and formats, and work with the Global Communities team to put it into action.
* Take full ownership of ticket sales and profitability for every show, tracking performance to ensure healthy, sustainable growth.
**Build and run your own promotional engine**

* Monitor ratios in real time and adjust promotion before the event, not after.

* Design event flow, activities and icebreakers that help guests meet and connect naturally, never forced.
* Use your knowledge of London's dating and social scene to choose venues, programming and atmospheres that feel welcoming and resonate with each audience.

* Own the quality of every event, making each night feel special, engaging and rooted in hospitality.

* Share learnings with the Global Communities team and help shape Sofar's singles initiatives more broadly.
* Build relationships with local businesses to drive sponsorships and private event activations tied to singles events.

* You bring professionalism, ownership and hospitality to every interaction with guests, partners, venues and collaborators.

* Gender balance at every event, against an agreed target ratio
