**Senior Software Engineer – SRE Core Infra** London (Hybrid) | Engineering | Full Time
**The Role**
PhysicsX is growing rapidly and so is the infrastructure that underpins our platform. We are building core infrastructure that is reliable, secure, scalable and reproducible across multiple cloud providers and on premises environments. As the platform evolves to serve increasingly complex engineering workloads, the foundational infrastructure layer becomes ever more critical.
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Platform SRE Core Infrastructure team. This role is responsible for the design, provisioning and operation of the shared infrastructure that the entire PhysicsX platform depends on. You will work across infrastructure as code, Kubernetes cluster management, secrets management, GPU drivers, networking and multi tenancy architecture to ensure the platform is dependable, scalable and secure.
This is a role for an engineer who combines deep infrastructure expertise with a reliability engineering mindset and an appreciation for the developer experience of the teams that consume the platform.
**What You Will Do**
* Own the design and delivery of core infrastructure across multi cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure) and on premises environments using Terraform and Crossplane.
* Architect and operate Kubernetes clusters supporting both single tenant and multi tenant workloads, with a strong emphasis on isolation, performance and reliability.
* Define and implement infrastructure provisioning patterns using Crossplane compositions and Terraform modules, ensuring reproducibility and auditability across environments.
* Design and operate secrets management solutions, including dynamic secret provisioning, rotation and fine grained access control integrated with cluster identity.
* Manage and maintain GPU driver configurations and accelerated compute node pools, ensuring compatibility and performance for AI and simulation workloads.
* Own cluster networking design including CNI selection, Istio service mesh integration, ingress strategy and cross cluster connectivity.
* Implement and maintain vCluster based multi tenancy to provide strong workload isolation within shared infrastructure.
* Develop lightweight Kubernetes Operators or controllers where automation of infrastructure lifecycle tasks requires it.
* Establish SLOs and reliability targets for core infrastructure components and lead the response to production incidents.
* Partner with security and platform teams to enforce infrastructure governance, network policies and compliance controls.
* Contribute to and uphold engineering standards across the platform organisation.
**What You Bring to the Table**
* Kubernetes depth – 5 or more years of professional experience operating Kubernetes in production. You have a thorough understanding of cluster architecture, the scheduler, networking, storage and the API lifecycle. Kubernetes certifications such as CKAD, CKA or CKS are highly desirable.
* Crossplane expertise – significant hands on experience designing and operating Crossplane compositions, providers and managed resources in production environments.
* Terraform proficiency – strong experience authoring, structuring and operating Terraform at scale, including state management, module design and CI integration.
* Multi cloud and on premises – practical experience operating infrastructure across more than one cloud provider and on premises environments, with an understanding of the differences in identity, networking and storage.
* Multi tenancy architecture – experience designing and implementing both single tenant and multi tenant Kubernetes architectures, with strong views on isolation, resource governance and operational overhead.
* Secrets management – experience with tools such as Vault, External Secrets Operator or cloud native secret stores, including dynamic provisioning and rotation.
* Networking – solid knowledge of Kubernetes networking, CNI plugins, Istio service mesh and ingress patterns. Experience with cross cluster or hybrid connectivity is valuable.
* vCluster and virtual clusters – experience using vCluster or similar tooling to provide lightweight, isolated Kubernetes environments within shared clusters.
* GPU and accelerated compute – familiarity with GPU driver management, device plugins and the operational considerations of running accelerated workloads in Kubernetes.
* Kubernetes Operators – at least lightweight experience writing or extending Kubernetes Operators or controllers, ideally in Golang or Python.
* Software engineering capability – you are comfortable writing code to automate and extend infrastructure. Python and Golang are the primary languages used across the platform. Exposure to functional programming languages such as Erlang, Elixir or OCaml is appreciated.
* Platform engineering mindset – you think about infrastructure as a product consumed by engineering teams and prioritise usability, documentation and long term maintainability.
* Distributed systems experience – a solid grounding in distributed systems concepts, including failure modes, consistency and the operational challenges of running systems at scale.

* Experience with GitOps workflows using tools such as Argo CD or Flux.
* Contributions to open source infrastructure or Kubernetes ecosystem projects.

## **About Pleo**
Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.
The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.
Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.
## **About the role**
We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our Bank Infrastructure team at Pleo. This team builds and maintains the payment rails that power Pleo's money movement, integrating with banks and payment partners to handle inbound and outbound bank transfers reliably and at scale. You'll be working on some of the most critical systems at Pleo: the infrastructure that guarantees that each financial transaction, whether incoming, outgoing, or internal, is processed and settled with absolute accuracy, on time, and with the resilience to recover gracefully when things go wrong.
If you're excited by the challenge of building highly reliable financial systems and want to work in a culture that values transparency, collaboration, and engineering excellence, this role is for you.
## **What you’ll be doing**
As a Senior Backend Engineer on Bank Infrastructure, you will:
* Design, build, and maintain integrations with banks and payment partners across multiple payment schemes (SEPA, Faster Payments, SWIFT, and others).
* Own the reliability and correctness of inbound and outbound payment flows, including reconciliation, settlement, and exception handling.
* Architect systems that are resilient to partner outages, network failures, and edge cases inherent in financial messaging.
* Lead initiatives to improve system observability, fault tolerance, and operational excellence across payment rails.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including compliance, finance operations, and product to evolve Pleo's payment capabilities.
* Participate in code reviews, post-mortems, and provide mentorship to other engineers.
* Proactively address technical debt and guide the team through technical challenges and migrations.
## **What you bring**
You'll thrive in this role if you have:
* Hands-on experience building payment integrations, bank APIs, payment scheme integrations, or financial messaging formats (ISO 20022, SWIFT, SEPA, Faster Payments, or similar).
* Strong understanding of payment flows end-to-end: payment initiation, routing, reconciliation, settlement, and exception/failure handling.
* Experience designing and operating highly available, resilient distributed systems with robust error recovery and observability.
* Expertise in server-side development, ideally Kotlin or Java, with strong experience in microservices and distributed systems.
* Proficiency with relational databases (PostgreSQL), cloud environments (AWS, Kubernetes), and observability tooling (e.g. Grafana).
* Awareness of payment compliance and regulatory considerations (e.g. AML, sanctions screening, PSD2) is a plus.
* Understanding of safeguarding of customer funds and the impact of money movement pipelines.
* Strong problem-solving skills and experience owning production payment systems through incidents and operational complexity.
* High proficiency with AI-enhanced development tools (such as GitHub Copilot or Claude) as integrated partners for system design, documentation, and code generation.
* Willingness to deepen your AI fluency as Pleo scales AI adoption across engineering. We're building a culture where thoughtful AI use for delivery velocity and quality.
* Proven ability to structure complex engineering problems for AI collaboration, including writing precise specifications, validating generated outputs, and iterative development.
* A proactive drive to expand your AI fluency as we scale adoption to enhance delivery velocity and maintain high engineering quality across our organisation.
* A collaborative mindset and the ability to mentor and upskill teammates.
## **Who you’ll be working with and reporting to**
You'll report to the Engineering Manager for Bank Infrastructure and work closely with cross-functional teams spanning product, finance operations, compliance, and other engineering squads within Pleo's Payments organisation. Bank Infrastructure is foundational to nearly everything Pleo does, your work will have direct dependencies with and from Card Infrastructure, Credit, and beyond. You'll collaborate with partners across the business to shape how Pleo moves money reliably at scale.
## **How you’ll develop in this role**
In your first six months at Pleo, you'll:
* Get deep into Pleo's payment rail architecture, understanding how inbound and outbound bank payment flows are built, monitored, and operated.
* Take ownership of meaningful initiatives in the bank integration or payment operations domain and drive them from design to production.
* Build relationships across the engineering organisation, contributing to code reviews and technical discussions beyond your immediate team.
* Grow your expertise in high-reliability, mission-critical financial infrastructure while contributing to Pleo's broader engineering culture.
We're committed to supporting your growth, whether through expanding your payment systems expertise, stepping into broader architectural influence, or taking on technical leadership responsibilities as Pleo scales.
## **Show me the benefits!**
💳 Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)
🍜 Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office
🏥 Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis
🌴 We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays
🏠 For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options
🏖️ Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice
❤️‍🩹 We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far
👶 Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work
## **The interview process**
We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:
1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.
2. Coding Interview (Multiple choice)
3. System Design (whiteboarding session)
4. Engineering Mananeer Behavioural Interview
Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!
Last time we hired this role, we received hundreds of applicants but could only speak with so many. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:
* CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!
* Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.
* Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.
## **About your application**
* **English first.** Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.
* **A fair look for everyone.** Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.
* **Diversity drives us.** We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.
* **Interview at your best.** We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.
* **Your data is safe.** When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.
* **Applying for multiple roles?** Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.
* **Reapplying.** If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

At PlotBox, our mission is to help those dealing with death and those who serve them.

job_title: Associate Director, Global Dossier and Value Communicates
job_description:
**Precision AQ** is seeking an enthusiastic, highly skilled **Associate Director**, to join our growing **Global Dossier and Value Communication team**. This role is ideal for an experienced market access or medical writer who is passionate about communicating healthcare innovation and shaping evidence-based value narratives that support patient access to new technologies.
As an **Associate Director,** on the **Global Dossier and Value Communications team**, you will play a pivotal role across the business—leading the development of high‐quality market access deliverables, guiding project teams, helping to define quality standards, and contributing to the strategic growth of our writing function. You will work closely with colleagues across HEOR and access strategy, health economics, evidence synthesis, and project management, as well as directly with clients, external experts, and partner agencies.
**Key Responsibilities**
**Leadership & Delivery**
* Act as the designated lead writer on projects, delivering evidence-based, fully referenced content to a consistently high standard and within agreed timelines.
* Manage your own and your team’s workload, plan project deliverables, and ensure smooth execution across multiple concurrent workstreams.
* Work across a wide range of therapeutic areas and market access deliverables, including:
+ JCA and HTA submissions
+ Global value dossiers
+ AMCP dossiers
+ Value proposition slide decks
+ Objection handlers
**Business & Team Contribution**
+ Lead BD activities independently generating leads measured against a £350,000 annual target
* Contribute to company-wide initiatives, including working groups, training programmes, and social activities.
* Support business development activities such as proposal writing, participating in introductory client calls, and contributing to pitches.
**Quality & Strategic Input**
* Ensure all client deliverables meet the highest quality standards through rigorous writing, editing, and quality control.
* Shape the strategic direction of writing deliverables to ensure they are fit for purpose and aligned with client objectives.
* Conduct desk research, literature reviews, data validation, and reference management using client approval systems.
**Collaboration & Communication**
* Work collaboratively with multidisciplinary internal teams and external stakeholders, including clients and key opinion leaders.
* Lead aspects of project workstreams, including intellectual design, timeline development, meeting leadership, and communication.
**Team Development**
* Support team growth and development through recruitment efforts.
* Providing mentorship, guidance, and support to junior and mid‐level writers, inspiring high performance and professional growth.
* Work with Directors to establish quality standards and training materials for new starters.
**Requirements**
**Required:**
* Minimum of 8 years of relevant industry experience, or an equivalent combination of advanced education and experience.
* A life sciences degree (or equivalent);
* Demonstrable experience developing market access materials, including JCA submissions, HTA submissions, GVDs, value propositions, and related deliverables.
* Experience managing and/or mentoring writers.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and bibliographic software (e.g., EndNote).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to assimilate complex information quickly and accurately.
* Strong organisational skills, autonomy, and ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
* High attention to detail, integrity, and commitment to confidentiality.
* Proactive mindset with a positive, solutions-oriented approach.
**Preferred**
* Masters Degree preferred,
* PhD in a life sciences discipline, is desirable
* Experience contributing to business development activities.

**We help companies get compensation right.**
What we get paid at work has a massive impact on our lives, and it’s one of the biggest factors in hiring and retaining talent - and yet so many companies struggle to get it right. They simply have no choice but to rely on poor data and unsophisticated tools for their pay decisions. That’s why we created Ravio.
We help many of the world’s most innovative and ambitious companies build stronger teams and reach their goals through better compensation. Our real-time data platform brings compensation into the modern age, tracking the market across all compensation types from salary to equity and benefits.
Ravio is growing fast, which means you can too. We’ve established ourselves as the European leader in our space serving more than 1,200 clients, and now have our sights set on becoming the global go to place for compensation data and tools for managing compensation.
Joining a startup and scaling it into a global product is one of the most challenging and rewarding experiences a career can offer. If that sounds exciting to you, you’re in the right place.
**The role**
We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join our engineering team and play a major role in our technical leadership during a significant platform shift.
Ravio is moving from a traditional SaaS posture to a platform built around agents - parent agents fronting our compensation data, specialist agents underneath, durable workflows, an MCP-based tool layer, and an eval harness to maintain consistency. You’ll own architecture and technical design across the stack: the customer-facing web app, the agentic platform, and the shared infrastructure connecting them.
You’ll bring system design depth - the kind that holds up under load, failure, and coordination across services and teams. You’ll continue to raise the bar on code quality, reliability, and the technical decisions that shape what we ship.
This is a hands-on individual contributor role - leading technical decision-making and tackling the hardest problems we encounter. There are also upcoming opportunities to move into management as our company continues to grow, if you wish.
**Requirements**
* 8+ years commercial engineering experience, with a track record of technical leadership during platform shifts - owning architecture, driving decisions, raising the bar through code review and design review, especially where LLM assisted engineering has become the standard
* System design depth as your headline strength. Concrete: durability and consistency under failure, multi-service orchestration, data platforms, performance and cost at scale, observability and ops fluency
* Senior-level fluency in TypeScript and Node, comfortable across the backend (PostgreSQL, GraphQL or HTTP APIs, GCP-shaped infra)
* Comfortable owning code in a distributed monorepo with multiple deployable services
* Ships fast under product pressure - we’re moving from PMF to scale and the role needs that pace

* MCP, Anthropic SDK, or other LLM platform work

From your perspective, there are three critical things to look for when evaluating this role: a company going places, a strong engineering culture, and a role that gives you a true opportunity to have impact as a technical leader.

There’s a lot happening at Ravio right now. We’ve just raised our Series A led by tier 1 US investors Spark Capital, and have acquired the benchmarking business of our competitor - Compete. We’ve got new joiners starting almost every week, and we’re rapidly expanding outside of our core markets in Europe. We need you to help us maintain our velocity and continue to build a scalable org and product.
Our core benchmarking product is at product-market fit, and we have a couple of new modules in the 0-1 phase. This means we’re at an exciting stage that involves 0-to-1 building in some areas, and building for scale in others. That’s true across the business, we’re continuing to expand and experiment, while systemising and doubling down on what is already working well from our seed phase.
Beyond the core product, we’re building Ravio’s agentic platform - parent agents fronting our compensation data with specialist agents underneath, durable workflows on Temporal, an MCP-based tool layer, and an eval harness to maintain consistency. It’s a platform engineering effort with the same care and rigour we apply to the rest of the product. A Staff engineer joining now would help shape the foundations of how Ravio’s product is built for the next phase.
We’d like to think Ravio is a great place to be a Staff engineer - we have technical leaders who know first hand the importance of creating space and focus for engineering teams to do their best work. And you’ll be working alongside many accomplished and world class teammates, who are energised by the work they do and have a high bar for themselves and their colleagues.

# Regulatory Affairs & Quality Assurance Director
Oxford
**Oxford, UK | Reporting to VP of Operations | Global travel including Boston, USA**
***(Anticipated start date for this role: January 2027)***
**Job Overview**
The **RAQA Director**, is responsible for the strategic development and execution of the Company's regulatory affairs and quality assurance programs. Refeyn's products are currently sold as research/laboratory instruments rather than medical devices or IVDs, so this role is accountable for general product compliance (e.g. product safety, EMC, labelling, export/customs classification) across the US, EU, NMPA and other major global markets, rather than medical device-specific registrations. The role is also accountable for the execution and administration of Refeyn's electronic Quality Management System (eQMS) and associated Quality Systems, and for monitoring whether future products or customer use-cases trigger medical device, IVD, or other regulated-product obligations.
As Refeyn's customer base increasingly moves from academic research into bioprocessing and industrial-scale biomanufacturing, our instruments are being deployed within, or adjacent to, our customers' GMP-regulated processes. While Refeyn is not itself required to hold GMP certification, this shift requires a comparable level of rigor, traceability and control discipline to that expected of a qualified GMP supplier — spanning supplier/vendor qualification, change control and notification of change, calibration traceability, complaint handling and CAPA, and data integrity controls on instrument software and outputs. This role is accountable for building and embedding those controls so that Refeyn can operate credibly as a supplier of record into GMP and GMP-adjacent environments, without over-rotating the business into the cost and rigidity of full GMP certification.
The Director will manage an internal RAQA team and relationships with external consultants/contractors, as necessary to support RA/QA activities and responsibilities and provide leadership and guidance to the organization on global regulatory and quality matters. The role will drive, promote, and embed a culture of ethics, integrity and continuous improvement focused on delivering quality, compliant products and services to our customers.
Reporting to our VP of Operations, this role is pivotal in growing the business whilst maintaining our customer focus through developing, implementing and improving our eQMS, regulatory strategy, processes and procedures. To ensure companywide buy-in and active ownership of the QMS and regulatory requirements, the role requires a person with a comprehensive set of change management skills, experiences, and past successes, combined with openness to learn, adapt and grow with our business.
The role will be based at Refeyn's location in Oxford, UK, with a global reach in line with our company footprint and the customer base. The role will demand global travel to our customers, suppliers and office in Boston, USA.
**Responsibilities**
**Regulatory Affairs**
* Develop, implement and manage Refeyn's global regulatory strategy to ensure compliance with applicable general product regulations (e.g. CE/UKCA marking under EMC and Low Voltage Directives, FCC/IC, RoHS, WEEE, REACH) across target markets.
* Own product labelling, technical documentation and declarations of conformity required for lawful sale as a research/laboratory instrument in each target market.
* Own export control classification (e.g. ECCN/customs codes) and associated compliance for international shipping of instruments and components.
* Monitor evolving customer use-cases, claims and markets to determine if or when medical device, IVD, or other regulated-product frameworks (e.g. FDA, EU MDR/IVDR, NMPA medical device registration) would begin to apply to any part of the product portfolio, and advise the Executive Leadership Team accordingly.
* Manage regulatory agents/distributors and associated registration renewals across global markets.
* Keep abreast of industry developments, forthcoming regulations, guidance, and best practices, and translate these into actionable regulatory and quality strategy
**Quality Management & eQMS**
* Own and administer Refeyn's eQMS, ensuring it meets standards required by US, EU, NMPA and other major regulatory authorities for research, development and commercial activities.
* Develop, implement and manage Refeyn's Quality Management System to enable quality improvements of our products and services at the speed and agility of a rapidly growing, high-tech company.
* Lead the company in the drive for ISO 9001:2015 accreditation. ISO 13485 is not currently required (product is not a medical device/IVD) but should be monitored as an option if the product scope or customer requirements change.
* Implement, own and improve a business process for quality improvements that prioritises customer feedback and manufacturing performance into further product and process development activities.
* Ensure quality metrics comply with best industry standards and practices.
* Ensure overall Quality oversight across the full value chain, from R&D, Sales and Marketing, Supply Chain and Manufacturing to Customer Support and Service, including installation and technical service activities.
* Accountable for supplier/vendor qualification and a risk-based audit and inspection program.
**Bioprocessing/GMP-Adjacent Customer Controls**
* Build and own a framework of GMP-grade controls appropriate to a non-GMP-certified supplier serving bioprocessing and industrial biomanufacturing customers, without requiring full GMP certification of Refeyn itself.
* Own the supplier/vendor qualification relationship with GMP customers, including hosting customer audits and responding to vendor qualification questionnaires.
* Establish and administer a formal change control and notification-of-change (NOC) process for changes that could affect a customer's validated process (e.g. firmware, components, calibration methodology).
* Support customer IQ/OQ/PQ activities with appropriate documentation, protocols and technical input, even where Refeyn does not perform validation directly.
* Ensure data integrity and audit-trail controls on instrument software and outputs are aligned with ALCOA+ principles and customer expectations (e.g. Part 11 / Annex 11-adjacent controls), where instrument data feeds GMP records.
* Own a formal complaint handling and CAPA process that meets the standard expected by GMP-regulated customers.
* Ensure calibration traceability and Certificate of Conformance/Analysis (CoC/CoA) rigor meets the standard required by customer QA organizations.
* Advise the Executive Leadership Team on the trade-offs between building GMP-adjacent controls versus pursuing formal GMP certification as the bioprocessing customer base scales.
**Leadership & Governance**
* Lead and manage internal RAQA team with team members based across USA and UK.
* Establish strong working relationships with external manufacturers of our products and assure alignment of the eQMS and technical documentation with these manufacturers. Ensure products manufactured at manufacturing partners meet company quality standards, government regulations, and customer GMP-adjacent expectations.
* Plan and oversee day-to-day activities of the Quality and Regulatory Affairs function, including management of consultants/auditors as needed to ensure project and business needs are met.
* Communicate significant quality and regulatory risks that may impact product suitability, market access or ongoing compliance in a timely manner to the Executive Leadership Team.
* Ensure the company's vision/mission is implemented through detailed departmental / personal objectives and supported by regular management reviews.
**Person Specification**
**Qualifications**
* 10+ years of relevant experience in Quality and/or Regulatory Affairs management within instrumentation, analytical equipment, or bioprocess equipment manufacturing businesses supplying to Biotech, Pharma, CDMO or other regulated industries.
* University Degree in Life Sciences or Engineering. Equivalent combination of education.
**Knowledge & Experience**
* Extensive knowledge and experience of general product compliance requirements for scientific/laboratory instrumentation sold into the USA, EU, NMPA and other global markets (e.g. CE/UKCA, EMC/LVD, FCC, RoHS, WEEE, REACH, export controls).
* Working knowledge of GxP-adjacent concepts and standards relevant to customers operating under GMP (e.g. ALCOA+ data integrity principles, 21 CFR Part 11 / EU Annex 11-style controls, ISO 13485, ISO 9001:2015) — not because Refeyn is required to hold these, but to credibly support customers who are.
* Direct experience operating as a supplier — not the licence holder — into GMP-regulated customers: surviving customer audits, supplier quality agreements, change notification processes, and CAPA management from the supplier side.
* Familiarity with GAMP 5 and computer system validation concepts where instrument software or data touches GMP records.
* Demonstrated success leading cross-functional teams in the development, implementation, application, and maintenance of eQMS platforms and regulatory submission processes.
* Strategic, tactical and hands-on experience managing quality and regulatory frameworks within the company and across the supply chain and partnership base.
* A hands-on leader with previous managerial experience who leads by example, inspires, and empowers team members.
* Experience developing future quality and regulatory leaders and implementing organizational culture.
* Strong collaborative, influencing and interpersonal skills with excellent verbal, written and presentation skills, with the ability to deal effectively across all levels of management, regulatory agencies, and customer quality organizations.
* Experience of RA/QA within an innovative scientific, engineering and manufacturing environment, ideally including scale-up from academic/research customers into industrial or bioprocessing volume.
* Pragmatic approach – able to judge the right level of control for a non-GMP-certified supplier, without either under-controlling or over-engineering toward unnecessary full GMP certification.
**We know there is no such thing as the perfect candidate and that there is great value in transferrable skills, so please don’t feel you have to tick all of the above boxes to apply!**
**Why work for Refeyn?**
Compensation and core benefits
* Competetive salary
* 25 days annual leave per year in addition to bank holidays
* Up to 7% employer matched pension contribution
* Private health insurance from day one plus critical illness cover, income protection and life insurance
* Give as You Earn and Cycle to Work salary sacrifice schemes.
Family Friendly Benefits
Refeyn offers the Enjoy Benefits Nursery Scheme to employees after 3 months, and new parents can benefit from up to 17 weeks fully paid maternity, adoption and shared parental leave, 4 weeks fully paid paternity leave, plus an annual allowance for emergency childcare.
Supporting your Development
All employees receive access to LinkedIn Learning which offers thousands of courses to support their personal and professional development. We also run frequent training sessions on both hard and soft skills.
**Refeyn is proud to use anonymised hiring practices. Identifying information such as a candidate's name, email address, date of birth and photo will not be visible to the hiring manager when they review CVs.**

You will also contribute to and maintain key architectural deliverables including the architecture model (Capella) and system‐level design descriptions.
This is a role for someone who enjoys solving complex multi‐disciplinary engineering problems and wants to influence the direction of a next‐generation nuclear power plant.
### **We’ll Need You To:**
* Lead significant architectural packages of work, generating design decisions and supporting rationale
* Apply independence, segregation and separation principles to C&I architectural decisions

# Director of Regulatory Strategy and Affairs
**Location:** Hull **Working pattern:** Hybrid, with a minimum of two days per week in our Hull office **Salary:** £67,000–£80,000 per annum, depending on experience and breadth of regulatory expertise **Employment type:** Full-time, permanent **Reports to:** CEO
**About Rubicon**
Rubicon is a specialist regulatory consultancy helping ambitious businesses bring products to market safely, efficiently and with confidence.
Our team supports brands, retailers, manufacturers and marketplaces across a range of regulated product categories, including food supplements, medicines, medical devices and cosmetics.
We work alongside our sister company, Rubicon Bridge, which provides regulatory technology and automated compliance solutions. Together, we combine deep technical expertise with innovative software to help businesses navigate complex regulations and trade internationally.
We are now looking for an experienced and commercially minded Director of Regulatory Affairs to lead Rubicon Technical and its multidisciplinary team of regulatory experts.
**The role**
This is a senior leadership role with responsibility for the performance and continued development of Rubicon Technical’s regulatory services.
You will lead a team of specialists working across food supplements, medicines, medical devices and cosmetics, ensuring that our advice is accurate, practical, commercially relevant and delivered consistently.
The role requires someone who combines strong regulatory expertise with excellent leadership, customer management and commercial judgement.
You will work closely with the CEO, senior leadership team and Rubicon Bridge product teams to shape our regulatory strategy, develop new services and ensure that our technical expertise continues to meet the evolving needs of our customers.
**Key responsibilities**
**Lead our regulatory team**
\* Lead, manage and develop a multidisciplinary team of regulatory experts.
\* Create a high-performing and collaborative culture with clear standards, responsibilities and expectations.
\* Support team members with complex regulatory matters and provide appropriate technical oversight.
\* Identify training, recruitment and resource requirements as the business develops.
\* Ensure workloads are managed effectively and customer projects are delivered on time.
\* Build strong working relationships across Rubicon Technical and Rubicon Bridge.
**Maintain regulatory excellence**
\* Take overall responsibility for the accuracy and consistency of regulatory advice delivered by Rubicon Technical.
\* Establish and maintain robust technical review and governance processes.
\* Ensure advice is evidence-based, clearly communicated and appropriate for each customer’s commercial objectives.
\* Provide senior-level guidance on complex, sensitive or high-risk regulatory issues.
\* Ensure the team remains informed about relevant legislative, regulatory and industry developments.
\* Maintain clear standards for documentation, technical decisions and regulatory governance.
**Support customers**
\* Act as a trusted senior regulatory adviser to key customers.
\* Build strong, long-term relationships with brands, retailers, manufacturers, marketplaces and strategic partners.
\* Translate complex regulatory requirements into clear and practical actions.
\* Support customers entering new markets, launching new products or responding to regulatory challenges.
\* Participate in important customer meetings, pitches and project reviews.
\* Ensure customers receive responsive, commercially useful and technically reliable support.
**Develop the business**
\* Work with the commercial team to shape proposals, scopes of work and regulatory service packages.
\* Support the growth of existing customer accounts and identify opportunities for additional services.
\* Help develop new propositions in response to changing regulation, customer needs and market opportunities.
\* Ensure projects are appropriately scoped, resourced and priced.
\* Take responsibility for the efficient and commercially effective operation of the regulatory function.
\* Contribute to revenue growth, customer retention and the long-term development of Rubicon Technical.
**Connect expertise with technology**
\* Work closely with Rubicon Bridge’s product and technology teams to translate regulatory expertise into scalable software solutions.
\* Help identify areas where regulatory processes can be standardised, automated or supported by technology.
\* Ensure regulatory content and methodologies embedded within the Rubicon Bridge platform remain accurate, practical and robust.
\* Contribute to the future development of regulatory products, databases and automated compliance tools.
\* Help ensure that technology strengthens the consistency, reliability and commercial value of regulatory decision-making.
**About you**
You will be an experienced regulatory leader with the credibility to manage senior specialists, advise complex customers and represent Rubicon Technical externally.
You may have developed your career within a regulatory consultancy, consumer products business, pharmaceutical or medical device company, retailer, manufacturer or regulatory authority.
You will bring:
\* Significant experience in regulatory affairs within one or more of our core categories.
\* Strong working knowledge of UK and European regulatory frameworks.
\* Experience leading and developing regulatory, scientific or technical teams.
\* The ability to oversee specialists working outside your own principal area of expertise.
\* Experience managing complex customer projects and senior stakeholder relationships.
\* Strong commercial awareness and an understanding of how to deliver professional services profitably.
\* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
\* The confidence to challenge, make decisions and provide clear direction.
\* A practical, solutions-focused approach to regulation.
\* The ability to operate effectively within a fast-moving and entrepreneurial business.
\* The ability to work from our Hull office for a minimum of two days each week.
Experience across several of the following areas would be particularly valuable:
\* Food supplements and nutrition.
\* Medicines and borderline products.
\* Medical devices.
\* Cosmetics and personal care.
\* Product classification and market access.
\* Claims, labelling and advertising.
\* International product registrations and notifications.
\* Regulatory due diligence.
\* Regulatory governance.
\* Regulatory technology or digital compliance solutions.
**What we are looking for**
We are not looking for someone who simply identifies regulatory obstacles.
We want a leader who can help customers understand what is possible, make informed decisions and find a compliant route to market.
You will be intellectually curious, calm under pressure and comfortable working across different product categories. You will care deeply about regulatory accuracy while also understanding that advice must be clear, responsive and commercially useful.
You will also be confident working with senior customers, supporting commercial conversations and helping the business build services that are technically robust and commercially sustainable.
Most importantly, you will be excited by the opportunity to lead an exceptional team and help shape the future of a business combining human regulatory expertise with innovative technology.
**Why join Rubicon?**
This is an opportunity to take a central leadership role within a business working at the forefront of regulatory services and technology.
You will have the opportunity to:
\* Lead a talented and highly experienced regulatory team.
\* Work with innovative brands, global retailers and international marketplaces.
\* Shape the future direction of Rubicon Technical.
\* Influence the development of regulatory technology used by businesses around the world.
\* Build new services and capabilities across multiple regulated sectors.
\* Work closely with the senior leadership team and have a genuine impact on the future of the business.
\* Join an ambitious and entrepreneurial company with a clear mission: to make global regulatory compliance simpler, faster and more accessible.

Alongside training, you’ll work on **building and configuring insurance products for our clients** using SchemeServe. This gives you practical, hands-on experience of the platform and the same product-building processes that you'll be teaching to customers.

# Agile Delivery Manager
**About Sedex**
Sedex is a trusted partner for over 100,000 businesses worldwide, helping them create **socially and environmentally sustainable supply chains**. Through our platform's powerful data insights and expert guidance, we simplify the management, assessment, and reporting of sustainability performance.
Our Vision is to be a leader in making global supply chains more socially and environmentally sustainable. Our Mission is To provide data-driven insights, accessible tools, and exceptional services that support businesses in improving environmental, social, and governance (ESG) performance and outcomes.
**The role**
You'll be part of a team of Agile Delivery Managers, playing a key role in ensuring that Sedex's in-house digital products come to market on time, on budget and to a high standard — and that they do what our customers need them to do. The Agile Delivery Manager works closely with Product, Design, Engineering and the business, driving key initiatives efficiently from inception through to market, while ensuring lean, agile practices are followed throughout.
The delivery manager role at Sedex is well established, and respected. You will manage the delivery of strategic development within a value stream, across two or more teams. At the same time, you will work closely with other key stakeholders in your value stream to author the product strategy and roadmap, ensure that it is delivered on-plan and taken to market, and that value strategic goals are met.
**Key responsibilities**
· Play a key role in the governance of your value stream as a member of a cross-functional working group, helping develop the product strategy and roadmap, ensuring a continuous flow of value for teams to work on, and sharing responsibility for hitting strategic value-stream goals
· Own the end-to-end product delivery plan for your value stream and teams, driving the Opportunity-to-Solution pipeline forward — making sure discovery kicks off on time, value hypotheses are tested through experimentation, and solutions are brought to market iteratively, in a controlled and predictable way
· Champion the effective use of AI across the delivery lifecycle, helping teams identify where AI can improve speed, quality or decision-making, while managing the risks that come with AI-enabled ways of working
· Chair working group and bridge crew meetings, ensuring that the ToR is followed, understood by all participants, and that outcomes are assigned, documented and followed up
· Provide continuous, reliable, data-driven status reporting and forecasting on solution development, including cost and delivery
· Manage risks, issues, dependencies, actions and decisions across your teams and across value streams – take care of escalations and urgent decision-making as and when needed
· Continuously monitor and improve flow across your value stream and teams using flow metrics, quickly identifying and removing impediments, and helping teams understand how and where to optimise
· Ensure Jira projects are well maintained and up to date, providing drill-down visibility from Opportunity to Story and enabling reliable delivery metrics
· Work closely with Product, Design and Engineering to ensure work is iterative, prioritised, appropriately sized, and has clearly defined goals and value propositions
· Coach teams to become autonomous and to continuously improve their agile ways of working
· Where needed, support less mature teams in adopting agile practices — for example, helping them run ceremonies like retrospectives, dailies and sprint planning — with a view to enabling full autonomy over time
· Help teams become more product-orientated, and ensure strong communication and collaboration across all roles and disciplines — for example, between Product and Engineering
· Contribute to the continuous improvement of both delivery and product development processes
**Knowledge, skills & experience**
· At least three years' experience in a product and technology delivery role of some kind
· "Profit-centre thinking" — always business and product focused, while understanding the need to balance the constraints and needs of technology and engineering
· Hands-on, and prepared to roll up your sleeves and act as a project manager when needed
· Strong communication skills, with the ability to bridge business stakeholders, product and engineering
· Confident and credible engaging with business stakeholders, up to and including Exec level
· A solid understanding of how to apply agile methods and best practice at every level of the value stream — from idea/opportunity pipeline and governance, through experimentation and solution development, to go-to-market and value realisation
· Naturally methodical and organised, with an eye for detail and the ability to plan complex initiatives
· High-level working knowledge of software development, technology and high-throughput, AI-enabled SDLC — for example, able to help teams manage and mitigate AI-driven cognitive overload

# BDR - Business Development Representative
London
## **About Sedna**
Sedna is at the forefront of revolutionising global trade, serving as the North Star for businesses navigating the complexities of international commerce. Our AI-powered platform is designed to make global trade more efficient, transparent, and sustainable. As we continue to grow and innovate, we are looking for exceptional talent to join our journey and contribute to our mission of transforming global trade.
You can find out more about us on our website: https://sedna.com/
## ## About The Role
Sedna is on a mission to transform how the shipping industry communicates and operates - we're already the platform behind 10 million emails a day for 950+ shipping and trading companies worldwide, and we're just getting started. If you've spent time in the shipping industry and are looking for your next move into a fast-growing tech business, this is exactly the kind of role that makes that jump possible.
As a Business Development Representative, you'll be on the front line of our growth: the first point of contact between Sedna and the shipping companies we want to work with. It's a fantastic entry point into a career in sales and tech - no formal sales background required, just curiosity, drive and, ideally, a bit of first-hand shipping knowledge so you already speak our customers' language.
Working in a fast-growth company means that no day is ever the same! But here are the main responsibilities and tasks you'll undertake while working for us:
### Industry and product knowledge
* Keeping abreast of maritime industry trends to increase your credibility in the industry - e.g. subscribing to blogs/podcasts, reading books, researching case studies.
* Increasing your knowledge of similar, complementary and competing products.
* Learning about the experiences other clients have with Sedna, so that you can apply these successes and learnings to your conversations.
* Using the product extensively - both to make your work successful, but also to learn of its features, value and use cases.
### Pipeline management
* Prioritising your list of accounts based on certain qualifying criteria.
* Researching your accounts, ensuring you have a clear understanding of previous discussions.
* Identifying and gathering information on new and existing contacts within your accounts.
* Leveraging various sales tools to assist with data capturing and research.
* Organising your time and collaborating with Account Executives and your Team Lead to ensure your time is being utilised in the most effective way.
### Contacting, nurturing and qualifying leads
* Leveraging sales and social tools e.g. LinkedIn to network and engage with your leads.
* Sending emails and making outbound calls, videos and voice messages to contacts within your accounts.
* Experimenting with different social engagement tactics.
* Qualifying leads to assess their suitability and readiness for Sedna.
* Building relationships with prospects who are not yet ready to explore Sedna.
* Booking initial meetings, in line with targets.
### Continuous improvement
* Attending initial meetings to learn more about the sales process and Sedna's value.
* Contributing to reporting requirements needed for effective forecasting.
* Reflecting on successes and failures, and making improvements to your ways of working as a result.
* Collaborating with other BDRs and relevant people in the industry to share learnings and to ensure that the collective team is achieving targets and developing.
## ## About You
At Sedna, we believe it's your skills and attributes that ultimately make you successful in a role. Here's what we're looking for:
* **Self motivated** - you are motivated to achieve in this role because of your enthusiasm - you relish pressure from others but don't need it to succeed.

* **Coachable** - this is a genuine entry point into your career, so how fast you learn and adapt matters more than what you've done before.
* **Shipping background a plus** - a couple of years' experience somewhere in the shipping industry (operations, chartering, broking, agency, or similar) is ideal, but not essential. Sessions is building the operating model for the future of restaurants, giving consumers instant access to the brands they love, wherever they live.
The Sessions distribution engine runs through 450+ delivery kitchens and 16 high street restaurants across the UK.
Founded in 2020 and led by ex-Deliveroo MD Dan Warne, Sessions has grown 7x in three years. Our platform has processed over 5 million orders and reaches 60% of the UK population. Our team brings experience from Deliveroo, Amazon, BrewDog, and Gousto.
We scale brands at a pace that redefines what's possible in food. Examples include Miko's Gyros, which went from launch to 100+ live sites in under two months and SoBe Burger, which is live in over 200 delivery locations and has opened 17 physical high street stores.
**🏃‍♂️ We are Agile -** Thrive in fast-pace. We sprint, adapt, and learn. **🌍 We are Ambitious -** Contribute to something big. Watch your career grow bigger. **🤪 We are Fun -**High performance, high fives. Join a team you'll love. **🤖We are Data-Driven -** Turn insights into action. We lead with evidence. 💡**We have Initiative -**Anticipate problems. Drive the solution.
**ABOUT THE ROLE:**
As our **New Brands Operations Manager,** you’ll own the process that decides which brands earn a permanent place in the Sessions network — the single biggest point of leverage in how well New Brands scales.
The team is in growth mode, aiming to increase the volume of brands we work with from 12 a year to 20. As volume increases, the key skill is understanding trade-offs — knowing where to spend time versus not, and what to prioritise.
You’ll work cross-functionally across Studio, Supply Chain and Growth, making sure we’re working towards outcomes rather than just tasks. You’ll also line manage our **Validation Trainer**, who leads the majority of on-site training and floor management for validation launches. It’s a hands-on role: structured enough to scale, detailed enough to get into host kitchens when needed.
**RESPONSIBILITIES:** **Host Operators Support and Relationship Management:**
* Identify the right sites for validation and ensure kitchens are launch-ready.
* Provide support at escalation level for host sites or in the absence of the New Brand Trainer who will be the primary point of contact day to day.
* Conduct regular site visits to assess performance and provide feedback.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with Brand Founders as well as delivery platforms.
* Work closely with various internal teams at Sessions to give the brands the best possible chance of succeeding within the validation period.
**Programme and Project Management:**
* Own the end-to-end validation process, driving it against clear timelines and holding pace as volumes increase.
* Own KPI monitoring and reporting across validation, and run the review process that decides what interventions are needed and which brands progress.
* Build and maintain scalable systems, templates and playbooks so the process holds up as volume grows toward c.20 brands a year.
* Prioritise across the full portfolio of brands in validation, deciding where time and resource should be spent as volumes increase, and why.
* Maintain live visibility of the validation pipeline, so issues within any brand's validation are caught and diagnosed quickly rather than surfacing late.
**Cross-Functional Collaboration:**
* Work and collaborate with Studio, Supply Chain and Growth so validation's needs are reflected in their planning.
* Understand constraints and capacity within each team, and where resource is best spent and which brands are prioritised.
* Draw on the expertise other teams bring, while still owning the decisions and driving validation towards clear outcomes.
* Once a brand has been validated, coordinate with the relevant downstream teams — including UKI — to set both the brand and those teams up for success.
**Continuous Improvement & Systematic Learning:**
* Take a proactive, hypothesis-led approach to validation: capture insight from each brand's pre- and post-validation stages and apply it earlier in the next one, so problems are caught before a brand goes live rather than after.
* Draw on insight from the broader Sessions estate — brands already live and scaling — to identify where validation itself can improve.
* Build AI-enabled reporting tools that turn validation data into structured, comparable analysis, so each brand's learnings become part of a growing, repeatable body of knowledge rather than one-off analysis.
**People Management & Leadership:**
* Directly manage and line-lead the New Brands Trainer, setting clear operational priorities and managing workload across brand rollouts.
* Support ongoing professional development, career growth, and skills enhancement for direct reports.
* Lead recruitment and onboarding efforts as team requirements scale.
* Oversee performance management and evaluation to maintain high standards of execution across validation sites.
**DESIRED SKILLS, EXPERIENCE & QUALITIES:**
* **Process Ownership:** highly organised, with a strength in process and procedure — builds and continuously improves repeatable systems, not just follows them.
* **Cross-Functional Influence**: delivers through teams that don't report to them.
* **People Management:** has line-managed and developed a direct report.
* **Hands-On:** comfortable in the operational detail, not just directing from above.
* **Data and Hypothesis-Led:** uses data and hypotheses to proactively spot issues before they surface, blending on-the-ground insight with what the data is showing to drive decision-making.
* **Sector Experience:** food, hospitality or QSR background valuable as context — ideally kitchen-to-corporate or hospitality experience.
* Strong communicator, able to build rapport and resolve conflict.
* Willing to travel to host sites; based in the London office.
* Ambitious, with a drive to join a fast-paced, high-growth company.
* Delivery platform experience preferred but not essential.
* Charismatic and energetic, with a passion for food.
* Expert English and right to work in the UK.

WHAT MAKES US, US
Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!
At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.
If you like what we're saying, keep reading!
WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US
SimCorp is a global provider of integrated investment management solutions, part of Deutsche Börse Group, trusted by more than half of the world's top 100 financial companies. Five years ago, SimCorp's ESG solution did not exist. Today, many of these financial institutions use it for regulatory reporting such as SFDR-PAI and the EU Taxonomy. The newest addition is an AI agent that turns plain-language questions into working ESG analytics. Next on the roadmap: ESG attribution — explaining why a portfolio's ESG results changed between periods, or why they differ from a benchmark.
Our Product Owner is moving to a new role within SimCorp, and we are looking for the person to take over the backlog, the sprints, and the daily decisions that turn regulation into working software.
The timing matters. ESG is becoming part of a larger product area, Investment Foundations, which also covers business entities and a funded programme to eliminate free codes from our standard solutions. The backlogs will merge in the near term, and the role grows with them. You start with ESG.
You will work with an established engineering team (hiring is underway for 1–2 more) and closely with the Product Manager for Investment Foundations. The role can be based in Copenhagen, Frankfurt, Paris, London or Warsaw.
This is a very involved role with real ownership and direct client contact. Ideas get a fair hearing here, including unconventional ones; if yours holds up, you will get the backing to build it. You'd be joining a product with real traction and demanding users — the tightest feedback loop a Product Owner can ask for — and AI product work that is already in production, with room to push it further.
WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR
Own and prioritize the backlog, sprint by sprint, balancing client value, platform quality and technical health
Translate regulatory text into product increments and acceptance criteria — often while the text is still in consultation
Set goals with the team and own the outcomes we have promised clients, not just the output
Prototype before building: a mock-up, a rough demo, a client call. Being wrong on paper is cheap; being wrong in production is not.
Act as a knowledgeable subject-matter resource in client and auditor meetings, and host the user group for our ESG community
Work with data vendors and partners, including within Deutsche Börse Group, which SimCorp is part of
Say no, often, and explain why — the backlog holds more good ideas than the team has quarters
Use AI in your daily work: for research, for prototyping, and increasingly for building. Product management here is moving toward building, not just specifying — the title on this ad says Product Owner but treat it as a starting point.
WHAT WE VALUE
We would rather say this now than in the interview. Compliance software leaves no room for "mostly right". The domain is dense and getting wider, and it takes months to get genuinely good — we will teach you, but you have to want it. You will depend on teams you do not control, so coordination, not authority, is the daily tool. And the rules sometimes change while you are building for them.
People who ask "why" one more time than expected, follow problems into other teams' domains, and stay on the call until the thing works do well here. How many years you have carried the Product Owner title matters less than whether you learn faster than the regulation changes.
You will be a good match if you have several of the following:
Curiosity about AI and about how the investment industry works
Experience with ESG or regulatory reporting, e.g. SFDR-PAI or the EU Taxonomy
Knowledge of SimCorp's ESG solution or SimCorp Dimension (a plus)
Experience with B2B or enterprise software, especially data-heavy products
Experience owning the backlog and delivering with engineering teams
Clear written and verbal communication
BENEFITS
Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.
Growth and innovation - Every 6th sprint is reserved for planning and innovation. So, with regular intervals you have a chance to explore and learn new skills or improve something that you believe will be beneficial to you, your team or the application.
Self- Direction - High degree of self-organization. Each team and developer have a high degree of freedom to plan, organize and design their work.
Inclusive and diverse company culture
Pension and health benefits and bonus
Work-life balance – We truly believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of our self's, both in private life and as a colleague in the workplace
Empowerment – We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will involved in shaping our work processes
NEXT STEPS
Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photos, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

At Snappy Shopper, we’re committed to innovation, retail empowerment and community impact, helping stores thrive digitally, offering exceptional local convenience to customers, and shaping the future of on‐demand retail in the UK.
**Our location** We are a UK company with colleagues across the country and offices in Dundee and Edinburgh. This is a fully remote role, with occasional opportunities to connect with colleagues in person.
**About the team** You'll join our Android team, working closely with Product, Engineering and customer-facing colleagues across the business.
Our Android estate is broader than a single consumer app.
Snappy Shopper is our consumer ordering app, built in Kotlin with Jetpack Compose, Coroutines and Flow.
Order Manager receives orders in-store and supports picking, substitutions, refunds, receipt printing and driver assignment.
Snappy Pickeris used by store and warehouse teams to scan and pick products and manage gaps and substitutions.
Order Manager and Snappy Picker also mean working with older Kotlin, RxJava2 and XML codebases running on rugged hardware in thousands of stores, often over patchy connectivity and in sessions lasting all day. Here, reliability matters more than pixel polish.
**About the role**
As an experienced Android Developer, you’ll combine strong hands-on Android development with the independent technical judgement and ownership.
Day-to-day, you will:
* Design, build and maintain Android features across Snappy Shopper, Order Manager and Snappy Picker.
* Work with other Android developers and wider stakeholders to turn business requirements into clear technical approaches and deliverables.
* Make sound technical decisions, considering architecture, reliability, maintainability and the wider impact of your implementation.
* Take ownership of the quality and completeness of your solutions before they reach review.
* Review other developers’ code and contribute constructively to technical discussions.
* Troubleshoot existing Kotlin and legacy Java code and help resolve complex production issues.
* Work pragmatically, recognising when something needs solving properly now and when improvement is better left for another day.
**To be successful, you'll have:**
We’re looking for someone with strong level of Android capability rather than a checklist of every technology we use.
You’ll bring strong modern Kotlin experience, including reviewing other developers’ Kotlin and contributing meaningfully to PR discussions.
You’ll also have:
* Production experience with Jetpack Compose.
* Strong experience with Coroutines and Flow.
* Hilt, Dagger 2 or Koin experience, with a good understanding of dependency scoping.
* Experience working with multi-module Clean Architecture, where architecture and code-quality standards are enforced through tooling and CI.
* A strong unit-testing habit, using technologies such as JUnit and MockK/Mockito.
* Experience with collaborative development, version control and code review.
* Experience working within an Agile/Scrum environment.
Our apps currently ship at minSdk 24–26 and targetSdk 35–36.
We’d also like you to have done at least one of these:
* Worked with RxJava2, including good disposal discipline.
* Shipped a hardware integration using a vendor SDK, AIDL service, Bluetooth device or partner-app Intent.
* Shipped realtime functionality using WebSockets, including fallback and dead-connection handling.
* Worked with custom Dagger scopes or subcomponents with explicit teardown.
Exposure to XML/ViewBinding, Room, Crashlytics, payment SDKs, Firebase Remote Config, WorkManager, Bluetooth printing or similar technologies is useful, but isn't essential.
And there are things we don't expect you to know before you arrive. You'll learn our store domain and the hardware behind it, including Sunmi POS devices and scanners, PayPoint terminals, Zebra scanners and Bluetooth label printers.
**Who you are**
* **Community:** You collaborate well, share knowledge and help others reach better technical solutions.
* **Be Snappy:** You work at pace, adapt to changing priorities and take ownership of delivery.
* **Breaking Barriers:** You use sound technical judgement to solve difficult problems and aren't afraid to constructively challenge an approach when there's a better one.
* **Craic on:** You communicate clearly, build trusted relationships and enjoy working with technical and non-technical colleagues.
**What’s in it for you**
Joining Snappy as an Android Developer means working on more than another consumer mobile app.
You'll work across modern Compose development and established applications that sit at the heart of day-to-day store operations. You'll encounter interesting challenges around reliability, hardware, payments, realtime communication and applications operating in imperfect real-world conditions.
You'll have autonomy in how you solve problems, the opportunity to influence our Android engineering approach and a team that values good judgement as much as technical knowledge.
We offer a competitive salary, flexible remote working and ongoing opportunities for learning and development.
**Applying**
We want our recruitment process to give you (and us) a proper opportunity to understand whether the role is the right fit.
Following an initial application review, selected candidates will have an introductory conversation with our Engineering team to discuss your experience, the role and Snappy's Android environment.
Candidates progressing from there will take part in practical technical sessions involving different Android development scenarios and live coding exercises, giving us the opportunity to understand how you approach problems, write and work with code, make technical decisions and respond as requirements or constraints evolve.
We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and are committed to inclusive recruitment.
Please note that due to the volume of applications we receive, we’re only able to contact candidates who are selected to progress to the next stage.
